qe: Which type of tissue covers the body surface and lines internal organs?
qh: शरीर की सतह को ढंकने और आंतरिक अंगों को अस्तर देने वाला ऊतक कौन सा है?
e: Epithelial tissue hamari skin ki outermost layer aur internal cavities jaise digestive, respiratory aur vascular systems ki inner lining banata hai. Iska primary kaam underlying structures ko mechanical injury, infection aur fluid loss se protect karna, aur secretion tatha absorption karna hota hai. Baaki major tissues mein Connective tissue alag-alag organs ko support aur bind karta hai, Muscular tissue movement ke liye contraction provide karta hai, aur Nervous tissue electrical signals ke zariye poor body communication aur reflex response manage karta hai.

qe: What is the process of bone formation called?
qh: हड्डियों के निर्माण की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Osteogenesis ya Ossification wo physiological process hai jisme osteoblast cells naye bony matrix synthesize karte hain aur usme calcium salts deposit karke hard bone tissue develop karte hain. Ye do pathways se hota hai: intramembranous ossification jo skull aur flat bones banata hai, aur endochondral ossification jisme pehle hyaline cartilage banta hai jo baad mein long bones mein convert hota hai. Skeletal growth aur fracture repair dono isi mechanism se poore hote hain, jabki osteoclasts bone resorption karke dynamic balance maintain rakhte hain.

qe: The union of an ovum and a spermatozoon is known as:
qh: एक अंडे और एक शुक्राणु के मिलन को कहा जाता है:
e: Fertilization tab hoti hai jab fallopian tube ke ampulla mein mature sperm female ovum ke outer layer (zona pellucida) ko penetrate karta hai. Is nuclear fusion se haploid sperm aur ovum milkar 46 chromosomes wala single-cell diploid zygote banate hain. Ye step embryonic development ka initial milestone hai, jisse gender determine hota hai aur rapid mitotic cell division (cleavage) trigger hoti hai. Blastocyst banne ke baad uterus ke endometrium mein implantation hota hai, jahan se fetal growth continue hoti hai.

qe: What is the primary reason for performing a 'Chest Lordotic View'?
qh: 'चेस्ट लॉर्डोटिक व्यू' (Lordotic View) करने का प्राथमिक कारण क्या है?
oe: To visualize the lung apices without clavicle interference
oh: फेफड़ों के ऊपरी हिस्से (Apices) को कॉलर बोन की बाधा के बिना देखना
हृदय को बेहतर तरीके से देखना
पसलियों को स्पष्ट रूप से देखना
e: Standard Chest PA view mein clavicles aur first ribs lung apices ke upar superimpose ho jaate hain, jisse wahan hidden early lesions miss hone ka risk rehta hai. Chest Lordotic view mein patient ko erect position se lagbhag 45 degrees backward lean karaya jata hai ya X-ray tube ko cephalad angle diya jata hai. Is projection se clavicles lung fields se upar project ho jati hain, jisse tuberculosis cavities, apical masses aur Pancoast tumors bina kisi bone superimposition ke clear visualize hote hain.

qe: A 'Lateral Decubitus' view of the abdomen is primarily used to detect:
qh: पेट का 'लैटरल डिकुबिटस' (Lateral Decubitus) व्यू मुख्य रूप से क्या पता लगाने के लिए किया जाता है?
oe: Air-fluid levels or free intraperitoneal air
oh: हवा और तरल का स्तर या मुक्त इंट्रापेरिटोनियल हवा
e: Jab koi critical ya trauma patient khada hokar erect abdominal X-ray nahi kara sakta, tab horizontal beam ke sath Lateral Decubitus projection liya jata hai. Gravity physics ke principle par dense peritoneal fluid downward side mein settle ho jata hai aur free gas upward rise karke abdominal wall ke sath air crescent banati hai. Ye view acute bowel perforation, pneumoperitoneum, bowel obstruction aur hidden free ascites ko bed-ridden patients mein accurately rule out karne ke liye gold standard projection hai.

qe: In a 'Left Lateral Decubitus' position, the patient is lying on their:
qh: 'लेफ्ट लैटरल डिकुबिटस' स्थिति में, रोगी अपनी किस तरफ लेटा होता है?
e: Radiography terminology mein decubitus position ka naam hamesha us body surface ke mutabiq decide hota hai jo table ya couch ke direct contact mein downward rehti hai. Left lateral decubitus mein patient apni left side par leta hota hai aur central X-ray beam horizontally pass hoti hai. Free intraperitoneal air ko check karne ke liye ye position isliye standard hai kyunki upar aane wali free gas dense liver shadow ke outer border par easily demarcate ho jaati hai aur stomach gas bubble ke sath confuse nahi hoti.

qe: Which type of radiation effect is 'probability-based' and has no threshold dose?
qh: किस प्रकार का विकिरण प्रभाव 'संभावना' पर आधारित है और इसकी कोई सीमा (threshold) नहीं है?
e: Stochastic radiation effects purely probabilistic model follow karte hain, jiska matlab hai ki inka koi safe minimum threshold dose nahi hota (Linear No-Threshold model). Radiation dose badhne se sirf event hone ki probability badhti hai, bimari ki severity nahi. Ek single ionizing photon bhi DNA mein point mutation cause kar sakta hai. Cancer induction aur heritable genetic mutations iske classic examples hain, jinka manifestation exposure ke kai saalon ya decades baad (latent period) samne aata hai.

qe: Radiation-induced 'Cataracts' or 'Skin Erythema' (redness) are examples of:
qh: विकिरण के कारण 'मोतियाबिंद' या 'त्वचा की लालिमा' किसके उदाहरण हैं?
e: Deterministic effects (non-stochastic) tab trigger hote hain jab radiation dose ek specific fixed threshold limit ko cross kar leti hai, jisse large scale par cell death hoti hai. Threshold cross hote hi damage ki severity directly radiation dose ke sath increase hoti hai. Examples mein ocular lens opacity (cataract), skin erythema, epilation (hair loss) aur radiation sickness shamil hain. Inka safe dose cutoff pata hone ki wajah se radiation protection mein primary target organ equivalent dose limits set ki jaati hain.

qe: Which cells in the human body are most sensitive to radiation?
qh: मानव शरीर की कौन सी कोशिकाएं विकिरण के प्रति सबसे अधिक संवेदनशील होती हैं?
oh: तेजी से विभाजित होने वाली कोशिकाएं (लिम्फोसाइट्स / अस्थि मज्जा)
e: Law of Bergonie and Tribondeau ke hisab se wahi cells radiation-sensitive hoti hain jinki mitotic rate high ho, future division capability zyada ho aur differentiation level kam ho. Body mein hematopoietic stem cells, lymphocytes, bone marrow cells, gonadal germ cells aur intestinal epithelial cells highly radiosensitive category mein aate hain. Iske contrast mature non-dividing highly differentiated cells jaise adult neuron networks aur skeletal muscle fibers highly radioresistant hote hain aur high dose par bhi lethal damage sustain nahi karte.

qe: The 'Direct Action' of radiation on cells involves damage to:
qh: कोशिकाओं पर विकिरण की 'प्रत्यक्ष क्रिया' (Direct Action) में किसे नुकसान पहुँचता है?
e: Direct action of radiation tab hoti hai jab incident ionizing radiation photons ya secondary electrons directly biological target macromolecules jaise nuclear DNA, RNA ya enzymes ke sath interact karte hain. Is direct impact se chemical bonds break hote hain, jisse single-strand breaks (SSB) ya critical double-strand breaks (DSB) develop hote hain. Direct action high Linear Energy Transfer (LET) radiations jaise alpha particles aur heavy ions mein dominant mode of cellular biological destruction hota hai.

qe: The 'Indirect Action' of radiation involves the production of:
qh: विकिरण की 'अप्रत्यक्ष क्रिया' (Indirect Action) में किसका उत्पादन शामिल है?
oh: फ्री रेडिकल्स (जल के रेडियोलिसिस से उत्पन्न)
e: Human body lagbhag 70 se 80 percent water se bani hoti hai. Jab X-rays ya gamma rays cell mein enter karte hain, toh wo water molecules ko ionize karke radiolytic breakdown karte hain. Is Radiolysis of Water se highly reactive free radicals jaise hydroxyl radical (OH•) aur hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) produce hote hain. Ye unstable chemical species intracellular target macromolecules aur DNA strands par oxidative attack karti hain. Low LET radiation jaise medical X-rays mein roughly do-tihaai damage isi indirect path se hota hai.

qe: A 'Stochastic' effect like Cancer usually has a:
qh: कैंसर जैसा 'स्टोकेस्टिक' प्रभाव आमतौर पर कैसा होता है?
e: Radiation exposure se induced cancer ka manifestation acute na hokar ek lambi latency period ke baad visible hota hai. Sub-lethal DNA mutations acquire hone ke baad cell division cycles continue karti hain, jisme epigenetic shifts aur defective apoptosis accumulate hone mein kayi saal lag jaate hain. Leukemia ka latency span lagbhag 2 se 5 saal hota hai, jabki solid organ tumors (jaise thyroid, breast, lung carcinomas) ko clinically surface hone mein 10 se 30 saal tak lag sakte hain.

qe: Which radiographic position is best for detecting a small 'Pleural Effusion'?
qh: कम मात्रा में 'प्लुरल एफ्यूजन' (फेफड़ों में पानी) का पता लगाने के लिए कौन सी स्थिति सबसे अच्छी है?
e: Standard erect chest PA radiograph costophrenic angle ko tabhi blunt dikhata hai jab pleural fluid 150 se 200 ml se zyada ho. Small ya trace effusions (5 se 10 ml tak) detect karne ke liye Lateral Decubitus projection with horizontal beam kiya jata hai, jisme affected side dependent (downward) rakhi jaati hai. Gravity fluid ko dependent hemithorax ke lateral chest wall par strip ki tarah spread kar deti hai, jisse fluid layer free-flowing nature ke sath easily confirm ho jati hai.

qe: What is the main advantage of an 'Automatic Processor' over manual processing?
qh: मैनुअल की तुलना में 'ऑटोमैटिक प्रोसेसर' का मुख्य लाभ क्या है?
oe: Faster processing speed and uniform consistency
oh: तेज प्रोसेसिंग गति और एकसमान निरंतरता
e: Manual darkroom development mein 45 se 60 minutes lagte hain aur human error ki wajah se optical density vary karti hai. Automatic processor continuous roller conveyor system aur micro-controlled thermostat heaters use karke pura cycle (develop, fix, wash aur dry) 90 seconds mein complete kar deta hai. Isse standardized chemical agitation, precise replenishment aur constant optical density milti hai, jisse repeat films aur unnecessary radiation exposure reduce hota hai.

qe: What is 'Replenishment' in an automatic film processor?
qh: ऑटोमैटिक फिल्म प्रोसेसर में 'रेप्लेनिशमेंट' (Replenishment) क्या है?
oe: Adding fresh chemicals to maintain solution strength
oh: रोलर्स को मैन्युअल रूप से साफ करना
घोल की शक्ति बनाए रखने के लिए ताजे रसायनों की पुनः पूर्ति
e: Jab continuous processing hoti hai, developer ke reducing agents silver reduce karte waqt oxidize ho jate hain aur halides accumulate hote hain, jabki fixer mein acidic pH rise ho jati hai aur dissolved silver badh jata hai. Is exhaustion aur drag-out loss ko neutralize karne ke liye replenishment system use hota hai. Har processed film ke surface area ke hisab se microswitches pump activate karke precise amount mein fresh developer aur fixer chemistry add karte hain taaki chemical activity constant rahe.

qe: Which component of the automatic processor moves the film through the tanks?
qh: ऑटोमैटिक प्रोसेसर का कौन सा घटक टैंकों के माध्यम से फिल्म को घुमाता है?
e: Automatic processor ka Roller Transport System racks, turnaround assemblies aur drive gears se bana hota hai. Master drive motor continuously gears ko rotate karti hai, jisse opposed neoprene aur phenolic rollers film ko constant linear speed par enter, submerged transport aur squeeze karte hain. Rollers film ko transport karne ke alawa emulsion surface par continuous chemical agitation dete hain aur tank exit par excess chemistry ko squeegee karke drag-out loss prevent karte hain.

qe: In automatic processing, the 'Dryer Section' uses:
qh: ऑटोमैटिक प्रोसेसिंग में, 'ड्रायर सेक्शन' किसका उपयोग करता है?
e: Processor ke wash tank se nikalne ke baad wet emulsion mein moisture retain rehti hai. Squeegee rollers se initial liquid clear hone ke baad film dryer section mein jaati hai. Wahan electric heating coils 50 se 55 degrees Celsius par air heat karte hain aur high-velocity blower fans use air tubes (air knives) ke through film ke dono sides par evenly spray karte hain. Is rapid evaporation se gelatin harden ho jati hai aur dry, non-sticky film bin mein collect hoti hai.

qe: What happens if the 'Replenishment Rate' is too low?
qh: यदि 'रेप्लेनिशमेंट दर' बहुत कम हो तो क्या होगा?
oe: Loss of contrast and thin, light images
oh: कंट्रास्ट की कमी और हल्की/पतली इमेज
e: Replenishment pump rate kam hone par fresh developer chemistry tank mein inject nahi hoti. Heavy aerial oxidation aur spent bromide ions ke buildup se developer ki reducing capacity gir jaati hai. Exposed silver halide grains fully metallic silver mein convert nahi hote, jisse overall optical density drop ho jati hai aur radiograph under-developed, pale aur low-contrast (thin image) bankar nikalta hai. Diagnostically useless hone ki wajah se aise cases mein repeats badh jaate hain.

qe: Why is the 'Developer' temperature kept higher in automatic processors than manual?
qh: ऑटोमैटिक प्रोसेसर में डेवलपर का तापमान मैनुअल की तुलना में अधिक क्यों रखा जाता है?
oe: To speed up the chemical reaction for rapid cycle time
oh: रोलर घिसाव बंद करने के लिए
रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया को तेज कर प्रोसेसिंग समय घटाने के लिए
e: Manual tanks mein developer 20 degrees Celsius par work karta hai aur lagbhag 5 minute develop hone mein lagte hain. Automatic processor ko 90-second total cycle achieve karne ke liye developer immersion window sirf 20 se 25 seconds milti hai. Reaction rate accelerate karne ke liye developer solution ka temperature heating elements aur heat exchangers ke through 34 se 35 degrees Celsius (approx 95 degrees Fahrenheit) maintain kiya jata hai taaki rapid reduction possible ho sake.

qe: What is the function of 'Hardener' in the automatic developer?
qh: ऑटोमैटिक डेवलपर में 'हार्डनर' (Hardener) का क्या कार्य है?
oe: To prevent excessive swelling and softening of gelatin emulsion
To convert film to black shade
oh: जिलेटिन इमल्शन को अत्यधिक फूलने और मुलायम होने से रोकना
e: Elevated temperatures (approx 35°C) par developer mein maujood photographic gelatin moisture absorb karke excessively swell aur soft ho jaati hai, jisse roller drive assemblies mein emulsion scratch ya film jam hone ka severe risk hota hai. Isliye automatic developers mein Glutaraldehyde ko hardening agent ke roop mein add kiya jata hai. Ye gelatin molecules ko cross-link karke mechanical strength deta hai taaki emulsion hard rahe aur drying stage smoothly manage ho sake.

qe: Which artifact is specifically caused by dirty rollers in an automatic processor?
qh: ऑटोमैटिक प्रोसेसर में गंदे रोलर्स के कारण कौन सा आर्टिफैक्ट होता है?
oh: पाई लाइन्स / दोहराव वाले निशान (Pi Lines)
e: Agar processor transport assembly ka roller dirty ho ya uspar chemical precipitate/physical dent ban jaye, toh wo film pass hote waqt wet emulsion par local pressure dalta hai. Kyunki roller cylindrical hota hai, har full rotation ke baad wo artifact repeat hota hai. Distance between lines hamesha roller circumference ke barabar hoti hai ($C = \pi 	imes D$), isliye ise 'Pi Lines' kehte hain. Routine rack cleaning aur deep roller scrubbing se is artifact ko eradicate kiya jata hai.

qe: The 'Recirculation System' in an automatic processor helps to:
qh: प्रोसेसर में 'रीसर्कुलेशन सिस्टम' क्या मदद करता है?
oe: Continuously mix chemicals, maintain temperature, and filter debris
oh: रसायनों को लगातार मिलाना, तापमान बनाए रखना और कणों को छानना
e: Automatic processor tanks mein Recirculation System dedicated pumps ke through developer aur fixer solutions ko continuously bottom se draw karke top par recirculate karta hai. Is agitation se chemical stratification rukti hai aur thermostatic heating cartridge ke coordination se tank bhar mein uniform temperature maintain hota hai. Inline particulate filter developer solution se emulsion particles aur precipitates trap kar leta hai taaki films par sludge deposits na bane.

qe: What is the primary biological effect of ionizing radiation on human cells?
qh: मानव कोशिकाओं पर आयनकारी विकिरण का प्राथमिक जैविक प्रभाव क्या है?
oe: DNA damage and structural strand breaks
oh: डीएनए (DNA) क्षति और संरचनात्मक स्ट्रैंड ब्रेक
e: Ionizing radiation biological systems mein electrons eject karke chemical bonds alter karta hai. Iska primary aur most critical biological target nuclear DNA hota hai. Ionization ki wajah se base pair alterations, single-strand breaks aur critical double-strand breaks create hote hain. Agar cell in breaks ko repair karne mein fail ho jata hai, toh premature apoptotic death, mitotic failure ya malignant transformation (carcinogenesis) hoti hai, jo ki radiation biology ka fundamental hazard mechanism hai.

qe: What causes 'Static Marks' (tree-like black streaks) on a radiographic film?
qh: रेडियोग्राफिक फिल्म पर 'स्टैटिक मार्क्स' (पेड़ जैसी काली धारियां) का क्या कारण है?
oe: Low relative humidity and frictional static discharge
oh: कम सापेक्ष आर्द्रता और घर्षण से स्थिर विद्युत निर्वहन
e: Jab darkroom ya loading room mein relative humidity 40% se neeche chali jaati hai, dry atmosphere electrostatic build-up encourage karta hai. Cassette se film nikalte ya feed tray par rapidly slide karte waqt physical friction se static electricity discharge hoti hai. Ye electrostatic spark visible light emit karti hai jo raw film emulsion ko instantly expose kar deti hai. Processing ke baad film par tree-like branching, feather ya crown shapes ke characteristic black artifacts dikhte hain.

qe: A 'Crescent Mark' (half-moon shaped mark) on film is caused by:
qh: 'क्रिसेंट मार्क' (आधे चाँद के आकार का निशान) किसके कारण होता है?
oe: Kinking or acute mechanical bending of the film
e: Crescent marks (half-moon / fingernail artifacts) tab form hote hain jab film ko careless handling ki wajah se corner se grab kiya jata hai ya sharply kink/bend kiya jata hai. Acute localized bending se emulsion layer par heavy mechanical stress padta hai. Agar bending processing se pehle ho toh local pressure se latent image generate ho kar dark black crescent banati hai; agar bending exposure se pehle ho jaye toh sensitivity crack hone se white crescent bhi ban sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Radiographic Density'?
qh: 'रेडियोग्राफिक डेंसिटी' (Radiographic Density) क्या है?
oe: Overall degree of blackening on the processed film
oh: प्रोसेस्ड फिल्म का कुल कालापन (Degree of Blackening)
e: Radiographic Optical Density processed film par deposited metallic silver granules ki wajah se develop hue overall blackening level ko define karti hai. Ye view-box se aane wali light transmission ka logarithmic ratio hoti hai: $OD = \log_{10}(I_0 / I_t)$. Jab X-ray photons emulsion ke silver halide crystals ko interact karte hain aur chemical develop hoti hai, metallic silver banta hai. Zyada photons absorb hone se density increase hoti hai, jo image blackening decide karti hai.

qe: Which factor is the primary controller of 'Radiographic Contrast'?
qh: 'रेडियोग्राफिक कंट्रास्ट' का प्राथमिक नियंत्रक कौन सा कारक है?
e: Peak kilovoltage (kVp) primary X-ray beam ki average energy aur penetrating quality control karta hai. Low kVp par Photoelectric Absorption dominate karti hai, jisse adjacent tissues (jaise bone aur muscle) ke attenuation values mein wide difference generate hota hai, resulting in high contrast (short-scale, sharp black-and-white). High kVp Compton Scatter interaction badhata hai, jisse differential absorption narrow ho kar long-scale low contrast (multiple gray shades) produce karti hai.

qe: How does increasing the 'SID' (Source to Image Distance) affect image detail?
qh: 'SID' बढ़ाने से इमेज डिटेल पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
oe: Increases recorded detail by reducing penumbra
oh: इमेज को बहुत धुंधला करता है
इमेज की डिटेल कम करता है
पेनम्ब्रा घटाकर इमेज डिटेल बढ़ाता है
e: Source to Image Receptor Distance (SID) ko badhane se X-ray beam ke divergent margins narrow ho jate hain. Geometry ke mutabiq Focal Spot Blur ya Penumbra ($P =  rac{	ext{FSS} 	imes 	ext{OID}}{	ext{SOD}}$) calculate hota hai; jab SID badhta hai, SOD bhi proportion mein rise hota hai jisse penumbra area significantly shrink ho jata hai. Edge sharpness enhance hoti hai aur magnification artifact khatam hota hai, jisse image par fine recorded anatomical detail visible hoti hai.

qe: What is the result of using a 'Large Focal Spot Size' (FSS)?
qh: 'बड़े फोकल स्पॉट साइज' (FSS) के उपयोग का क्या परिणाम होता है?
oe: Increased geometric blur (penumbra) and reduced image sharpness
oh: ज्योमेट्रिक धुंधलापन (Penumbra) में वृद्धि और तीक्ष्णता में कमी
e: X-ray tube ka target anodal area jahan incident electron beam collide karti hai, use effective focal spot kehte hain. Large focal spot (typically 1.0 se 1.2 mm) high heat loads sustain karne ke liye safe hota hai, lekin optical unsharpness (penumbra) ko broad kar deta hai.边缘 (edges) fuzzy ho jane se fine spatial resolution degrade ho jati hai. Isliye fine micro-calcifications aur extremities ke liye small focal spot (0.6 mm) use kiya jata hai.

qe: The 'OID' (Object to Image Distance) should ideally be kept:
qh: 'OID' (वस्तु से इमेज की दूरी) को कैसा रखा जाना चाहिए?
e: Object to Image Distance (OID) patient body part aur image receptor plane ke beech ka distance hota hai. Jaise-jaise OID badhta hai, X-ray beam divergence ki wajah se beam anatomy ko amplify karti hai, jisse geometric magnification increase hota hai aur geometric blur (penumbra) fail kar structural sharpness ruin kar deta hai. Sharper edges aur true anatomical size ensure karne ke liye patient anatomy ko detector cassette ke sath directly contact mein rakha jata hai.

qe: What causes 'Scratches' (white lines) on a processed film?
qh: Processed फिल्म पर 'खरोंच' (सफेद रेखाएं) का क्या कारण है?
oe: Physical abrasion of soft emulsion by transport rollers or fingernails
oh: रोलर्स या नाखूनों द्वारा मुलायम इमल्शन का छिलना
e: Wet processing ke dauran gelatin emulsion liquid absorb karke soft aur vulnerable ban jati hai. Agar is state mein transport rollers par abrasive particles hon, guide shoes misalignment hon, ya operator film handling ke dauran nails se press kare, toh emulsion layer physically scrape off ho sakti hai. Scraping se silver grains completely wipe out ho jaate hain, aur processing ke baad clear film base expose hone se wo radiograph par sharp white lines ke roop mein appear hote hain.

qe: Which factor primarily controls 'Image Density'?
qh: 'इमेज डेंसिटी' को मुख्य रूप से कौन सा कारक नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Milliampere-seconds (mAs) tube current (mA) aur exposure duration (seconds) ka product hota hai, jo cathode filament se nikle thermal electrons ki total quantity set karta hai. Ye directly target se release hue primary X-ray photons ke number (beam quantity) ko govern karta hai. Direct linear correlation hone ke kaaran agar mAs double kiya jaye, toh detector tak pahuchne wale photons double ho jaate hain aur film density proportionally increase ho jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Penumbra' in radiography?
qh: रेडियोग्राफी में 'पेनम्ब्रा' (Penumbra) क्या है?
oe: Geometric unsharpness or blur around image boundaries
oh: छवि सीमाओं के चारों ओर ज्योमेट्रिक धुंधलापन (Geometric unsharpness)
e: X-ray tube ka focal spot ek single mathematical point source nahi hota, balki ek finite rectangular physical surface hota hai. Finite size se radiate hone ki wajah se anatomical edge par divergent photons ek partial shadow zone create karte hain jise Penumbra ya Focal Spot Blur kehte hain. Penumbra zone jitna broad hoga, true shadow (umbra) utni hi indistinct hogi, jisse image boundaries fuzzy dikhne lagengi aur resolution drop ho jayega.

qe: What is the main reducing agent in the 'Developer' solution?
qh: 'डेवलपर' समाधान में मुख्य रिड्यूसिंग एजेंट क्या है?
e: Developer solution latent image ko visible metallic silver image mein transform karta hai via chemical reduction. Is formulation ke do primary chemical agents Hydroquinone aur Phenidone (ya Metol) hote hain jo synergistically work karte hain. Phenidone rapidly optical density ke initial light gray midtones create karta hai, jabki slower-acting Hydroquinone high-density maximum blacks produce karta hai. Sath mein milkar ye balanced radiographic contrast aur acceptable visual density provide karte hain.

qe: The 'Clearing time' in the dark room refers to:
qh: डार्क रूम में 'क्लियरिंग टाइम' (Clearing time) का तात्पर्य है:
oe: Time taken by fixer to dissolve unexposed silver halide crystals
oh: फिक्सर द्वारा अप्रकाशित सिल्वर को घोलकर हटाने का समय
e: Jab processed film developer se nikal kar fixer bath mein jaati hai, unexposed aur undeveloped silver halide crystals emulsion ko milky-white aur opaque bana kar rakhte hain. Fixer ka solvent agent (Ammonium Thiosulfate) in crystals ko soluble silver-thiosulfate complexes mein convert karta hai. Wo duration jisme film ka milky look disappear hokar base transparent ban jaata hai, use 'Clearing Time' kehte hain. Total fixing time standardly clearing time ka double rakha jata hai.

qe: Why is 'Acetic Acid' added to the Fixer solution?
qh: फिक्सर समाधान में 'एसिटिक एसिड' क्यों मिलाया जाता है?
oe: To reduce wash tank water usage
To neutralize residual alkaline developer and stop development
oh: धात्विक कणों को कृत्रिम रूप से काला करना
क्षारीय डेवलपर को बेअसर कर विकास रोकना (Neutralize developer)
e: Developer solution highly alkaline (pH 10 se 11) environment mein operate karta hai. Agar emulsion par laga residual alkali fixer mein carry over ho jaye, toh reduction reaction unexposed areas mein bhi continue rahegi aur chemical fog create karegi. Isko prevent karne ke liye fixer formulation mein Acetic Acid ko activator/acidifier ke roop mein add kiya jata hai jo pH ko 4.0 se 4.5 drop kar deta hai, alkaline development ko stop karta hai aur fixing agent ko active karta hai.

qe: Which 'Safelight' filter is used for green-sensitive (orthochromatic) films?
qh: ग्रीन-सेंसिटिव फिल्मों के लिए कौन सा 'सेफलाइट' फिल्टर उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Orthochromatic radiographic films blue aur green electromagnetic spectrum light ke liye highly sensitive hoti hain. Safelight fogging prevent karne ke liye illumination source film emulsion ki spectral sensitivity envelope se bahar fall hona chahiye. GBX-2 ruby-red safelight filter wavelength 600 nm se niche ki all light blocks block kar deta hai aur sirf pure dark red transmit karta hai. Green-sensitive grains red photons absorb nahi karte, isliye processing safe rehti hai.

qe: What causes 'Film Fog' in the dark room?
qh: डार्क रूम में 'फिल्म फॉग' (Film Fog) का कारण क्या है?
oe: Stray light leaks, faulty safelights, or expired chemicals
oh: आवारा प्रकाश का रिसाव, दोषपूर्ण सेफलाइट या पुराने रसायन
e: Radiographic film fog ek unintentional base optical density hoti hai jo primary beam radiation exposure ke bina film develop hone par create hoti hai. Darkroom environments mein faulty door seals, illumination leaks, incorrect bulb wattage ya cracked safelight filters optical fog trigger karte hain. Similarly, chemical storage over-temperature, expired emulsions aur excessive developer activity unexposed silver crystals reduce karke chemical fog build karte hain, jisse overall contrast degrade ho jata hai.

qe: The 'Distance' part of radiation protection states that intensity decreases by:
qh: विकिरण सुरक्षा का 'दूरी' भाग कहता है कि तीव्रता कम होती है:
oe: The inverse square of the distance from the source
oh: प्रति इकाई दूरी पर ठीक आधी
स्रोत से दूरी के व्युत्क्रम वर्ग के अनुपात में (Inverse Square Law)
दूरी को दो से गुणा करने पर
e: Radiation safety mein Inverse Square Law ($I_1/I_2 = (d_2/d_1)^2$) primary fundamental principle hai. Ionizing radiation point source se spherically propagate karti hai, isliye radiation intensity source distance ke square ke inverse proportion mein rapidly fall hoti hai. Agar technician source se separation distance double (2x) kar le, toh effective occupational radiation dose घटकर sirf one-fourth (1/4) reh jaati hai. Distance increase karna instant radiation protection provide karta hai.

qe: What is the purpose of 'Final Washing' in film processing?
qh: फिल्म प्रोसेसिंग में 'अंतिम धुलाई' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
oe: To wash off all residual thiosulfate and fixer chemistry
oh: बचे हुए थायोसल्फेट और फिक्सर रसायनों को पूरी तरह हटाना
बचे हुए दानों को ब्लीच करना
e: Fixer bath ke baad gelatin emulsion residual fixer chemicals aur dissolved silver thiosulfate complexes se saturated hoti hai. Agar running clean water bath mein adequate final wash na kiya jaye, toh residual thiosulfate slow chemical reaction ke zariye silver image ke sath react karke silver sulfide banata hai. Is degradation se radiograph waqt ke sath yellow-brown discolor ho jaata hai aur permanent diagnostic record spoil ho jaata hai.

qe: Which device is used to measure a technician's cumulative occupational radiation dose?
qh: तकनीशियन की संचयी विकिरण खुराक मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thermo-luminescent Dosimeter (TLD) badge radiation personnel safety monitoring ke liye standard wearable dosimeter hai. Iske andar Calcium Sulfate (CaSO4:Dy) ya Lithium Fluoride (LiF) crystals sealed hote hain. Ionizing radiation in crystals ke electrons ko metastable higher energy traps mein pack kar deti hai. Accredited lab par readout ke dauran crystals heat kiye jaate hain, jisse trapped energy emitted light photons ke roop mein release hoti hai, jo accurate accumulated dose measure karti hai.

qe: A 'Grid' is used in radiography to:
qh: रेडियोग्राफी में 'ग्रिड' (Grid) का उपयोग किया जाता है:
oe: Reduce scatter radiation reaching the image receptor
oh: इमेज रिसेप्टर तक पहुँचने वाले स्कैटर रेडिएशन को अवशोषित करना
ट्यूब की ऊष्मा को कम करना
e: Jab primary X-ray beam thick body anatomical regions (greater than 10 cm) se pass hoti hai, Compton Scatter radiation originate hoti hai jo omnidirectional pattern mein traverse karti hai. Ye scattered photons film par unwanted general gray fog laydown karte hain jisse image contrast vanish ho jaata hai. Patient aur image receptor ke beech lagi lead-strip grid parallel transmitted primary photons ko pass karti hai jabki angled scatter photons ko lead strips mein trap kar leti hai.

qe: The 'Latent Image' is formed in which layer of the radiographic film?
qh: रेडियोग्राफिक फिल्म की किस परत में 'गुप्त छवि' (Latent Image) बनती है?
oe: Emulsion layer containing silver halide crystals
oh: सिल्वर हैलाइड युक्त इमल्शन परत (Emulsion layer)
e: Radiographic film ki active functional layer Emulsion hoti hai jo gelatin matrix mein suspended photosensitive Silver Halide micro-crystals (chiefly Silver Bromide with Silver Iodide) se construct hoti hai. Exposure ke waqt jab X-ray photons ya screen light crystals ko strike karti hain, Gurney-Mott theory ke hisab se electron traps sensitivity specks par metallic silver atoms aggregate kar dete hain. Ye invisible chemical trace processing se pehle 'Latent Image' kehlaata hai.

qe: What is the specific instruction for a patient before a 'Barium Meal' examination?
qh: 'बेरियम मील' परीक्षण से पहले रोगी के लिए विशिष्ट निर्देश क्या है?
oe: Drink copious fluids prior to test
Fasting for at least 6-8 hours prior to test (NPO)
oh: परीक्षण से पहले खूब पानी पीना
परीक्षण से कम से कम 6-8 घंटे पहले उपवास (NPO)
e: Barium Meal examination stomach aur duodenal mucosa ka fluoroscopic evaluation hota hai. Clear visualization ke liye upper gastrointestinal tract ka residual food solids, gastric secretions aur fluid bubbles se empty hona critical hai. Isliye patient ko strictly 'Nil Per Os' (NPO) yaani overnight ya examination se minimum 6 se 8 hours pehle tak fast karne ko kaha jata hai, taaki Barium suspension stomach walls ko uniform coat kar sake.

qe: In a 'Trauma' chest X-ray, which position is used if the patient cannot stand?
qh: यदि रोगी खड़ा नहीं हो सकता, तो 'ट्रॉमा' चेस्ट एक्स-रे में किस स्थिति का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Trauma settings mein patients aksar spinal instability, shock, unconsciousness ya severe pelvic injuries ke sath present karte hain jahan erect khada karna contraindicated ya impossible hota hai. Aise cases mein trolley ya bed par hi cassette patient ke peeth ke peeche place karke vertical beam se Supine AP projection kiya jata hai. Halanki isme heart magnification aur fluid levels evaluate karne mein limitations aati hain, par acute pneumothorax aur gross injury instantly detect ho jaati hai.

qe: Which contrast agent is used in 'GIT' studies like Ba Meal and Ba Enema?
qh: Ba Meal और Ba Enema जैसे GIT अध्ययनों में कौन सा कंट्रास्ट एजेंट उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Barium Sulphate ($BaSO_4$) gastrointestinal luminal examinations ke liye primary radio-opaque positive contrast agent hai. Barium ka atomic number high ($Z = 56$) hota hai, jo tissue ke comparison mein X-ray beam ko dramatically attenuate karta hai. Iski chemical property completely insoluble aur chemically inert hone ki wajah se ye GIT mucosa se systemically absorb nahi hota aur patient ko systemic heavy metal toxicity se safe rakhta hai.

qe: What is the primary sign of 'Heart Failure' on a chest X-ray?
qh: चेस्ट एक्स-रे पर 'हार्ट फेल्योर' का प्राथमिक लक्षण क्या है?
e: Congestive Heart Failure (CHF) ka standard radiographic indicator chest PA view par Cardiomegaly hota hai, jisme Cardiothoracic Ratio (CTR) 50% (0.5) se exceed kar jata hai. Iske sath pulmonary venous hypertension ke radiographic markers visible hote hain jaise upper lobe blood vessel diversion (cephalization), interstitial fluid leakage se Kerley B lines, peribronchial cuffing, bat-wing alveolar edema aur bilateral pleural effusion fluid collection.

qe: Which study is performed to visualize the 'Duodenum'?
qh: 'डुओडेनम' (ग्रहणी) को देखने के लिए कौन सा अध्ययन किया जाता है?
e: Barium Meal examination digestive system ke stomach aur continuous C-loop duodenum (duodenal bulb aur sweeping loop) ko evaluate karta hai. Fluoroscopic real-time control ke under oral barium suspension swallow karake peristaltic waves monitor ki jaati hain. Ye procedure duodenal ulcers, bulb deformity, diverticula, duodenal masses aur gastric outlet obstruction pathologies ko pinpoint accurately diagnose karta hai.

qe: For an 'AP View' of the chest, the X-ray beam enters from:
qh: छाती के 'AP व्यू' के लिए, एक्स-रे बीम कहाँ से प्रवेश करती है?
e: Radiographic nomenclature central ray ke entering surface aur exiting surface ke sequence par define hoti hai. Antero-Posterior (AP) view mein central X-ray beam patient ke anterior surface (chest front) se enter karti hai aur internal thorax traverse karke posterior surface (back) par rakhe image receptor cassette par terminate hoti hai. Is projection mein heart anteriorly placed hone ki wajah se receptor se door hota hai, jisse magnification artifact increase hota hai.

qe: The 'Plain Abdomen' X-ray is often used to detect:
qh: 'सादा पेट' एक्स-रे अक्सर किसका पता लगाने के लिए किया जाता है?
oe: Intestinal obstruction, perforation, or radio-opaque stones
oh: आंतों में रुकावट, वेध (Perforation) या पथरी
e: Acute plain abdominal radiography (KUB / Supine view) emergency abdominal diagnostics ka first-line triage tool hai. Is projection se pathological bowel patterns (jaise small/large bowel mechanical obstruction ke dilated loops), abnormal bowel gas localization, pneumoperitoneum (subdiaphragmatic free air), aur radiopaque calcifications jaise urinary calculi (kidney, ureter, bladder stones) aur gallstones instantly locate ho jaate hain.

qe: What is 'Double Contrast' study in GIT radiography?
qh: GIT रेडियोग्राफी में 'डबल कंट्रास्ट' अध्ययन क्या है?
oe: Simultaneous use of dense Barium and Gas (Air/CO2)
Administering two separate liquid barium doses
oh: बेरियम और हवा/गैस का एक साथ उपयोग (Barium and Air)
e: Double Contrast barium study mein mucosal lining par thin radio-opaque Barium Sulphate layer spread karayi jaati hai aur lumen ko negative radiolucent gas (carbon dioxide effervescent granules ya room air) se distend kiya jata hai. Is technique se mucosal architectural fine detail reveal hoti hai, jisse flat superficial polyps, small early mucosal ulcerations, erosions aur subtle mucosal abnormalities visualize ho jaati hain jo thick single contrast mein hide ho jaati hain.

qe: In chest trauma, 'Rib fractures' are best visualized in which view?
qh: चेस्ट ट्रॉमा में, 'पसलियों के फ्रैक्चर' किस व्यू में सबसे अच्छे दिखाई देते हैं?
oh: समर्पित ऑब्लिक रिब व्यू (Oblique Rib views)
e: Pansliyan (ribs) thoracic cavity ke around curved structure form karti hain, jisse standard PA aur AP chest radiographs par lateral aur axillary rib margins tangential profile na milne aur superimposition ke kaaran obscure ho jaate hain. Patient ko 45 degrees par rotate karke Oblique Rib projection lene se rib arch beam ke profile alignment mein aa jati hai, jisse undisplaced hairline fractures, cortical breaks aur underlying flail chest deformities clearly demarcate hoti hain.

qe: A 'Gastrografin' swallow is used instead of Barium if:
qh: बेरियम के बजाय 'गैस्ट्रोग्राफिन' स्वेलो का उपयोग किया जाता है यदि:
oe: Visceral perforation or leakage is suspected
oh: आंतों में वेध या रिसाव (Perforation) का संदेह हो
e: Barium Sulphate suspension agar bowel perforation, esophageal rupture (Boerhaave syndrome) ya anastomosis leak ke through peritoneal ya mediastinal cavity mein escape kar jaye, toh ye severe chemical granulomatous peritonitis aur fibroblastic scarring cause karta hai. Isliye suspicion of perforation mein water-soluble, iodinated contrast agent 'Gastrografin' use kiya jata hai, kyunki leak hone par bhi ye surrounding interstitial tissues se safely reabsorb ho jata hai.

qe: What is the primary function of a 'Safelight' in a dark room?
qh: डार्क रूम में 'सेफलाइट' (Safelight) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
oe: Provides safe working illumination without fogging film emulsion
oh: फिल्म को खराब (Fog) किए बिना काम करने योग्य प्रकाश देना
e: Photographic X-ray films unexposed state mein ordinary visible white light photons se instantly expose aur fog ho jaati hain. Darkroom safelight ek enclosed filtered lamp fixture hota hai jisme calibrated bulb (7.5-15W) aur colored absorption filter laga hota hai. Safelight wahi narrow wavelength range emit karti hai jiske liye film emulsion non-sensitive hoti hai, jisse technician without fogging raw cassettes unload aur reload easily kar sakta hai.

qe: The 'Developer' solution in film processing is used to:
qh: फिल्म प्रोसेसिंग में 'डेवलपर' (Developer) समाधान का उपयोग किया जाता है:
oe: Convert the invisible latent image into a visible black metallic silver image
oh: अदृश्य गुप्त छवि (Latent Image) को दृश्य काली छवि में बदलना
e: Exposure ke baad radiographic film ke crystal defects par banne wala latent image molecular scale par invisible hota hai. Developer chemical solution (pH 10+) reducing agents supply karke in exposed silver halide grains ko electrons contribute karta hai. Is catalytic chemical reaction se exposed crystals visible microscopic metallic silver grains mein rapidly reduce ho jaate hain, jo processed film par anatomically accurate black-and-gray optical densities create karte hain.

qe: What is the role of 'Fixer' in the dark room technique?
qh: डार्क रूम तकनीक में 'फिक्सर' (Fixer) की क्या भूमिका है?
oe: To remove unexposed silver halide crystals and make the image permanent
To act as primary reducing agent
oh: अप्रकाशित सिल्वर हैलाइड को हटाना और छवि को स्थायी बनाना (Fix image)
मुख्य रिड्यूसिंग एजेंट का काम करना
e: Development step ke baad film par unexposed aur unreduced silver halide grains bache rehte hain, jo daylight mein aane par continuously darken hokar image ruin kar sakte hain. Fixer solution ka Clearing Agent (Ammonium Thiosulfate) in unexposed halide grains ko dissolve karke clear silver-thiosulfate complexes banata hai. Sath hi iska Acidifier developer reaction halt karta hai aur Hardener (Aluminium Chloride) soft gelatin matrix ko permanently harden karta hai.

qe: Radiation 'Protection' for staff includes which of the following?
qh: कर्मचारियों के लिए विकिरण 'सुरक्षा' (Protection) में निम्नलिखित में से क्या शामिल है?
oe: Lead aprons, thyroid shields, and TLD dosimeter badges
oh: लेड एप्रन, थायरॉयड शील्ड और टीएलडी बैज (Lead Aprons & TLD)
e: Diagnostic radiology suites mein occupational scatter radiation hazards mitigate karne ke liye structured Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) mandatory hota hai. Isme 0.25 to 0.5 mm lead-equivalent protective lead aprons, thyroid collars aur lead acrylic mobile shields shamil hain jo secondary scatter photons absorb karte hain. Sath hi Thermo-luminescent Dosimeter (TLD) badges personnel ke quarterly cumulative absorbed doses log karte hain taaki regulatory radiation limits strictly comply ho sakein.

qe: Why must a dark room be 'light-tight'?
qh: एक डार्क रूम 'लाइट-टाइट' (light-tight) क्यों होना चाहिए?
oe: To prevent unwanted ambient exposure and severe fogging of films
oh: कमरे का तापमान बनाए रखने के लिए
फिल्मों को अनचाहे प्रकाश एक्सपोजर और फॉगिंग (Fog) से बचाने के लिए
e: Unprocessed photographic aur radiographic film emulsions optical spectrum ke visible photons ke prati extremely sensitive hoti hain. Agar darkroom processing bench ya pass box ke aas-paas microscopic doors crack, ventilation leaks ya light shafts allow karein, toh raw film unexposed silver grains par unwanted stray exposure ho jayega. Ye complete diagnostic contrast loss, heavy chemical/optical fogging aur completely ruined unreadable radiographs result karega.

qe: What is the standard order of manual film processing?
qh: मैनुअल फिल्म प्रोसेसिंग का मानक क्रम क्या है?
oe: Developing -> Rinsing (Stop Bath) -> Fixing -> Washing -> Drying
oh: डेवलपर -> रिंसिंग (स्टॉप बाथ) -> फिक्सर -> वाशिंग -> ड्राइंग
e: Manual darkroom wet processing ek strict sequential biochemical pathway follow karti hai: Pehle Developer invisible latent image ko metallic silver image mein convert karta hai. Phir Water Rinse (Stop Bath) alkaline developer ko wash out karke reaction halt karta hai aur fixer contamination prevent karta hai. Next, Fixer unexposed crystals ko clear karke gelatin harden karta hai. Fourth step Final Wash residual chemistry cleanse karta hai, aur end mein warm Drying chamber film deliver karta hai.

qe: The 'Intensifying Screen' inside an X-ray cassette is used to:
qh: एक्स-रे कैसेट के अंदर 'इंटेन्सिफाइंग स्क्रीन' का उपयोग किया जाता है:
oe: Significantly reduce patient radiation dose by converting X-rays to visible light
Filter scatter radiation like a grid
oh: एक्स-रे को दृश्य प्रकाश में बदलकर मरीज की विकिरण खुराक काफी कम करना
e: Film emulsion directly less than 1% incident X-ray photons absorb karti hai, jisse direct radiography mein high patient doses ki zaroorat padti hai. X-ray cassette ke andar Intensifying Screens lagi hoti hain jinme Rare Earth Phosphors (jaise Gadolinium Oxysulfide) coat hote hain. Ye phosphors incident X-ray photons ko absorb karke thousands of visible light photons emit karte hain (luminescence). Film predominantly is screen-emitted light se expose hoti hai, jisse required patient radiation dose dramatically reduce ho jaati hai.

qe: Which material is used in the walls of an X-ray room for 'Protection'?
qh: 'सुरक्षा' के लिए एक्स-रे रूम की दीवारों में किस सामग्री का उपयोग किया जाता है?
oe: Lead lining sheet or solid high-density concrete
oh: लेड लाइनिंग (Lead Sheet) या उच्च घनत्व कंक्रीट
e: Diagnostic facilities ke bahar public aur radiation workers ko scatter aur primary radiation leakage se insulate karne ke liye room walls barrier banti hain. High density aur high atomic number ($Z = 82$) ki wajah se Lead sheet lining (typically 1.5 se 2.0 mm thickness) standard structural shielding material hai. Equivalent radiation attenuation dense solid concrete (6 to 7 inches) ya special solid barium plaster brick walls construct karke bhi regulatory safety limits achieve ki jaati hain.

qe: What happens if the 'Developer' temperature is too high?
qh: यदि 'डेवलपर' का तापमान बहुत अधिक हो तो क्या होगा?
oe: Over-development, excessive dark density, and severe chemical fog
oh: प्रोसेसिंग पूरी तरह बंद हो जाना
ओवर-डेवलपमेंट, अत्यधिक कालापन और केमिकल फॉग
e: Developer chemicals ki reducing reactivity direct temperature-dependent rate constant follow karti hai. Recommended operational operating temperature se high degrees reach hone par Hydroquinone hyperactive ho jata hai. Exposed grains rapidly develop hone ke sath-sath chemical reducing agents unexposed silver halide crystals ko bhi randomly break karna start kar dete hain. Isse generalized chemical fogging, excessive dark base density, aur contrast loss ho jata hai, aur high heat emulsion gelatin ko soften karke roller jam create kar sakti hai.

qe: Which rule is fundamental to radiation protection?
qh: विकिरण सुरक्षा के लिए कौन सा नियम मौलिक है?
oh: एलारा सिद्धांत - ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable)
e: ALARA radiation protection philosophy ka core pillar hai, jiska full form 'As Low As Reasonably Achievable' (social aur economic factors consider karte hue) hai. Linear No-Threshold hypothesis accept karte hue ye principle mandate karta hai ki har unnecessary radiation exposure avoid kiya jaye aur medical diagnostics mein imaging parameters optimize kiye jayein. ALARA achieve karne ke primary cardinal principles Time minimize karna, Distance maximize karna aur Shielding employ karna hote hain.

qe: Which radiographic view is most commonly used to visualize the heart and lungs in a stable patient?
qh: स्थिर रोगी में हृदय और फेफड़ों को देखने के लिए आमतौर पर किस रेडियोग्राफिक व्यू का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Chest radiography mein stable ambulant patient ke liye Postero-Anterior (PA) erect projection gold standard selection hai. Isme patient chest cassette plate ke direct contact mein anteriorly touch karta hai aur tube focus 6 feet (72 inches / 180 cm) standard distance par placed rehta hai. Anterior orientation ki wajah se cardiac shadow image receptor ke bohot kareeb hoti hai, jisse magnification minimum rehti hai aur true cardiac size tatha pulmonary fields accurately visualize hote hain.

qe: What is the primary purpose of a 'Barium Swallow' (Ba Swallow)?
qh: 'बेरियम स्वेलो' (Ba Swallow) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
oe: To analyze the large intestine mucosa
To dynamically visualize the anatomy and motility of the esophagus
To evaluate distal terminal ileum loops
oh: ग्रासनली (Esophagus) की संरचना और गतिशीलता का मूल्यांकन करना
e: Barium Swallow (Esophagogram) pharynx aur pure esophagus ka dedicated dynamic fluoroscopic investigation hai. Patient thick barium paste swallow karta hai aur real-time continuous imaging se swallowing mechanism evaluate hoti hai. Procedure dysphagia (swallowing difficulty), esophageal strictures, achalasia cardia motility disorders, hiatus hernia, esophageal varices, foreign bodies aur malignant esophageal neoplasms ko accurately assess karta hai.

qe: Which view is essential to detect 'Pneumoperitoneum' (free air) in a plain abdomen X-ray?
qh: सादे पेट के एक्स-रे में 'न्यूमोपेरिटोनियम' (मुक्त हवा) का पता लगाने के लिए कौन सा व्यू आवश्यक है?
e: Pneumoperitoneum abdominal cavity ke andar free air ki presence hoti hai, jo generally hollow organ perforation (jaise gastric/duodenal ulcer perforation) indicate karti hai. Erect (upright) position mein gravity ke kaaran heavy abdominal viscera downward slide ho jaate hain aur free peritoneal gas buoyant density ke kaaran upper abdomen mein rise karti hai. Ye air dome-shaped diaphragm ke neeche sickle-shaped radiolucent crescent (Free air under diaphragm) ke roop mein clear dikhti hai.

qe: In CVS radiography, why is a 'Lateral View' of the chest taken?
qh: CVS रेडियोग्राफी में, छाती का 'लैटरल व्यू' क्यों लिया जाता है?
oe: To evaluate the retrocardiac space, posterior heart border, and chamber enlargement
Exclusively to detect anterior rib fractures
oh: रेट्रोकार्डियक स्पेस और हृदय कक्षों के विस्तार (Chamber enlargement) का मूल्यांकन करना
e: PA projection chest ki transverse profile show karta hai par antero-posterior depth superimpose ho jaati hai. Lateral chest radiograph cardiac structures ki 3-dimensional understanding complete karta hai. Ye clear view deta hai retrosternal space (right ventricular hypertrophy se obliterate hoti hai) aur retrocardiac space ka (left atrial enlargement ya left ventricular dilation se encroached hoti hai), aur thoracic aortic aneurysms aur posterior mediastinal masses localize karne ke liye mandatory supplementary view hai.

qe: A 'Barium Enema' is used to visualize which part of the digestive system?
qh: 'बेरियम एनीमा' का उपयोग पाचन तंत्र के किस भाग को देखने के लिए किया जाता है?
oh: बड़ी आंत - मलाशय और कोलन (Colon and Rectum)
e: Barium Enema lower gastrointestinal tract ka fluoroscopic contrast examination hota hai. Rectal catheter ke through retrograde route se liquid Barium Sulphate (aur air double contrast technique mein) instill kiya jata hai taaki rectum, sigmoid, descending colon, transverse colon, ascending colon aur caecum fully distend ho sakein. Ye study colorectal carcinomas, polyps, diverticulosis, ulcerative colitis aur Hirschsprung disease evaluate karne ke liye use hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Barium Meal' (Ba Meal) primarily used to study?
qh: 'बेरियम मील' (Ba Meal) का मुख्य रूप से किसके अध्ययन के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
oh: आमाशय, पाइलोरस और ग्रहणी (Stomach and Duodenum)
e: Barium Meal examination specific upper gastrointestinal evaluation hai jisme patient barium suspension drink karta hai. Iska primary objective stomach ke anatomical regions (fundus, body, antrum, pyloric canal) aur duodenum ke initial loops (duodenal bulb aur C-loop) ki mucosal lining aur emptying dynamics visualize karna hai. Ye gastric ulcers, malignancies, hypertrophic pyloric stenosis aur structural anatomical deformations ko diagnose karne ke liye apply hota hai.

qe: Which radiographic sign is often looked for in a chest X-ray of a 'Trauma' patient?
qh: 'ट्रॉमा' (आघात) रोगी के चेस्ट एक्स-रे में अक्सर कौन सा रेडियोग्राफिक संकेत देखा जाता है?
e: Chest blunt ya penetrating trauma ke patients mein priority acute life-threatening emergencies rule out karna hota hai. Urgent signs mein Pneumothorax (jahan pleural cavity mein air leak hone se peripheral lung vascular markings absent hoti hain aur lung collapsed border dikhti hai) aur Hemothorax (pleural space mein blood collect hone se costophrenic angles blunted ho jate hain ya dense opaque hemithorax banta hai) evaluate kiye jaate hain, sath hi underlying rib fractures note kiye jaate hain.

qe: For visualizing a 'Hiatus Hernia', which contrast study is most effective?
qh: 'हायटस हर्निया' को देखने के लिए कौन सा कंट्रास्ट अध्ययन सबसे प्रभावी है?
oh: बेरियम मील - ट्रेंडेलनबर्ग स्थिति के साथ (Ba Meal)
e: Hiatus Hernia mein stomach ka proximal segment (fundus ya gastroesophageal junction) diaphragmatic hiatus ke through chest thoracic cavity mein herniate ho jaata hai. Barium Meal fluoroscopy ke dauran patient ko tilted Trendelenburg position (head down) mein rakha jata hai aur intra-abdominal pressure badhaya jata hai. Barium suspension hernia pouch ko highlight karti hai, jisse sliding aur rolling (paraesophageal) hiatus hernias instantly demarcate ho jaate hain.

qe: Why is the patient asked to 'hold their breath' during a chest X-ray?
qh: चेस्ट एक्स-रे के दौरान मरीज को 'सांस रोकने' के लिए क्यों कहा जाता है?
oe: To achieve maximum lung inspiration and eliminate respiratory motion blur
oh: रोगी को शांत रखने के लिए
अधिकतम फेफड़ों का विस्तार करना और मोशन ब्लर रोकना
e: Chest radiography mein full inspiration hold karana do main physical goals accomplish karta hai: Pehla, deep inspiration diaphragm ko downwards 9th se 10th posterior ribs tak displace karti hai jisse lung parenchyma fully expand hota hai aur basal lung lesions unmask ho jaati hain. Doosra, exposure duration ke waqt patient respiration suspend karne se respiratory kinetic motion blur eliminate ho jata hai, jisse sharp trabecular aur vascular image detail capture hoti hai.

qe: The study of the 'Ileo-caecal junction' is a part of:
qh: 'इलियो-सेकल जंक्शन' का अध्ययन किसका हिस्सा है?
oe: Barium Meal Follow Through (BMFT) and Small Bowel Series
oh: बेरियम मील फॉलो थ्रू (BMFT) और स्मॉल बॉवेल सीरीज
e: Ileocaecal junction wo transition anatomical landmark hai jahan small intestine ka terminal ileum large intestine ke caecum se connect hota hai. Barium Meal Follow Through (BMFT) ya dedicated Barium Enema ke reflux stage par compression spot films lekar is region ko evaluate kiya jata hai. Ye investigation Ileocecal Tuberculosis, Crohn's disease, ileocecal intussusception aur local strictures identify karne ke liye critical diagnostic landmark maani jaati hai.

qe: Which artificial isotope is most commonly used for 'Thyroid' imaging and treatment?
qh: 'थायराइड' इमेजिंग और उपचार के लिए आमतौर पर किस कृत्रिम आइसोटोप का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thyroid follicular cells blood se iodine ko actively concentrate karti hain. Is physiological property ka use karke synthetic radioisotope Iodine-131 (I-131) administer kiya jata hai. I-131 ki physical half-life approximately 8 days hoti hai aur ye beta particles aur gamma photons dono emit karta hai. Gamma rays scintigraphy imaging mein uptake pattern reveal karti hain, jabki energetic destructive beta particles hyperthyroidism (Graves disease) aur differentiated thyroid cancer cells ko targeted destroy karti hain.

qe: What is the physical half-life of 'Technetium-99m' (Tc-99m)?
qh: 'टेक्नेटियम-99m' (Tc-99m) की भौतिक हाफ-लाइफ क्या है?
e: Technetium-99m ($^{99m}	ext{Tc}$) diagnostic nuclear medicine ka most widely used radioisotope hai, jo lagbhag 80% scan protocols mein use hota hai. Iski physical half-life exactly 6 hours hoti hai. Ye duration patient ke preparation aur complete gamma camera acquisition scan ke liye perfectly sufficient hoti hai, jabki scan khatam hote hi patient body se radioactivity rapidly decay ho jaati hai, jisse unneeded residual radiation dose drastically reduce hoti hai.

qe: Which type of radiation emitted by isotopes is best for 'Imaging' from outside the body?
qh: शरीर के बाहर से 'इमेजिंग' के लिए आइसोटोप द्वारा उत्सर्जित कौन सा विकिरण सबसे अच्छा है?
e: Internal diagnostic nuclear imaging mein tracer se aane wali radiation ko patient body se bahar nikal kar external gamma camera ya SPECT detectors tak reach karna hota hai. Alpha aur Beta particulate radiations low penetrating power aur high mass/charge ke kaaran human tissues ke andar hi absorb ho kar severe local tissue ionization damage karti hain. Gamma rays high-energy, zero-charge electromagnetic photons hote hain jo human tissue bina absorb hue penetrate kar lete hain.

qe: In the context of 'Radium', what is its approximate half-life?
qh: 'रेडियम' के संदर्भ में, इसकी अनुमानित हाफ-लाइफ क्या है?
e: Radium-226 ($^{226}	ext{Ra}$) historically Marie aur Pierre Curie dwara discover kiya gaya natural radioisotope hai jo early brachytherapy cancer management mein interstitial needles ke roop mein use hota tha. Radium-226 ki radioactive half-life lagbhag 1600 years hoti hai aur ye decay chain mein hazardous radon gas aur alpha, beta aur high-energy gamma emit karta hai. Itni long life aur containment hazards ki wajah se ab clinical practice mein Radium ko safer short-lived synthetic isotopes se replace kar diya gaya hai.

qe: Which isotope is commonly used in 'Brachytherapy' (cancer treatment)?
qh: 'ब्रेकीथेरेपी' (कैंसर उपचार) में आमतौर पर किस आइसोटोप का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Brachytherapy internal radiation therapy procedure hai jisme encapsulated radioactive sealed sources ko directly malignant tumor mass ke inside ya adjacent placement mein deliver kiya jata hai. High Dose Rate (HDR) brachytherapy mein Iridium-192 ($^{192}	ext{Ir}$, half-life approx 74 days) gold standard isotope hai. Cobalt-60 aur Cesium-137 bhi radiation oncology mein use hote hain. Ye isotopes highly concentrated localized radiation dose deliver karte hain jabki surrounding healthy tissues spare ho jaate hain.

qe: How does 'Artificial Radioactivity' differ from natural radioactivity?
qh: 'कृत्रिम रेडियोधर्मिता' प्राकृतिक रेडियोधर्मिता से किस प्रकार भिन्न है?
oe: It is physically weaker than all baseline soils
It is induced artificially by human bombardment of stable nuclei in reactors/cyclotrons
oh: यह परमाणु रिएक्टरों/साइक्लोट्रॉन में स्थिर नाभिकों पर बमबारी करके बनाई जाती है
e: Natural radioactivity un unstable heavy elements (jaise Uranium, Thorium, Radium) ki spontaneous breakdown hoti hai jo naturally earth crust mein exist karte hain. Artificial (Induced) Radioactivity tab create hoti hai jab nuclear reactors ya cyclotrons ke andar stable atomic nuclei ko thermal neutrons, high-energy protons ya alpha particles se bombard kiya jata hai. Is artificial transmutation se unstable radioisotopes (jaise Tc-99m, I-131, F-18) bante hain jo medical diagnostics aur radiotherapy ke main pillars hain.

qe: Which particle is emitted when a radioactive element undergoes 'Alpha Decay'?
qh: जब कोई रेडियोधर्मी तत्व 'अल्फा क्षय' से गुजरता है तो कौन सा कण उत्सर्जित होता है?
e: Alpha decay ek radioactive decay process hai jisme unstable heavy nucleus spontaneous instability release karne ke liye Alpha particle ($\alpha$) eject karta hai. Ek alpha particle physically Helium-4 atom ka nucleus ($^4_2	ext{He}^{2+}$) hota hai, jisme do protons aur do neutrons tightly bound hote hain (mass number 4, charge +2). Alpha emission ke baad parent nucleus ka atomic number 2 units kam ho jata hai aur mass number 4 units drop ho jata hai.

qe: What is the primary role of 'Filters' in a radioactive isotope container?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी आइसोटोप कंटेनर में 'फिल्टर' की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
oe: To selectively absorb unwanted soft low-energy radiations and optimize beam profile
To add kinetic energy to photons
oh: अवांछित कम ऊर्जा वाले विकिरण को अवशोषित करना (Beam filtration)
e: Radioactive source capsules aur beam applicators mein metal filters (jaise Aluminium, Copper ya Lead sheets) place kiye jaate hain. Ye filters low-energy 'soft' photons aur secondary beta particulate radiation ko selectively absorb kar lete hain, jo diagnostic imaging ya target therapy mein contribute kiye bina patient skin par superficial non-penetrating absorbed dose badhate hain. Filtration beam ko harden karke safe, uniform aur clinically effective radiation spectrum guarantee karti hai.

qe: The 'Inverse Square Law' in radiation states that intensity:
qh: विकिरण में 'व्युत्क्रम वर्ग नियम' (Inverse Square Law) कहता है कि तीव्रता:
oe: Decreases as the square of the distance
Stays the same regardless of distance
oh: दूरी के वर्ग के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती कम होती है
दूरी के बावजूद समान रहती है
दूरी के साथ रैखिक रूप से बढ़ती है
दूरी के सीधे आनुपातिक कम होती है
e: Radiation physics mein Inverse Square Law ($I \propto 1/d^2$) ek fundamental radiation safety principle hai jo spherical divergence par based hota hai. Jab point source se X-ray ya gamma photons propagate karte hain, toh distance double karne par beam ka radiation area 4 guna spread ho jata hai, jisse per unit area beam intensity gir kar original value ki one-fourth (1/4) reh jaati hai. Distance triple karne par intensity 1/9 ho jati hai. Isi principle ke chalte radiology staff ke liye source se separation distance increase karna personal occupational radiation dose minimize karne ka sabse fast aur effective method banta hai.

qe: Which artificial isotope is used in 'PET scans'?
qh: 'PET स्कैन' में किस कृत्रिम आइसोटोप का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) scanning mein Fluorine-18 ($^{18}\text{F}$) primary cyclotron-produced artificial radionuclide hai. Iski ideal half-life approximately 110 minutes hoti hai. Clinically ise 2-deoxy-D-glucose ke sath synthesize karke Fluorodeoxyglucose (18F-FDG) radiotracer banaya jata hai. Cancerous tumor cells normal cells ke comparison mein significantly zyada glucose metabolize karti hain, jisse FDG wahan accumulate hota hai. $^{18}\text{F}$ se emit hone wala positron tissue electron ke sath annihilate hokar opposite direction mein do 511 keV gamma photons release karta hai, jinhe external coincidence detectors accurately locate karte hain.

qe: Which effect is primarily responsible for producing 'Contrast' in a diagnostic X-ray image?
qh: डायग्नोस्टिक एक्स-रे इमेज में 'कंट्रास्ट' पैदा करने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा प्रभाव जिम्मेदार है?
e: Diagnostic radiology mein high image contrast achieve karne ka primary driver Photoelectric Absorption hota hai. Is interaction mein incident X-ray photon atom ke inner-shell electron ko completely displace karke apni total energy transfer kar deta hai aur khud fully absorb ho jata hai. Photoelectric probability tissue ke atomic number ke cube ($Z^3$) ke directly proportional hoti hai. High-Z bone dense absorption create karti hai aur radiograph par sharp radiopaque white dikhti hai, jabki low-Z soft tissue se photons easily transmit hokar blackening karte hain, jo clear subject contrast create karta hai.

qe: What happens during 'Compton Scattering' in radiography?
qh: रेडियोग्राफी में 'कॉम्पटन प्रकीर्णन' (Compton Scattering) के दौरान क्या होता है?
oe: Photon is deflected with reduced energy and an outer-shell electron is ejected
oh: कोई परमाणु परस्पर क्रिया नहीं होती
घटना फोटॉन का पूर्ण अवशोषण होता है
फोटॉन कम ऊर्जा के साथ विक्षेपित होता है और बाहरी शेल इलेक्ट्रॉन बाहर निकलता है
e: Compton Scattering diagnostic imaging ranges mein dominant interaction hoti hai jisme medium-energy X-ray photon target atom ke outer-shell loosely bound valence electron se strike karta hai. Collision ke dauran incident photon apni energy ka kuch fraction electron ko dekar use Compton recoil electron ke roop mein eject kar deta hai, jabki bacha hua photon lower energy aur altered angular trajectory ke sath deflect ho jata hai. Ye scattered photons image receptor par arbitrary directions se striking karke destructive gray fog create karte hain aur image contrast ko severely degrade karte hain.

qe: The 'Continuous X-ray Spectrum' is produced by which process?
qh: 'सतत एक्स-रे स्पेक्ट्रम' (Continuous X-ray Spectrum) किस प्रक्रिया द्वारा निर्मित होता है?
e: Continuous X-ray Spectrum Bremsstrahlung (Braking Radiation) process se generate hota hai, jo standard X-ray tube emission ka roughly 80 se 90 percent part represent karta hai. Jab cathode se accelerated fast-moving projectile electrons heavy tungsten target nuclei ke powerful positive electrostatic field ke paas se guzarte hain, toh nucleus ka positive pull unhe sharply decelerate aur deflect kar deta hai. Electron ki kinetic energy ka ye sudden loss electromagnetic radiation photons ke roop mein release hota hai, jisse zero se lekar peak kVp energy tak continuous spectrum form hota hai.

qe: At what energy level does 'Pair Production' typically occur?
qh: 'पेयर प्रोडक्शन' आमतौर पर किस ऊर्जा स्तर पर होता है?
e: Pair Production ek high-energy electromagnetic interaction hai jo Einstein ke mass-energy equivalence ($E = mc^2$) rule par operate karti hai. Is interaction mein photon target nucleus ke strong nuclear electromagnetic field mein enter karke completely disappear ho jata hai aur ek electron tatha ek positron pair mein materialize hota hai. Chunki ek electron aur positron dono ka rest mass energy equivalent 0.511 MeV hota hai, is process ke occur hone ke liye incident photon ki threshold energy minimum 1.02 MeV honi mandatory hai, isliye ye diagnostic X-rays mein impossible hai aur radiation therapy mein dikhta hai.

qe: Which type of X-ray spectrum consists of 'discrete' energy peaks?
qh: किस प्रकार के एक्स-रे स्पेक्ट्रम में 'असतत' (discrete) ऊर्जा शिखर होते हैं?
e: Characteristic X-ray Spectrum continuous smooth distribution ke bajaye sharp, discrete, narrow energy peaks ke roop mein register hota hai. Ye tab generate hota hai jab high-velocity incident electron target atom ke innermost K-shell electron ko knock out karke ionize kar deta hai. Us vacant inner orbital space ko fill karne ke liye outer shells (jaise L ya M shell) se electron downward jump karta hai. Dono electron orbits ke precise quantum binding energy difference ke equal discrete energy photon release hota hai, jo target element material ki exact chemical identity represent karta hai.

qe: The probability of the 'Photoelectric Effect' increases as the:
qh: 'फोटोइलेक्ट्रिक प्रभाव' की संभावना बढ़ जाती है जैसे ही:
oe: Atomic number (Z) of the material increases
oh: सामग्री की परमाणु संख्या (Z) बढ़ती है
e: Photoelectric absorption probability tissue ke atomic number ke cube ($Z^3$) ke directly proportional aur incident photon beam energy ke cube ($E^3$) ke inversely proportional hoti hai ($P \propto Z^3 / E^3$). Is mathematical dependency ki wajah se high atomic number wale structures jaise bone ($Z \approx 13.8$) ya administered iodinated/barium contrast agents soft tissue ($Z \approx 7.4$) ke comparison mein significantly zyada photoelectric interactions undergo karte hain. Yahi differential absorption medical radiographs par high subject contrast aur clear anatomical boundaries ensure karta hai.

qe: What is 'Attenuated' radiation?
qh: 'अटेंयूएटेड' (Attenuated) विकिरण क्या है?
oe: Reduction in beam intensity due to absorption and scattering in matter
Energy gained by photons through interaction
Unmodified primary beam emerging from tube port
oh: पदार्थ में अवशोषण और प्रकीर्णन के कारण बीम की तीव्रता में कमी
कृत्रिम रूप से केंद्रित दृश्य प्रकाश
परस्पर क्रिया द्वारा फोटॉनों द्वारा प्राप्त ऊर्जा
ट्यूब पोर्ट से निकलने वाली अपरिवर्तित प्राथमिक बीम
e: Attenuation ka matlab primary X-ray beam ke number of photons ya total energy intensity mein hone wali overall progressive reduction hai jab beam kisi physical matter (patient tissue) se traverse karti hai. Ye total attenuation do primary physical processes ka sum hota hai: Photoelectric Absorption (jisme photons completely absorb hokar energy lose kar dete hain) aur Compton Scattering (jisme photons out-of-path deflect hokar useful beam se deviate ho jaate hain). Attenuation rate tissue density, atomic number aur radiation beam quality par depend karta hai.

qe: Which interaction is the main source of 'Occupational Dose' to the X-ray technician?
qh: एक्स-रे तकनीशियन के 'व्यावसायिक जोखिम' (dose) का मुख्य स्रोत कौन सी परस्पर क्रिया है?
e: Radiology rooms mein technicians aur interventional radiologists ke liye scatter radiation occupational exposure ka primary contributor hoti hai. Diagnostic kVp ranges (70 se 120 kVp) par jab primary X-ray beam patient ki body se interact karti hai, toh body tissues massive scattering medium ki tarah act karte hain aur Compton scattering ke zariye scattered photons har angle par deflect hote hain. Is patient-generated secondary scatter radiation se shield karne ke liye protective lead aprons, thyroid shields, mobile lead barriers aur 2-meter safety distance protocol follow kiya jata hai.

qe: The 'Average' energy of an X-ray beam is approximately what fraction of the peak (kVp)?
qh: एक एक्स-रे बीम की 'औसत' ऊर्जा पीक (kVp) का लगभग कितना हिस्सा होती है?
oe: One-third to one-half (1/3 to 1/2) of peak
e: X-ray tube polyenergetic ya heterogeneous beam produce karti hai, jisme maximum energy control console par set kiye gaye peak kilovoltage (kVp) ke barabar hoti hai. Lekin Bremsstrahlung deceleration collisions multiple energy ranges mein distribute hote hain aur filtration soft rays remove karti hai, jisse spectrum ka peak curve left-skewed banta hai. Is continuous spectrum profile ki wajah se emitted beam ki effective ya average photon energy set kVp value ki lagbhag one-third (30% to 40%) hoti hai (e.g., 90 kVp beam ki effective energy approx 30-35 keV hoti hai).

qe: Why is 'Filtration' used to change the X-ray spectrum?
qh: एक्स-रे स्पेक्ट्रम को बदलने के लिए 'निस्पंदन' (Filtration) का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
oe: To selectively absorb non-penetrating low-energy photons (Beam Hardening)
To add low-energy soft rays for surface exposure
To alter visual spectrum luminescence color
To thermally cool the rotating target anode
oh: कम ऊर्जा वाले फोटॉनों को चुनिंदा रूप से हटाना / बीम हार्डनिंग (Hardening)
सतह एक्सपोजर के लिए नरम किरणें जोड़ना
घूर्णन लक्ष्य एनोड को ठंडा करना
e: Tube port se nikli raw X-ray beam mein wide band of low-energy 'soft' X-ray photons hote hain jinme patient body penetrate karke detector tak reach karne ki sufficient energy nahi hoti. Agar filtration na lagayi jaye, toh ye soft photons superficial skin layers mein hi absorb hokar unnecessary patient radiation dose badhate hain. Beam port par Aluminium filtration sheets lagane se ye low-energy photons selectively absorb ho jate hain, jisse overall beam hardened ho jaati hai aur mean beam energy improve hoti hai.

qe: If a radioactive source has a half-life of 6 hours, how much activity remains after 12 hours?
qh: यदि रेडियोधर्मी स्रोत की हाफ-लाइफ 6 घंटे है, तो 12 घंटे बाद कितनी गतिविधि बचेगी?
e: Radioactive decay exponential decay law ($A_t = A_0 \times (1/2)^n$) follow karta hai, jahan $n$ elapsed half-lives ka count hai. Is scenario mein total time 12 hours hai aur half-life ($T_{1/2}$) 6 hours hai, jisse total number of half-lives $n = 12 / 6 = 2$ calculate hoti hain. Pehle 6 hours (1 half-life) ke baad original activity decay hokar 50% bachegi. Agle 6 hours (2nd half-life) ke baad bachi hui 50% activity half hokar 25% (yaani initial activity ka one-fourth, 1/4) reh jayegi.

qe: Which unit is used to measure 'Radioactivity' (disintegrations per second)?
qh: 'रेडियोधर्मिता' को मापने के लिए किस इकाई का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: International System of Units (SI) ke under Radioactivity measurement ki standard unit Becquerel (Bq) hai. Ek Becquerel ko mathematically exactly one spontaneous nuclear transformation (disintegration) per second define kiya gaya hai ($1 \text{ Bq} = 1 \text{ dps}$). Iski traditional historical unit Curie (Ci) hai, jo Radium-226 ke 1 gram ke radioactive decay rate par based thi aur $1 \text{ Ci} = 3.7 \times 10^{10} \text{ Bq}$ ke barabar hoti hai. Radiation diagnostic doses measure karne ke liye megabecquerels (MBq) commonly express kiya jata hai.

qe: The 'Radium series' ends when it decays into which stable element?
qh: 'रेडियम श्रृंखला' किस स्थिर तत्व में क्षय होने पर समाप्त होती है?
e: Radium-226 natural Uranium-Radium decay series ($4n+2$ series) ka critical intermediate daughter isotope hai. Unstable heavy nuclei spontaneous balance achieve karne ke liye continuous alpha aur beta emissions undergo karte hain. Radium decays radon gas, polonium, bismuth aur thallium radioisotopes se propagate karte hue ultimate stage par stable, non-radioactive Lead isotope, Lead-206 ($^{206}\text{Pb}$) banta hai. Yahan nuclear binding energy stable state reach karti hai aur cascade radioactivity permanently terminate ho jaati hai.

qe: What are 'Alpha particles' composed of?
qh: 'अल्फा कण' (Alpha particles) किससे बने होते हैं?
e: Alpha particles particulate ionizing radiation hote hain jo unstable super-heavy atomic nuclei (jaise Uranium, Radium, Americium) ke alpha decay ke dauran eject hote hain. Structurally ek alpha particle completely ionized Helium-4 atom ka nucleus ($^4_2\text{He}^{2+}$) hota hai, jisme 2 protons aur 2 neutrons nuclear force se tightly locked hote hain. Iska net electric charge $+2e$ aur mass number 4 atomic mass units hota hai. Heavy mass aur double positive charge ki wajah se iska Linear Energy Transfer (LET) extremely high hota hai.

qe: What is the charge of a 'Gamma ray'?
qh: 'गामा किरण' (Gamma ray) का आवेश क्या है?
e: Gamma rays charged subatomic particles na hokar high-frequency, extremely short-wavelength electromagnetic radiation photons hote hain jo excited atomic nuclei ke nuclear de-excitation transitions se emit hote hain. Kyunki ye pure electromagnetic energy packets (photons) hain, inka rest mass zero hota hai aur electric charge completely neutral (zero) hota hai. Net charge na hone ke kaaran gamma rays electric ya magnetic fields se deflect nahi hoti hain aur deeply human biological tissue penetrate kar leti hain.

qe: Artificial isotopes like 'Technetium-99m' are used in imaging because:
qh: इमेजिंग में 'टेक्नेटियम-99m' जैसे कृत्रिम आइसोटोप का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि:
oe: They have an ideal short half-life and emit pure gamma without particulate damage
They are extremely heavy metals that precipitate in bone
oh: उनकी छोटी हाफ-लाइफ होती है और वे बिना कण क्षति के शुद्ध गामा उत्सर्जित करते हैं
वे सस्ते और हमेशा के लिए बने रहते हैं
वे उच्च ऊर्जा अल्फा कण उत्सर्जित करते हैं
e: Technetium-99m ($^{99m}\text{Tc}$) nuclear medicine imaging ke liye globally preferred radiopharmaceutical isotope hai. Iska metastable isomeric state lagbhag 6 hours ki short half-life ke sath decay hota hai, jo patient examination aur imaging ke liye perfect duration deta hai bina residual internal dose generate kiye. Sabse important feature ye hai ki ye bina kisi damaging particulate radiation (alpha ya beta) ke lagbhag 140 keV energy ka single isometric gamma photon emit karta hai, jo standard gamma cameras dwara crystal detection ke liye ideal mana jata hai.

qe: The process where an unstable nucleus loses energy by emitting radiation is:
qh: वह प्रक्रिया जिसमें एक अस्थिर नाभिक विकिरण उत्सर्जित करके ऊर्जा खो देता है:
e: Radioactive Decay ek spontaneous nuclear physics phenomenon hai jisme unstable parent nucleus apne unfavorable neutron-to-proton ratio ($N/Z$) ya excess nuclear energy level ko balance karne ke liye spontaneously particles ya electromagnetic energy emit karta hai. Is nuclear transformation process mein alpha particles, beta particles ya gamma ray photons release hote hain, jisse parent nucleus gradually lower-energy ground state stable daughter nucleus mein transform ho jata hai. Ye process external temperature, pressure ya chemical state se completely independent hota hai.

qe: Which type of decay occurs when a neutron turns into a proton and emits an electron?
qh: जब न्यूट्रॉन प्रोटॉन में बदल जाता है और इलेक्ट्रॉन उत्सर्जित करता है, तो कौन सा क्षय होता है?
e:
Beta-minus ($ eta^-$) decay tab trigger hota hai jab kisi radioactive nucleus ke andar neutrons ki excess quantity (high $N/Z$ ratio) hoti hai. Stability achieve karne ke liye weak nuclear interaction force ek intranuclear neutron ko proton mein convert kar deta hai: $n 	o p + e^- +  ar{
u}_e$. Is conversion se ek high-speed nuclear relativistic electron (beta particle) aur ek electron antineutrino nucleus se eject ho jaate hain. Resulting daughter nucleus ka atomic number ($Z$) 1 unit increase ho jata hai jabki mass number ($A$) unchanged rehta hai.

qe: The 'Lead container' used for radium storage is an example of:
qh: रेडियम भंडारण के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला 'सीसा कंटेनर' किसका उदाहरण है?
e: Radiation protection ke teen primary cardinal principles Time, Distance aur Shielding hote hain. Radium-226 aur uske daughter decay products high-energy gamma rays aur alpha/beta radiations emit karte hain jo surrounding biological tissues ke liye severe hazard create karte hain. Lead ($Pb$) ka high atomic number ($Z = 82$) aur dense physical compactness Photoelectric absorption aur Compton scatter attenuation produce karti hai. Radium storage ke liye use hone wale thick lead containers barrier shield bankar external gamma exposure ko regulatory permissible limits tak drop kar dete hain.

qe: Radioactive 'Tracers' in imaging help to study:
qh: इमेजिंग में रेडियोधर्मी 'ट्रेसर' किसके अध्ययन में मदद करते हैं?
oe: Organ physiological function, blood perfusion, and cellular metabolism
oh: अंग क्रिया, रक्त परिसंचरण और कोशिकीय चयापचय (Function & Metabolism)
e: Conventional radiography aur CT scanning primarily structural anatomy aur macroscopic morphology show karte hain, jabki Nuclear Medicine tracers functional pathophysiology reveal karte hain. Jab carrier biomolecules (jaise glucose analogues ya phosphonates) ko radioisotope ke sath tag karke patient body mein inject kiya jata hai, toh tracer specific metabolic biochemical pathways trace karta hai. Is gamma emission tracking se organ functional perfusion, cellular metabolic turnover rate, thyroid uptake activity aur early malignant metastases structural deformities appear hone se pehle hi detect ho jaati hain.

qe: Why is 'Copper' used in the anode body along with the Tungsten target?
qh: टंगस्टन टारगेट के साथ एनोड बॉडी में 'कॉपर' का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
oe: To rapidly conduct and dissipate excessive thermal heat
To artificially boost electron acceleration speed
To filter secondary leakage rays internally
To directly produce primary diagnostic X-rays
oh: अत्यधिक ऊष्मा को तेजी से संचालित और नष्ट करने के लिए (Heat Dissipation)
किरणों को आंतरिक रूप से छानने के लिए
एक्स-रे का उत्पादन करने के लिए
e: Standard X-ray tubes mein target collision par kinetic energy ka 99% se zyada fraction thermal heat mein transform hota hai aur 1% se kam energy actual X-rays banti hai. Tungsten focal track par extreme temperature generate hota hai jo melting damage cause kar sakta hai. Tungsten disc ko solid copper anode block mein seat kiya jata hai kyunki Copper ek exceptional thermal conductor ($k \approx 400 \text{ W/m}\cdot\text{K}$) hota hai. Copper heat ko tungsten focal track se rapidly absorb karke surrounding cooling oil bath aur tube housing ki taraf dissipate kar deta hai.

qe: The 'Line Focus Principle' is used in X-ray tubes to:
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब में 'लाइन फोकस सिद्धांत' का उपयोग किया जाता है:
oe: Reduce the effective focal spot size while maintaining a large actual focal spot
oh: प्रभावी फोकल स्पॉट का आकार कम करना (Reduce effective focal spot size)
e: Line Focus Principle anodal target face ko 7 se 17 degrees ke angle par bevel karke operate karta hai. Tube electron beam jis physical target area ko strike karti hai use 'Actual Focal Spot' kehte hain, jise heat loading tolerate karne ke liye intentionally large banaya jata hai. Lekin beveled target angle ki wajah se patient aur detector ke perspective se downward project hone wala 'Effective Focal Spot' geometric projection ke kaaran significantly small dikhta hai ($EFS = AFS \times \sin\theta$). Ye configuration tube overloading prevent karte hue superior optical sharpness aur detail provide karti hai.

qe: What is the relationship between X-ray wavelength and frequency?
qh: एक्स-रे तरंग दैर्ध्य (wavelength) और आवृत्ति (frequency) के बीच क्या संबंध है?
oe: They are inversely proportional to each other
They are directly proportional to each other
oh: वे एक दूसरे के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होते हैं (Inversely proportional)
e:
Electromagnetic wave propagation equation ke according wave speed constant rehti hai: $c = \lambda \times 
u$ (jahan $c$ speed of light hai, $\lambda$ wavelength hai, aur $
u$ frequency hai). Speed fixed hone ki wajah se wavelength aur frequency ek dusre ke perfectly inversely proportional hote hain. Iska matlab hai ki frequency jitni high hogi, wavelength utni hi short compressed hogi. Quantum physics ke mutabiq ($E = h
u = hc/\lambda$), shorter wavelength aur higher frequency directly high-energy hard X-rays aur deeper tissue penetration represent karte hain.

qe: Which interaction produces 'Characteristic Radiation' in the X-ray tube?
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब में कौन सी परस्पर क्रिया 'विशिष्ट विकिरण' (Characteristic Radiation) उत्पन्न करती है?
oe: Inner-shell (K-shell) electron ionization and subsequent cascade transition
oh: आंतरिक शेल (K-shell) आयनीकरण और इलेक्ट्रॉन संक्रमण
e: Characteristic X-rays tab originate hoti hain jab tube ka fast incident electron target atom ke innermost K-shell electron ko strike karta hai aur use target atom se eject kar deta hai. Is ionization ke hone ke liye incident electron ki kinetic energy K-shell binding energy (tungsten ke liye 69.5 keV) se zyada honi compulsory hai. Vacant orbital spot ko fill karne ke liye outer L ya M shell ka electron drop hota hai. Dono shells ke energy level difference ke barabar specific discrete energy photon release hota hai, jo target element ki characteristic identity hota hai.

qe: What is 'Bremsstrahlung' radiation?
qh: 'ब्रेम्सस्ट्रालुंग' (Bremsstrahlung) विकिरण क्या है?
oe: Braking radiation produced by projectile electron deceleration
oh: ब्रेकिंग रेडिएशन - इलेक्ट्रॉन मंदन द्वारा निर्मित (Braking radiation)
e: Bremsstrahlung German language ka technical term hai jiska exact translation 'Braking Radiation' hota hai. X-ray production tube mein jab high-speed negatively charged cathode electron target ke positive tungsten nucleus ke powerful nuclear field ke kareeb se pass hota hai, positive electrostatic attraction electron ko deflect aur decelerate (brake) kar deti hai.
