Is deceleration force ki wajah se projectile electron apni kinetic energy lose karta hai, aur lost energy instant electromagnetic X-ray photon ke roop mein release hoti hai, jo continuous X-ray spectrum create karti hai.

qe: How does increasing 'mA' (milliamperage) affect the X-ray beam?
qh: 'mA' बढ़ाने से एक्स-रे बीम पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
oe: Increases the quantity (intensity) of X-ray photons produced
Shifts the minimum cut-off wavelength leftward
oh: उत्पादित एक्स-रे की मात्रा / तीव्रता बढ़ाता है (Beam Quantity)
एक्स-रे की मर्मज्ञ गुणवत्ता (Quality) बढ़ाता है
e: Tube current (mA) direct measure hota hai un electrons ke quantity flow ka jo filament cathode se anodal target ki taraf travel karte hain. Console par mA settings increase karne se filament circuit ka step-down heating current badh jata hai, jisse thermionic emission ke zariye filament wire se significantly zyada electrons boil off hote hain. Target se collide hone wale electrons ki density badhne se release hone wale overall X-ray photons ka number (beam quantity/intensity) proportionally badhta hai, jabki individual photons ki energy quality aur penetration unvaried rehti hai.

qe: The 'Actual Focal Spot' is located on the:
qh: 'एक्चुअल फोकल स्पॉट' कहाँ स्थित होता है?
oh: एनोड टारगेट ट्रैक की सतह पर (Anode target)
e: Actual Focal Spot target track anodal surface ka wo precise physical area hota hai jahan cathode filament se accelerated electrons ka beam stream actual impact karta hai. Ye spot physical collision aur kinetic interaction ka zone hota hai jahan 99% heat aur 1% primary diagnostic X-rays produce hoti hain. Is physical spot ki dimensions filament wire ki physical length, width aur nickel focusing cup ke electrostatic geometry design se govern hoti hain. Large actual spot focal track par localized heat damage avoid karne mein assist karta hai.

qe: Which component of the X-ray tube is negatively charged?
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब का कौन सा घटक नकारात्मक रूप से आवेशित होता है?
oh: कैथोड असेंबली - फिलामेंट और फोकसिंग कप (Cathode)
e: X-ray tube ek high-vacuum diode assembly hoti hai jisme Cathode negatively charged electrical terminal hota hai. Is assembly mein coiled tungsten filament wires aur ek surrounding metallic molybdenum/nickel Focusing Cup shamil hota hai. High voltage generator operation ke dauran cathode assembly ko high negative electrical potential par maintain karta hai. Negative charge filament se nikle thermal electrons ko electrostatic repulsion ke zariye condense narrow stream mein accelerate karta hai taaki wo opposing positive anode target par focused beam ban kar strike karein.

qe: The process of removing low-energy X-ray photons is called:
qh: कम ऊर्जा वाले एक्स-रे फोटॉनों को हटाने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है:
e: Filtration X-ray collimator port par metallic absorbing materials (primarily Aluminium equivalents) place karne ki process hoti hai. Raw X-ray emission mein broad low-energy soft rays hoti hain jinme anatomical tissue traverse karne ki energy nahi hoti aur wo surface skin dose badhane ka kaam karti hain. Filtration sheet in useless soft wavelengths ko selectively absorb karke filter out kar deti hai. Is phenomenon ko 'Beam Hardening' kehte hain, jisse mean beam energy increase hoti hai, beam penetration improve hoti hai aur unnecessary patient dosage minimize hoti hai.

qe: What percentage of electron energy is converted to X-rays in a standard tube?
qh: एक मानक ट्यूब में इलेक्ट्रॉन ऊर्जा का कितना प्रतिशत एक्स-रे में परिवर्तित होता है?
e: Diagnostic radiology tube operation extremely inefficient energy conversion process par run hota hai. Cathode se accelerate hone wale thermal electrons jab heavy tungsten target par strike karte hain, toh 99% se zyada kinetic energy outer-shell target atomic interactions aur vibrational atomic excitations ke zariye pure thermal heat mein convert ho jaati hai. Less than 1% kinetic electron energy actual Bremsstrahlung ya characteristic X-ray photons emit karti hai. Is massive heat generation ki wajah se rotating anodes, copper housings aur circulating oil systems lagaye jaate hain.

qe: What is 'Half-life' in radioactivity?
qh: रेडियोधर्मिता में 'हाफ-लाइफ' (Half-life) क्या है?
oe: Total decay lifespan of an unstable mass
Time taken for half of the radioactive atoms in a sample to disintegrate
Time required to double initial atomic mass
Operational duration of radiation detector counters
oh: किसी नमूने के आधे रेडियोधर्मी परमाणुओं के क्षय होने में लगा समय (Half-life)
e: Radioactive Half-life ($T_{1/2}$) wo precise statistical time period define karti hai jisme kisi radioactive sample ki initial activity ya uske unstable radioactive nuclei ka population count decay process ke through exactly half (50%) reh jaata hai. Ye physical property har isotope ki characteristic identity hoti hai ($T_{1/2} = \ln(2)/\lambda \approx 0.693/\lambda$) aur ye external temperature, pressure ya chemical state se bilkul affect nahi hoti. Medicine mein short half-life radioisotopes radiation dose reduce karne ke liye select kiye jaate hain.

qe: Unstable atoms that undergo spontaneous decay are called:
qh: स्वतः क्षय होने वाले अस्थिर परमाणुओं को कहा जाता है:
e: Radioactive isotopes (Radionuclides ya radioisotopes) wo atoms hote hain jinka nuclear configuration binding energy balance satisfy nahi karta, aksar unke nucleus mein neutrons aur protons ka ratio ($N/Z$) unstable hota hai ya nucleus excess energy state mein hota hai. Stability regain karne ke liye ye nuclei continuous spontaneous radioactive decay process undergo karte hain, jisme wo ionizing subatomic particles (alpha, beta) ya high-energy gamma ray photons emit karte hain jab tak wo completely stable elemental state reach na kar lein.

qe: Which series describes the natural decay of Radium?
qh: कौन सी श्रृंखला रेडियम के प्राकृतिक क्षय का वर्णन करती है?
oh: रेडियम श्रृंखला / यूरेनियम श्रृंखला - Radium series (Uranium decay series)
e: Radium-226 natural Uranium decay chain ($4n+2$ series) ka intermediate daughter product hota hai jise historical radiology literature mein 'Radium Series' kehte hain. Ye series primordial parent isotope Uranium-238 se originate hoti hai aur Uranium-234 tatha Thorium-230 se transmutate hokar Radium-226 banati hai. Aage chalkar Radium alpha decay se gaseous Radon-222 aur polonium, lead, bismuth radioisotopes mein disintegrate hota hai, aur end mein completely non-radioactive stable Lead-206 ($^{206}\text{Pb}$) par decay cycle conclude hota hai.

qe: What are 'Isotopes' used for in medical imaging?
qh: मेडिकल इमेजिंग में 'आइसोटोप' (Isotopes) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
oe: Radioactive tracers for functional and metabolic organ evaluation
oh: मशीन को ठंडा करने के लिए
कार्यात्मक और चयापचय मूल्यांकन के लिए रेडियोधर्मी ट्रेसर के रूप में (Radioactive tracers)
e: Diagnostic Nuclear Medicine imaging mein specific artificial radioisotopes ko biologically active carrier pharmaceutical molecules ke sath bind kiya jata hai, jinhe Radiopharmaceuticals ya Radio-tracers kehte hain. Patient body mein introduce karne ke baad ye tracers internal biochemical physiological pathways follow karte hain (jaise bone osteoblastic activity mein Tc-99m MDP ya myocardial perfusion mein Tc-99m Sestamibi). Internal gamma emissions ko external Gamma camera ya SPECT scanners detect karte hain, jisse organ physiology aur functional metabolism ka detailed dynamic display milta hai.

qe: The definition of 'Artificial Radioactivity' is:
qh: 'कृत्रिम रेडियोधर्मिता' (Artificial Radioactivity) की परिभाषा है:
oe: Radioactivity induced in stable elements by artificial nuclear particle bombardment
oh: स्थिर तत्वों पर कणों की बमबारी द्वारा प्रेरित रेडियोधर्मिता (Induced Radioactivity)
e: Artificial ya Induced Radioactivity wo process hai jise human intervention dwara nuclear reactors ya cyclotrons ke andar generate kiya jata hai. Is technique mein naturally stable non-radioactive elemental nuclei ko energetic thermal neutrons, accelerated protons ya alpha particles se bombard kiya jata hai. Is artificial nuclear transmutation interaction se atomic nucleus unstable nuclear balance acquire kar leta hai, jisse radioactive behavior trigger hota hai. Diagnostic isotopes jaise Technetium-99m, Fluorine-18 aur Iodine-131 isi artificial reaction pathway se manufacture kiye jaate hain.

qe: Which type of 'Radioactive radiation' has the highest penetrating power?
qh: किस प्रकार के 'रेडियोधर्मी विकिरण' में सबसे अधिक मर्मज्ञ शक्ति होती है?
e: Particulate radiations ke comparison mein Gamma rays ki penetrating power maximum hoti hai. Alpha particles heavy mass aur double positive charge hone ki wajah se extremely high ionization rate rakhte hain aur paper sheet ya superficial skin layer dwara absorb ho jaate hain. Beta particles plastic ya thin aluminum plate se stop ho jaate hain. Gamma rays massless, neutral electromagnetic photons hote hain jo matter se minimal collision interaction undergo karte hain, jisse inki penetration range wide hoti hai aur inhe attenuate karne ke liye thick lead lining ya dense concrete barriers required hote hain.

qe: In radiology, 'Radio Dosage' management includes the use of:
qh: रेडियोलॉजी में 'रेडियो डोज' प्रबंधन में किसका उपयोग शामिल है?
oe: Collimation filtration and radiation shielded containers
oh: निस्पंदन, कोलिमेशन और परिरक्षित कंटेनर (Filtration and Shielded Containers)
e: Radioactive dosage management ka primary objective occupational radiation workers aur patients ko unnecessary ionizing radiation exposure se protect karna hai. Isme X-ray beam filtration employ ki jaati hai taaki harmful non-penetrating soft rays eliminate ho sakein, precise beam collimation use hoti hai taaki field of view anatomically restricted rahe, aur radiopharmaceuticals ko transport aur house karne ke liye heavy lead-shielded syringe shields aur decay containers employ kiye jaate hain, jo ALARA regulatory dose boundaries ensure karte hain.

qe: What is the primary risk of handling 'Unstable atoms'?
qh: 'अस्थिर परमाणुओं' को संभालने का प्राथमिक जोखिम क्या है?
oe: Biological damage from ionizing radiation exposure
oh: आयनकारी विकिरण से जैविक क्षति (Biological damage from ionizing radiation)
e: Unstable radioactive atoms spontaneously ionizing radiations (alpha, beta, gamma) emit karte hain jo biological tissue damage ka severe hazard present karti hain. Jab ionizing photons ya particles living cells se pass hote hain, toh wo cellular atoms ko ionize kar dete hain aur water radiolysis ke zariye free radicals generate karte hain. Is interaction se single-strand aur double-strand DNA breaks create hote hain, jo cellular apoptosis, somatic organ dysfunction, radiation-induced sickness aur long-term stochastic carcinogenesis (cancer formation) cause karte hain.

qe: Which applicator is used for 'Protection' against radioactive losses?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी नुकसान के खिलाफ 'सुरक्षा' (Protection) के लिए किस एप्लिकेटर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
oh: परिरक्षित कंटेनर / लेड शील्डेड कंटेनर (Shielded containers)
e: Radioactive isotopes aur brachytherapy source pins handling ke dauran radiation exposure leakage block karne ke liye heavy Shielded Containers (jinhe 'Lead Pigs' ya 'Lead Castles' kehte hain) use kiye jaate hain. Lead ($Pb$) aur depleted Uranium jaise high atomic number dense materials high attenuation properties offer karte hain jo penetrating gamma emissions ko container boundaries ke andar hi trap aur absorb kar lete hain. Is physical shielding se ambient storage environment aur healthcare personnel primary ionizing radiation leak se isolated rehte hain.

qe: Radioactive series eventually end with the formation of:
qh: रेडियोधर्मी श्रृंखला अंततः किसके निर्माण के साथ समाप्त होती है?
oh: स्थिर सीसा / लेड आइसोटोप - Stable Lead (Pb)
e: Nature mein payi jaane wali teeno major natural radioactive decay chains—Uranium series, Thorium series, aur Actinium series—heavy unstable parent nuclei se start hoti hain aur multiple sequential alpha aur beta disintegrations ke through progress karti hain. Ye continuous nuclear cascade transmutation tab stop hoti hai jab decay chain lead ($Pb$) ke naturally stable, non-radioactive isotope par reach karti hai (Uranium series Pb-206 par, Thorium series Pb-208 par, aur Actinium series Pb-207 par). Yahan binding energy curve stable equilibrium achieve kar leta hai.

qe: Who discovered X-Rays in the year 1895?
qh: 1895 में एक्स-रे की खोज किसने की थी?
e: 8 November 1895 ko German physicist Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen ne University of Würzburg mein Crookes gas discharge cathode ray tube par experiment karte waqt X-rays accidentally discover kiye. Unhone dekha ki darkroom mein covered black cardboard tube ke paas rakhi barium platinocyanide fluorescent screen glowing light produce kar rahi thi. Unknown physical nature ki wajah se unhone is radiation ka naam 'X-rays' rakha. Is breakthrough discovery ke liye unhe physics ka sabse pehla Nobel Prize (1901) award kiya gaya tha.

qe: Which material is most commonly used as a 'Target material' in an X-ray tube?
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब में 'टारगेट सामग्री' के रूप में आमतौर पर किस सामग्री का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: General diagnostic X-ray tubes mein target anodal material ke roop mein Tungsten ($W$) standard material hai. Iske teen critical physical advantages hote hain: Pehla, iska high atomic number ($Z = 74$) Bremsstrahlung X-ray production efficiency badhata hai kyunki X-ray yield $Z$ ke directly proportional hoti hai. Doosra, iska exceptionally high melting point (approx 3422°C) continuous high heat loading withstand karta hai bina target evaporate hue. Teesra, iska decent thermal conductivity rate localized heat dissipating support provide karta hai.

qe: What determines the 'Quality' or penetrating power of X-rays?
qh: एक्स-रे की 'गुणवत्ता' या मर्मज्ञ शक्ति (penetrating power) क्या निर्धारित करती है?
e: X-ray beam ki 'Quality' beam photons ki average kinetic energy, frequency aur penetrating ability ko refer karti hai, jise primarily Peak Kilovoltage (kVp) govern karta hai. Console par kVp setting cathode aur anode ke beech electrical potential difference set karti hai. High kVp cathode electrons ko extreme kinetic velocities par target ki taraf accelerate karta hai, jisse unke collision se shorter wavelength, high-energy penetrating photons generate hote hain jo dense body tissues ko easily traverse kar lete hain.

qe: What are 'Hard X-rays'?
qh: 'कठोर एक्स-रे' (Hard X-rays) क्या हैं?
oe: High-energy X-ray photons with short wavelengths and deep penetrating power
oh: उच्च ऊर्जा और गहरी मर्मज्ञ क्षमता वाली किरणें (Hard X-rays)
e: Hard X-rays high-energy electromagnetic photons hote hain jinki photon energies standard diagnostic ranges mein higher band (typically above 30-50 keV) par hoti hain aur wavelengths extremely short ($0.01$ to $0.1$ nm) hoti hain. Inki deep tissue penetration capability thick anatomical structures (jaise lumbar spine ya dense adult pelvis) ko cross karke detector tak transmit hoti hai bina skin par absorb hue. Inhe diagnostic beam filtration (soft ray absorbers) aur high operational kVp selection dwara optimize kiya jata hai.

qe: X-rays are a form of which type of radiation?
qh: एक्स-रे किस प्रकार के विकिरण का एक रूप हैं?
e: X-rays electromagnetic radiation spectrum ka high-energy segment occupy karte hain, jinki place ultraviolet light aur gamma rays ke intermediate fall hoti hai. Visible light photons ki tarah X-rays dual wave-particle nature exhibit karte hain aur massless energy packets (photons) ke roop mein vacuum ke andar speed of light ($c \approx 3 \times 10^8 \text{ m/s}$) par travel karte hain. Distinct feature ye hai ki inki frequency high ($10^{16}$ to $10^{19}$ Hz) aur energy sufficient hoti hai atoms ko ionize karne ke liye, jo inhe ionizing radiation banati hai.

qe: The interaction of penetrating radiation with 'Matter' involves:
qh: मर्मज्ञ विकिरण की 'पदार्थ' (Matter) के साथ परस्पर क्रिया में शामिल है:
e: Jab penetrating X-ray photons kisi material medium ya human body se traverse karte hain, toh beam photons teen potential fates encounter karte hain: transmission (bina interaction body cross karna), Photoelectric Absorption (photon target atom ke inner-shell electron ko transfer hokar completely disappear ho jata hai), aur Compton Scattering (photon collision ke baad out-of-path angle par deflect hokar apni partially reduced energy lose karta hai). Yahi absorption aur scatter differential attenuation structure form karte hain.

qe: Which property of X-rays makes them useful for medical imaging?
qh: एक्स-रे का कौन सा गुण उन्हें मेडिकल इमेजिंग के लिए उपयोगी बनाता है?
oe: Differential absorption by various biological tissues based on atomic density
oh: विभिन्न ऊतकों द्वारा विभेदक अवशोषण (Differential absorption by tissues)
e: Medical radiography ka fundamental principle Differential Absorption par depend karta hai. Body ke different tissues ka physical density aur effective atomic number vary karta hai (jaise bone $Z \approx 13.8$, soft tissue $Z \approx 7.4$, aur air lungs mein low density). High-Z bone X-ray photons ko photoelectrically absorb kar leti hai aur radiograph par white radiopaque profile generate karti hai, jabki air-filled lungs aur soft muscle mass photons ko transmission allow karke optical darkness create karte hain, jo clear diagnostic contrast map deliver karta hai.

qe: What is the result of using a 'Soft X-ray' beam?
qh: 'नरम एक्स-रे' (Soft X-ray) बीम के उपयोग का परिणाम क्या होता है?
oe: Low tissue penetration and unnecessary high patient skin radiation dose
oh: कम मर्मज्ञ शक्ति और रोगी की त्वचा पर अत्यधिक विकिरण खुराक (High skin dose)
e: Soft X-rays long-wavelength, low-energy photons hote hain jinme diagnostic structures ko penetrate karne ki insufficient kinetic energy hoti hai. Agar ye un-attenuated beams patient anatomy par direct fall karein, toh wo internal tissue penetrate karke image detector plate tak nahi pahunch pate. Iske bajaye ye body ki superficial skin layers aur subcutaneous tissue mein hi fully absorb ho jaate hain. Resultantly, ye image creation mein zero contribution dete hain jabki patient skin entrance dose ko dangerously multiply kar dete hain.

qe: The 'Source' of electrons in a modern X-ray tube is the:
qh: आधुनिक एक्स-रे ट्यूब में इलेक्ट्रॉनों का 'स्रोत' है:
oe: Electrically heated Cathode Filament (via Thermionic Emission)
oh: गर्म कैथोड फिलामेंट - Thermionic Emission (Heated Filament)
e: Modern Coolidge X-ray tubes mein free projectile electrons ka primary origin cathode assembly ke andar mount kiya gaya coiled Tungsten Filament hota hai. Jab low-voltage, high-current filament circuit apply hota hai, tungsten wire resistance ki wajah se white-hot thermal incandescent state (over 2000°C) achieve karta hai. Is extreme heat energy se metallic outer valence electrons thermal excitation paakar wire surface se eject ho jaate hain. Is phenomenon ko Thermionic Emission kehte hain, jo tube current ke electrons provide karta hai.

qe: Why is vacuum maintained inside the X-ray tube?
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब के अंदर वैक्यूम क्यों बनाए रखा जाता है?
oe: To prevent accelerated electrons from colliding with gas molecules and prevent filament burnout
oh: इलेक्ट्रॉनों को वायु अणुओं से टकराने और फिलामेंट ऑक्सीकरण से बचाने के लिए (Prevent collision)
e: X-ray tube insert borosilicate glass ya metal ceramic casing ke andar high vacuum ($10^{-6}$ to $10^{-7}$ torr) maintain karta hai. Agar tube chamber mein air ya residual gases presence show karein, toh cathode se anode accelerate hone wale fast-moving thermal electrons gas molecules se collide ho jayenge. Is obstruction se electrons kinetic energy lose kar denge, beam focusing completely scatter ho jayegi, gas ionization se arc discharge develop hogi aur atmospheric oxygen heated tungsten filament ko instantly oxidize karke burn out kar degi.

qe: The 'Electro-physiological' activity of the heart begins at which natural pacemaker?
qh: हृदय की 'इलेक्ट्रो-फिजियोलॉजिकल' गतिविधि किस प्राकृतिक पेसमेकर से शुरू होती है?
e: Human cardiac electrical conduction pathway ka primary intrinsic pacemaker Sinoatrial (SA) Node hota hai, jo right atrium ki posterior wall mein superior vena cava ke opening junction par positioned hota hai. SA node specialized self-excitable pacemaker cells se bana hota hai jo bina kisi external nervous command ke spontaneously rhythmic action potentials generate karti hain (inherent rate 60-100 impulses/minute). Ye depolarizing electrical wavefront dono atria mein spread hokar mechanical atrial contraction trigger karta hai aur AV node tak conduct hota hai.

qe: What does the 'P-wave' represent in a normal ECG?
qh: एक सामान्य ECG में 'P-वेव' क्या दर्शाती है?
e: Standard electrocardiogram (ECG) tracing par P-wave pehla positive deflection banti hai. Ye wave electrical impulse ke SA node se nikal kar right aur left atria ke myocardial muscle mass mein spread hone ko reflect karti hai, jise Atrial Depolarization kehte hain. Electrical depolarization instantly muscle cell membranes ke calcium channels open karti hai, jisse electrical event ke immediate follow-up mein atria physically contract hote hain (atrial systole) aur blood ventricles mein pump hota hai. Is wave ka duration normally 0.08 se 0.10 seconds hota hai.

qe: The 'Coronary circulation' primarily supplies blood to:
qh: 'कोरोनरी सर्कुलेशन' मुख्य रूप से किसे रक्त की आपूर्ति करता है?
oe: Myocardium and tissues of the heart itself
oh: हृदय की मांसपेशियां - मायोकार्डियम (Heart muscles / Myocardium)
e: Heart chambers continuously blood pump karte hain, lekin cardiac muscular wall (myocardium) itni thick aur dense hoti hai ki wo chambers ke andar flow ho rahe luminal blood se direct oxygen absorb nahi kar sakti. Is purpose ke liye ascending aorta ke root par aortic sinuses se right aur left coronary arteries emerge hoti hain. Ye arteries myocardium ki pure muscle wall, conduction tissue aur cardiac valves ko oxygenated blood, glucose aur nutrients supply karti hain aur deoxygenated blood coronary sinus ke through right atrium mein return hota hai.

qe: Mechanical activity of the heart includes which phase?
qh: हृदय की यांत्रिक गतिविधि में कौन सा चरण शामिल है?
oh: सिस्टोल (संकुचन) और डायस्टोल (शिथिलन) - Systole and Diastole
e: Cardiac cycle heart ki dynamic continuous mechanical pumping loop hoti hai jo do major alternate sequential phases mein divide hoti hai: Systole aur Diastole. Ventricular Systole mechanical contraction stage hoti hai jisme intraventricular pressures sharp rise karte hain, atrioventricular valves snap close hote hain, aur semilunar valves open hokar stroke volume blood ko aorta aur pulmonary arteries mein eject karte hain. Ventricular Diastole relaxation aur filling phase hoti hai jahan ventricles expand hokar venous blood se re-fill hote hain.

qe: Which condition is defined as a deficiency in the amount of oxygen reaching the tissues?
qh: ऊतकों तक पहुँचने वाली ऑक्सीजन की मात्रा में कमी को क्या कहा जाता है?
oh: हाइपोक्सिया - Hypoxia (ऊतकों में ऑक्सीजन की कमी)
e: Hypoxia ek serious pathophysiological state hoti hai jisme cellular level par metabolizing biological tissues ko demand ke mutabiq adequate oxygen supply delivery nahi ho pati. Iske broad classifications hote hain: Hypoxemic hypoxia (arterial blood mein low partial oxygen pressure $PaO_2$), Anemic hypoxia (hemoglobin transport capacity down hona), Stagnant/Ischemic hypoxia (blood circulatory perfusion flow slow hona), aur Histotoxic hypoxia (cellular enzymes jaise cytochrome oxidase ka cyanide poisoning se block ho jana, jisse cells oxygen utilize nahi kar paate).

qe: What is the clinical term for 'Difficulty in breathing'?
qh: 'सांस लेने में कठिनाई' के लिए नैदानिक शब्द क्या है?
e: Dyspnoea ek clinical diagnostic symptom hai jisme patient breathing discomfort, shortness of breath ya air hunger perceive karta hai. Ye subjective sensation respiratory centers ke sensory motor feedback mismatch hone par trigger hoti hai (chemoreceptors aur lung stretch receptors ke through). Dyspnoea acute respiratory distress (jaise asthma attack, acute pulmonary embolism, severe pneumonia) aur CVS failure conditions (congestive left ventricular failure aur pulmonary interstitial edema) ka cardinal clinical indicator hota hai.

qe: The 'Adrenal glands' are located on top of which organ?
qh: 'एड्रिनल ग्रंथियां' किस अंग के ऊपर स्थित होती हैं?
e: Adrenal Glands (jinhe anatomy mein Suprarenal glands kehte hain) do small yellowish pyramidal-shaped endocrine organs hote hain jo retroperitoneal space mein dono kidneys ke superior poles par cap ki tarah firmly positioned rehte hain. Inka structure do functional parts mein divided hota hai: Outer Adrenal Cortex jo life-saving steroid hormones (mineralocorticoid Aldosterone, glucocorticoid Cortisol, aur androgens) secretes karta hai; aur Inner Adrenal Medulla jo sympathetic nervous system ke direct regulation mein stress catecholamines (Adrenaline / Epinephrine aur Noradrenaline) synthesize karta hai.

qe: What does 'Renal filtration' produce as a waste product?
qh: 'रीनल फिल्ट्रेशन' अपशिष्ट उत्पाद के रूप में क्या उत्पन्न करता है?
e: Renal filtration kidney ke functional units yaani nephrons mein perform hoti hai. Glomerulus high hydrostatic pressure ke zariye blood plasma ko filter karke glomerular filtrate produce karta hai, jisme se zaroori glucose, amino acids aur electrolytes nephron tubules dwara reabsorb ho jaate hain. Bacha hua liquid jisme toxic nitrogenous metabolic wastes jaise urea, uric acid, creatinine aur excess ions dissolve rehte hain, use urine kehte hain. Ye collect hokar ureter ke raste urinary bladder mein store hota hai aur micturition dwara body se expel hota hai, jo fluid-electrolyte balance aur blood pressure maintain karta hai.

qe: The exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the alveoli is called:
qh: एल्वियोली में ऑक्सीजन और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के विनिमय को कहा जाता है?
oh: बाहरी / पल्मोनरी गैस विनिमय (External/Pulmonary gas exchange)
e: Lungs ke microscopic air sacs yaani alveoli aur unhe surround karne wali pulmonary capillaries ke beech gas molecules ka diffusion External ya Pulmonary Gas Exchange kehlaata hai. Alveolar air mein oxygen ka partial pressure ($pO_2$) deoxygenated blood se significantly high hota hai, isliye oxygen respiratory membrane cross karke pulmonary blood capillaries ke hemoglobin se bind ho jaati hai. Wahi pulmonary blood se carbon dioxide ($pCO_2$) alveoli mein diffuse hokar exhalation dwara body se bahar nikal jaati hai. Iske विपरीत internal respiration systemic capillary blood aur peripheral metabolizing tissue cells ke beech gas exchange ko kehte hain.

qe: What is the primary function of the 'Cell Membrane'?
qh: 'कोशिका झिल्ली' (Cell Membrane) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
e: Cell membrane ya plasma membrane phospholipid bilayer aur embedded proteins se bani ek selectively permeable (ardh-paragamya) biological barrier hoti hai. Iska primary mechanical function cell ke internal cytoplasm ko external extracellular fluid environment se separate rakhna aur across-membrane molecular trafficking ko strictly regulate karna hai. Small non-polar molecules passive diffusion se pass ho jaate hain, jabki ions, glucose aur water trans-membrane protein channels, carrier pumps (jaise $Na^+/K^+$ ATPase) aur active transport mechanisms se travel karte hain. Ye cell ka resting membrane electrical potential generate karke cell signaling aur cellular homeostasis maintain rakhti hai.

qe: Which component of blood is responsible for 'Coagulation'?
qh: रक्त का कौन सा घटक 'कोगुलेशन' (थक्का जमने) के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Hemostasis ya blood coagulation vascular injury ke waqt excessive hemorrhage rokne ki protective physiological cascade hoti hai. Jab vascular endothelium rupture hota hai, bone marrow se generate hue cellular cell fragments jinhe Platelets (thrombocytes) kehte hain, instantly collagen se bind karke primary platelet plug form karte hain. Sath hi enzymatic clotting cascade trigger hota hai, jisme prothrombin enzyme thrombin mein convert hota hai. Thrombin soluble plasma protein Fibrinogen ko insoluble fibrin mesh threads mein polymerize kar deta hai. Ye mechanical mesh platelets aur blood cells ko trap karke stable fibrin clot banata hai jo wound heal karta hai.

qe: The 'Electro-physiological activity' of the heart is recorded using which test?
qh: हृदय की 'इलेक्ट्रो-फिजियोलॉजिकल' गतिविधि को किस टेस्ट का उपयोग करके रिकॉर्ड किया जाता है?
e: Electrocardiogram (ECG) cardiac conduction system dwara generate hone wale microscopic electrical potential changes ko skin par placed external metal electrodes ke through graph surface par trace karta hai. Heart ke sinoatrial (SA) node se originate hone wali ionic depolarization aur repolarization waves atrial aur ventricular muscle cells mein travel karti hain. ECG monitor in bio-potentials ko amplify karke P-wave (atrial depolarization), QRS complex (ventricular depolarization) aur T-wave (ventricular repolarization) waveforms ke roop mein display karta hai. Is non-invasive test se cardiac arrhythmias, conduction heart blocks, ischemia aur myocardial infarction accurately diagnose hote hain.

qe: What is the primary function of 'Hemoglobin'?
qh: 'हीमोग्लोबिन' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
e: Hemoglobin red blood cells (erythrocytes) ke andar packed iron-containing quaternary transport protein hai jisme char heme prosthetic groups aur globin chains hoti hain. Har iron atom ($Fe^{2+}$) ek oxygen molecule ke sath reversibly bind kar sakta hai, isliye ek hemoglobin molecule maximum char oxygen molecules bind karke Oxyhemoglobin form karta hai. Lungs ke high partial pressure oxygen environment mein ye oxygen load karta hai aur peripheral hypoxic tissues mein deliver karta hai jahan mitochondrial respiration chal rahi hoti hai. Sath hi ye approximately 20-23% carbon dioxide ko carbaminohemoglobin ke form mein lungs tak wapas return transport bhi karta hai.

qe: Which blood cells are primarily involved in the 'Immune response'?
qh: कौन सी रक्त कोशिकाएं मुख्य रूप से 'प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया' में शामिल होती हैं?
e: Lymphocytes specialized agranular white blood cells (leukocytes) hote hain jo body ki adaptive aur humoral immunity govern karte hain. Inki do major classes hoti hain: B-lymphocytes jo bone marrow mein mature hote hain aur antigens ke against specific circulating target antibodies (immunoglobulins) synthesize karte hain; aur T-lymphocytes jo thymus mein mature hote hain aur infected, mutated ya foreign cells ko direct kill karke cell-mediated immunity provide karte hain (CD8+ cytotoxic T cells) tatha immune cascades coordinate karte hain (CD4+ helper T cells). Sath hi ye immune memory maintain karte hain taaki re-infection par rapid immune response trigger ho sake.

qe: The 'Mechanical activity' of the heart refers to:
qh: हृदय की 'यांत्रिक गतिविधि' (Mechanical activity) का तात्पर्य है:
oh: संकुचन और पंपिंग - सिस्टोल और डायस्टोल (Contraction and Pumping)
e: Heart ki mechanical activity cardiac electrical impulses ke triggering ke baad myocardial muscle fibers ki physical kinetic pumping action ko indicate karti hai. Is continuous loop ko cardiac cycle kehte hain, jo do interconnected alternating mechanical phases mein divide hota hai: Systole aur Diastole. Ventricular Systole ke dauran myocardium forcefully contract hota hai, atrioventricular valves close hoti hain aur pressurized blood stroke volume ban kar aorta aur pulmonary trunk mein pump hota hai. Ventricular Diastole ke dauran ventricular chambers relax aur expand hote hain taaki venous return blood unhe wapas replenish kar sake.

qe: Which process describes the 'exchange of gases' in the lungs?
qh: फेफड़ों में 'गैसों के विनिमय' का वर्णन कौन सी प्रक्रिया करती है?
e: Pulmonary gas exchange respiratory membrane ke across hone wala passive physical diffusion process hai jo lungs ke terminal alveoli aur surrounding pulmonary capillary networks ke beech operate hota hai. Ye Fick's Law of Diffusion follow karta hai, jahan gases high partial pressure se low partial pressure gradient ki taraf move karti hain. Inhaled air se fresh oxygen alveolar wall aur capillary endothelium cross karke blood plasma aur RBCs mein bind ho jaati hai, jabki venous system se aane wali carbon dioxide simultaneous counter-diffusion se alveolar space mein discharge hokar expire out ho jaati hai.

qe: Renal function primarily involves the filtration of:
qh: 'रीनल फंक्शन' (Renal function) में मुख्य रूप से किसका निस्पंदन शामिल है?
oh: मूत्र निर्माण के लिए रक्त का निस्पंदन (Blood to form urine)
e: Kidneys ka primary physiological mechanism renal circulation se receive hone wale massive arterial blood flow (approx 20-25% of cardiac output) ko continuously ultrafilter karna hai. Renal cortex ke nephrons mein renal artery se aane wala blood afferent arteriole ke through glomerulus capillary bed mein enter karta hai. High glomerular capillary blood pressure cellular elements aur large proteins ko retain karke water, salts, metabolic wastes aur nutrients ko Bowman's capsule mein filter out karta hai. Tubular reabsorption aur tubular secretion ke specific processing stages ke baad remaining concentrated liquid final urine bankar renal pelvis mein collect hota hai.

qe: Which type of joints allow for the greatest range of movement?
qh: किस प्रकार के जोड़ सबसे अधिक गति की अनुमति देते हैं?
oh: साइनोवियल जोड़ / सचल जोड़ - Synovial joints (Diarthroses)
e: Anatomy mein functional classification ke आधार par joints ko teen main classes mein divide kiya jata hai: Synarthroses (immovable fibrous joints jaise skull sutures), Amphiarthroses (slightly movable cartilaginous joints jaise pubic symphysis) aur Diarthroses (freely movable Synovial joints). Synovial joints mein articulating bone ends articular hyaline cartilage se cap rehti hain aur unke beech ek enclosed synovial cavity hoti hai jisme viscous synovial fluid bhara rehta hai jo friction-free glide allow karta hai. Ball-and-socket joints (shoulder/hip) aur hinge joints (elbow/knee) iske examples hain jo maximum range of motion offer karte hain.

qe: The joints of the 'Trunks' primarily involve the:
qh: 'धड़' (Trunks) के जोड़ों में मुख्य रूप से शामिल हैं:
oh: कशेरुका स्तंभ और इंटरवर्टेब्रल जोड़ (Vertebral column joints)
e: Trunk (axial skeleton) ke articulating junctions primarily spine ya vertebral column ke structural framework se construct hote hain. Isme do distinct anatomical connections shamil hote hain: adjacent vertebral bodies ke beech fibrocartilaginous intervertebral discs (symphysis joints) jo weight-bearing shock absorbers ka kaam karte hain, aur adjacent vertebral arches ke articular processes ke beech pairing plane synovial facet joints (zygapophyseal joints). Sath hi thoracic region mein ribs vertebrae ke sath costovertebral aur costotransverse joints form karti hain, jo trunk ko bending, axial rotation aur respiratory chest wall movement provide karte hain.

qe: Which part of the brain coordinates complex muscular movements?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग जटिल मांसपेशियों की गतिविधियों का समन्वय करता है?
e: Cerebellum (chhota dimag) posterior cranial fossa mein brainstem ke peeche positioned hota hai. Halanki voluntary muscular movements cerebral motor cortex se initiate hoti hain, un movements ki precise motor execution, dynamic timing, rate, force aur muscle group synergy ko calibrate karne ka central task cerebellum manage karta hai. Ye inner ear ke vestibular apparatus aur muscles/tendons ke proprioceptors se continuous real-time sensory feedback receive karta hai aur motor output ko adjust karta hai, jisse posture balance, smooth gait locomotion aur fine precision movements execute hoti hain.

qe: Surface Anatomy is used to study:
qh: सर्फेस एनाटॉमी का उपयोग किसके अध्ययन के लिए किया जाता है?
oe: Surface landmarks and internal structural projections on the living human body
oh: जीवित मानव शरीर पर सतही स्थलचिह्न और आंतरिक संरचनाएं (Surface landmarks)
e: Surface Anatomy descriptive clinical anatomy ki specialized branch hai jo living human body par skin surface aur external visual contour landmarks ke through underlying internal anatomical organs, bones, blood vessels aur nerves ki relative position project aur locate karti hai. Clinical practice aur radiology mein surface landmarks (jaise sternal angle of Louis, xiphoid process, iliac crests, bony spine processes aur peripheral arterial pulses) pulse palpation, lumbar punctures, chest drain tubes insertion, nerve blocks aur accurate radiologic X-ray tube centering ke liye absolute foundation bante hain.

qe: Which part of the brain acts as the primary relay station for almost all sensory information?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग लगभग सभी संवेदी सूचनाओं के लिए प्राथमिक रिले स्टेशन है?
e: Thalamus diencephalon ka large, symmetrical dual-lobed ovoid gray matter nuclear mass hai jo cerebral cortex aur midbrain ke beech situated hota hai. Ise central nervous system ka primary 'Sensory Relay Station' ya gatekeeper kehte hain. Olfaction (smell) ke single exception ke alawa peripheral sensory pathways se aane wale sabhi sensory inputs—jaise somatic touch, pain, temperature, proprioception, vision (lateral geniculate nucleus) aur hearing auditory inputs (medial geniculate nucleus)—cerebral cortex ke higher sensory regions tak reach karne se pehle thalamic nuclei mein synapse aur initial process hote hain.

qe: Which structure connects the spinal cord to the higher brain centers?
qh: कौन सी संरचना रीढ़ की हड्डी को मस्तिष्क के उच्च केंद्रों से जोड़ती है?
e: Brainstem central nervous system ka stalk-like structural aur functional stalk hai jo superiorly cerebral hemispheres aur diencephalon ko inferiorly continuous spinal cord se anatomically connect karta hai. Brainstem teen contiguous sequential segments se compose hota hai: rostral Midbrain, intermediate Pons aur caudal Medulla Oblongata. Brainstem se ascending sensory tracts aur descending motor pyramidal pathways traverse karte hain. Sath hi ye 10 cranial nerves (III se XII) ko originate karta hai aur autonomous vital autonomic centers (cardiac pacing, vascular vasomotor tone, respiratory breathing drive) harbor karta hai.

qe: The 'Hypothalamus' is located in which region of the brain?
qh: 'हाइपोथैलेमस' मस्तिष्क के किस क्षेत्र में स्थित है?
e: Hypothalamus Diencephalon ka fundamental ventral basal segment banata hai, jo thalamus ke theek inferior floor par aur third ventricle ki floor aur lateral walls ke sath positioned hota hai. Size mein miniature hone ke bawajood hypothalamus body ka master homeostatic control center hai. Ye autonomic nervous system ko directly regulate karta hai, pituitary gland se endocrine hormone release ko infundibular stalk ke zariye command karta hai, aur body temperature, hunger, thirst, sleep-wake circadian cycles aur emotional limbic drives ko seamlessly balance karta hai.

qe: The 'Meninges' consist of how many protective layers?
qh: 'मेनिन्जेस' में कितनी सुरक्षात्मक परतें होती हैं?
e: Meninges teen continuous connective tissue protective membranous sheaths hoti hain jo central nervous system yaani brain aur spinal cord ko bony cranial cavity aur vertebral canal ke andar insulate karti hain. Outer outermost thick, tough, dense fibrous layer ko Dura Mater (pachymeninx) kehte hain; intermediate web-like avascular layer ko Arachnoid Mater kehte hain; aur innermost delicate, highly vascular layer jo direct brain gyri aur sulci se chipki rehti hai, use Pia Mater kehte hain. Arachnoid aur Pia ke beech subarachnoid space hoti hai jisme Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) circulate hokar mechanical cushioning provide karta hai.

qe: Which structure provides the 'Blood Supply' to the brain?
qh: मस्तिष्क को 'रक्त आपूर्ति' कौन सी संरचना प्रदान करती है?
oe: Circle of Willis and major cerebral arterial branches
oh: सर्कल ऑफ विलिस और सेरेब्रल धमनियां (Circle of Willis / Cerebral arteries)
e: Brain ki primary arterial perfusion do interconnected circulatory pathways se supply hoti hai: Anterior circulation jo bilateral Internal Carotid Arteries se arise hoti hai, aur Posterior circulation jo Vertebral Arteries se milkar Basilar Artery banati hai. Brain ke base par interpeduncular fossa ke around ye vessels aapas mein anastamose karke ek polygonal vascular ring banati hain jise 'Circle of Willis' (Circulus Arteriosus) kehte hain. Is anastomotic network se Anterior, Middle aur Posterior Cerebral Arteries radiate hoti hain jo cerebral cortex aur deep nuclear parenchyma ko continuous, uninterrupted oxygenated blood supply ensure karti hain.

qe: The 'Spinal Cord' is divided into various:
qh: 'रीढ़ की हड्डी' को विभिन्न भागों में विभाजित किया गया है:
e: Spinal cord vertebral column ke spinal canal ke andar situated cylindrical elongated nervous tract hai. Regional anatomy ke basis par ise 31 sequential anatomical segments mein classify kiya jata hai, jinse 31 pairs of spinal nerves bilateral nikalte hain: 8 Cervical segments ($C_1-C_8$), 12 Thoracic segments ($T_1-T_{12}$), 5 Lumbar segments ($L_1-L_5$), 5 Sacral segments ($S_1-S_5$) aur 1 Coccygeal segment ($Co_1$). Cross-section mein har segment central H-shaped gray matter (dorsal aur ventral horns) aur surrounding outer white matter columns (funiculi) mein divided hota hai jo peripheral body ko brain se connect karte hain.

qe: The 'Cerebellum' is primarily involved in:
qh: 'सेरेबेलम' मुख्य रूप से किसमें शामिल है?
oh: मोटर समन्वय, संतुलन और शारीरिक साम्यावस्था (Motor coordination and Balance)
e: Metencephalon ka part Cerebellum muscle movements initiate nahi karta, balki motor execution ko fine-tune aur coordinate karta hai. Ye body ke balance, equilibrium aur spatial posture ko regulate karta hai. Cerebellar cortex spinocerebellar tracts ke zariye continuous sensory input monitor karta hai aur use planned cerebral voluntary motor commands se compare karta hai. Agar movement path ya trajectory mein physical error ho, toh cerebellum inhibitory/excitatory feedback signals generate karke antagonist aur agonist muscle groups ko smoothly synchronize karta hai, jisse ataxia aur tremors prevent hote hain.

qe: Which ventricles are located within the cerebral hemispheres?
qh: सेरेब्रल हेमिस्फीयर के भीतर कौन से वेंट्रिकल्स स्थित होते हैं?
e: Brain ke internal cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) ventricular system mein four communicating cavities hoti hain. Inme se Right aur Left Cerebral Hemispheres ke core mein situated C-shaped paired large fluid cavities ko 'Lateral Ventricles' (First aur Second ventricles) kehte hain. Har lateral ventricle mein ek central anterior horn (frontal lobe), body (parietal lobe), posterior horn (occipital lobe) aur inferior horn (temporal lobe) hota hai. Inke andar lining choroid plexus tissue continuous CSF secret karta hai, jo foramen of Monro (interventricular foramen) ke zariye diencephalon ke single midline Third Ventricle mein flow hota hai.

qe: Which part of the brain contains the 'Thalamus and Hypothalamus'?
qh: मस्तिष्क के किस भाग में 'थैलेमस और हाइपोथैलेमस' होते हैं?
e: Forebrain (prosencephalon) embryonic stage par do major subdivisions mein bifurcate hota hai: telencephalon (jo cerebral hemispheres banata hai) aur diencephalon. Diencephalon midline central cerebral structure hai jo upper brainstem (midbrain) aur cerebrum ke intermediate locate hota hai. Iske primary anatomical structural components mein sensory relaying Thalamus, endocrine aur autonomic regulatory Hypothalamus, pineal gland containing Epithalamus, aur basal motor circuit linked Subthalamus shamil hain. Ye structures together body ki sensory processing, endocrine hormone axis aur metabolic homeostasis ko coordinate karte hain.

qe: The study of 'Joints of the Upper Limb' includes:
qh: 'ऊपरी अंग के जोड़ों' के अध्ययन में शामिल हैं:
oe: Shoulder, Elbow, Radioulnar, and Wrist joints
oh: कंधा, कोहनी, रेडियोअल्नर और कलाई के जोड़ (Shoulder, Elbow, and Wrist)
e: Upper limb ke articulations human body mein fine manual dexterity, reaching aur object manipulation ke liye design kiye gaye synovial joints hain. Is region ki systematic anatomical study pectoral girdle se distal hand tak progress karti hai: Sternoclavicular aur Acromioclavicular joints (pectoral girdle stability); Glenohumeral joint (multiaxial ball-and-socket shoulder joint); Hinge type Elbow joint (humeroulnar aur humeroradial flex-extension); Proximal aur Distal Radioulnar joints (forearm pronation aur supination); Radiocarpal Wrist joint; aur hand ke intercarpal, metacarpophalangeal (MCP) tatha interphalangeal (IP) joints.

qe: The microscopic study of tissues, such as epithelium and connective tissue, is called:
qh: उपकला और संयोजी ऊतक जैसे ऊतकों के सूक्ष्म अध्ययन को कहा जाता है:
e: Histology (Microscopic Anatomy) anatomy ki wo branch hai jisme biological tissues ki microscopic cellular architecture, intracellular organization aur extracellular matrix structure ka study histological sectioning, tissue staining (jaise Hematoxylin & Eosin) aur light/electron microscopy ke zariye kiya jata hai. Human body ke sabhi organ structures chaar primary basic tissue groups se construct hote hain: Epithelial tissue (surface lining aur protection), Connective tissue (structural support aur binding), Muscular tissue (contraction aur mechanical motion), aur Nervous tissue (electrical impulse transmission). Normal histology samajhna clinical histopathology mein disease diagnosis ka core base hota hai.

qe: Which structure prevents food from entering the trachea during swallowing?
qh: निगलते समय कौन सी संरचना भोजन को श्वासनली में जाने से रोकती है?
e: Epiglottis ek leaf-shaped flexible fibrocartilaginous flap hota hai jo larynx ke inlet par tongue base ke peeche situated hota hai. Respiration ke dauran epiglottis upright open rehta hai taaki pharynx se air freely laryngeal inlet aur trachea mein circulate ho sake. Swallowing (deglutition) ke second reflexive pharyngeal stage par suprahyoid muscles larynx ko upward aur forward elevate karti hain, jisse epiglottis backward fold hokar laryngeal entrance (glottis) ko tightly seal kar deta hai. Ye dynamic mechanical closure masticated food bolus ko airway trachea mein chhale jane (aspiration) se rok kar esophagus ki taraf divert karta hai.

qe: The 'Blood Vascular System' includes which of the following components?
qh: 'रक्त संवहनी तंत्र' में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा घटक शामिल है?
oe: Arteries, Capillaries, and Veins (driven by the Heart)
oh: धमनियां, केशिकाएं और नसें (Arteries, Capillaries, and Veins)
e: Blood Vascular System circulatory cardiovascular framework ka closed tubular network hota hai jo oxygen, nutrients, hormones aur metabolic wastes ko entire body mein continuously circulate karta hai. Is circulatory loop mein centrally positioned pumping muscular heart shamil hota hai jo hydrostatic pressure generate karta hai. Peripheral vessels teen functional types mein divide hoti hain: Arteries jo high-pressure oxygenated blood heart se door peripheral organs tak distribute karti hain; microvascular Capillaries jahan ultra-thin endothelial walls ke across blood aur tissues ke beech nutrient-gas exchange hota hai; aur Veins jo deoxygenated blood ko low-pressure return karke heart mein drain karti hain.

qe: Which part of the digestive system is responsible for the microscopic and gross study of food absorption?
qh: पाचन तंत्र का कौन सा भाग भोजन के अवशोषण के सूक्ष्म और स्थूल अध्ययन के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
oh: छोटी आंत - डुओडेनम, जेजुनम, इलियम (Small Intestine)
e: Small Intestine gastrointestinal tract ka primary organ hai jahan chemical digestion complete hoti hai aur 90% se zyada fluid aur nutrient absorption execute hota hai. Anatomically ye teen sequential segments mein divide hoti hai: Duodenum, Jejunum aur Ileum. Microscopic surface area expand karne ke liye iski luminal mucosal wall par circular folds (plicae circulares), microscopic finger-like projections (villi) aur enterocyte cell membranes par microvilli brush border hote hain. Ye microscopic structural adaptation absorption surface area ko hundreds of square meters tak multiply kar deti hai, jahan carbohydrates, amino acids, fatty acids, vitamins aur electrolytes efficiently blood aur lymphatic lacteals mein absorb hote hain.

qe: The primary organ of the 'Lymphatic System' that filters lymph is:
qh: 'लसीका तंत्र' का प्राथमिक अंग जो लसीका को फिल्टर करता है, वह है:
e: Lymph Nodes small, bean-shaped encapsulated lymphoid organs hote hain jo body bhar ke lymphatic vessels ke network par pathways par strategically clustered rehte hain (jaise cervical, axillary, mediastinal aur inguinal regions). Interstitial spaces se collect hone wala tissue lymph fluid afferent lymphatic channels ke zariye lymph nodes ke subcapsular aur medullary sinuses mein flow karta hai. Node ke andar densely packed macrophages, dendritic antigen-presenting cells, B-cells aur T-cells particulate cellular debris, foreign pathogens, bacteria aur malignant metastatic cancer cells ko phagocytize aur filter out kar dete hain, jisse immune activation trigger hoti hai.

qe: Which of the following is a major branch of the 'Trachea' entering the lungs?
qh: फेफड़ों में प्रवेश करने वाली 'श्वासनली' की एक प्रमुख शाखा निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी है?
e: Trachea (windpipe) neck se descend hokar superior mediastinum mein sternal angle of Louis ($T_4-T_5$ vertebral junction) ke level par bifurcate hoti hai. Is division point par internal cartilage ridge ko Carina kehte hain, jahan se trachea Right aur Left Primary (Mainstem) Bronchi mein divide hoti hai. Right main bronchus wider, shorter aur zyada vertical orientation mein hoti hai (jisse foreign body aspiration wahan zyada frequent hoti hai), jabki left main bronchus narrower aur zyada horizontal hoti hai. Ye primary bronchi lung hilum ke through enter karti hain aur lobar, segmental bronchi aur microscopic bronchioles mein progressively branch hoti hain.

qe: The study of the development of a 'Fertilized Ovum' is called:
qh: 'निषेचित अंडे' के विकास के अध्ययन को कहा जाता है:
e: Embryology biological science ki wo branch hai jo haploid gametes (sperm aur ovum) ke fertilization ke baad banne wale single-celled diploid zygote se lekar complete multicellular fetus ke intra-uterine morphological development ko study karti hai. Is discipline mein initial mitotic cleavages, morula, blastocyst formation, uterine wall implantation, embryonic gastrulation (ectoderm, mesoderm, endoderm germ layers ka generation), organogenesis (body organs ka embryonic origin aur differentiation) aur structural congenital anomalies/teratology ka comprehensive developmental roadmap cover kiya jata hai.

qe: Which system is responsible for the excretion of urine from the body?
qh: शरीर से मूत्र के उत्सर्जन के लिए कौन सा तंत्र जिम्मेदार है?
oh: मूत्र प्रणाली - Urinary system (Renal excretory tract)
e: Urinary System (Renal Excretory System) human body ka dedicated physiological organ group hai jo blood filtration, waste nitrogen extraction, osmoregulation aur urine excretion handle karta hai. Is system ke structural components mein shamil hain: bilateral Kidneys (jo blood plasma filter karke urine formulate karti hain); do fibromuscular Ureters (jo peristaltic muscular waves se urine ko kidneys se bladder tak propel karte hain); single distensible Urinary Bladder (jo urine ko mechanically store karta hai); aur Urethra (jo controlled voluntary voiding ke dauran urine ko body se external environment mein discharge karti hai).

qe: Bones provide which of the following functions in 'Osteology'?
qh: 'ऑस्टियोलॉजी' में हड्डियाँ निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कार्य प्रदान करती हैं?
oe: Structural Formation, Mechanical Protection, Support, and Mineral Storage
oh: संरचनात्मक निर्माण, यांत्रिक सुरक्षा, सहारा और खनिज भंडारण (Formation, Function & Support)
e: Osteology skeletal bones ke macroscopic anatomy, microscopic trabecular architecture aur biomechanical function ki scientific study hai. Skeletal bones body ko structural rigid framework provide karti hain aur vital soft visceral organs ko shield karti hain (jaise skull brain ko, thoracic ribcage heart-lungs ko aur vertebral column spinal cord ko protect karti hai). Muscular attachment tendons ke sath milkar bones mechanical levers form karti hain jo locomotion aur physical movement execute karte hain. Metabolic level par bones 99% calcium aur phosphorus store karne ka dynamic mineral reservoir hoti hain aur red marrow ke zariye hematopoiesis conduct karti hain.

qe: Which tissue type includes 'Cartilage, Bone, and Lymph'?
qh: किस ऊतक प्रकार में 'कार्टिलेज, हड्डी और लसीका' शामिल हैं?
e: Connective tissue embryonic mesoderm se derive hota hai aur iska hallmark feature widely spaced living cells ka extracellular structural matrix (fibers aur ground substance) ke andar embedded hona hai. Ye different tissue types aur body organs ko bind, support aur protect karta hai. Cartilage solid flexible supportive connective tissue hai jiska matrix chondroitin salts se rich hota hai; Bone dense, rigid mineralized skeletal connective tissue hai jisme calcium phosphate hydroxyapatite crystals deposit hote hain; aur Blood tatha Lymph specialized fluid connective tissues hain jinka extracellular matrix fluid plasma/lymph liquid hota hai jo immune protection aur transport function serve karte hain.

qe: The largest part of the human brain is:
qh: मानव मस्तिष्क का सबसे बड़ा भाग है:
e: Cerebrum (Cerebral Hemispheres) human brain ka largest aur developmentally most advanced superior anatomical part hai, jo total intracranial brain mass ka lagbhag 80 se 85 percent share represent karta hai. Deep midline longitudinal cerebral fissure ise Right aur Left Cerebral Hemispheres mein divide karta hai, jo deep white matter band 'Corpus Callosum' dwara internally connected rehte hain. Inki outer corrugated layer Cerebral Cortex hoti hai jisme billions of neurons, gyri folds aur sulci grooves hote hain. Cerebrum consciousness, logical thinking, voluntary motor commands, sensory integration, memory storage aur speech language centers ko house karta hai.

qe: Which part of the brain acts as a relay station for sensory information?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग संवेदी जानकारी के लिए रिले स्टेशन के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: Thalamus forebrain ke diencephalon region mein positioned bilateral symmetric egg-shaped gray matter mass hai. Ise universal sensory relay station aur processing gateway kaha jata hai. Peripheral sensory receptors se nikalne wale somatic touch sensations, thermal gradients, pain pathways, auditory acoustical impulses aur visual photoreceptor streams sensory ascending tracts ke through pehle thalamic specific sensory nuclei mein synapses form karte hain. Yahan sensory information filter, modulate aur reorganize hoti hai aur specific corresponding primary sensory cerebral cortices (jaise postcentral gyrus, calcarine visual cortex) par relay hoti hai (except olfaction).

qe: The membranes that cover and protect the brain and spinal cord are called:
qh: मस्तिष्क और रीढ़ की हड्डी को ढंकने और सुरक्षित करने वाली झिल्लियाँ कहलाती हैं:
e: Central Nervous System (brain aur spinal cord) ko external physical trauma aur infections se protect karne ke liye teen continuous concentric connective tissue envelopes cover karte hain jinhe collectively Meninges kehte hain. Outermost tough, inelastic fibrous layer Dura Mater hoti hai jo cranial bones ki inner surface se attach rehti hai; middle non-vascular cobweb-like membrane Arachnoid Mater hoti hai; aur innermost microscopic vascular sheath Pia Mater hoti hai jo nervous tissue surface contours se chipki rehti hai. Arachnoid aur pia ke intermediate subarachnoid space mein cerebrospinal fluid circulate hokar shock-absorbing hydrodynamic buoyancy ensure karta hai.

qe: Which part of the brain regulates body temperature and hunger?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग शरीर के तापमान और भूख को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Hypothalamus diencephalon ka ventral sub-thalamic region hai jo body ka master autonomic aur physiological thermostat coordinate karta hai. Iske specific specialized neural nuclei homeostatic parameters monitor karte hain: Anterior nucleus heat loss (sweating, vasodilation) trigger karta hai jabki Posterior nucleus heat conservation (shivering, vasoconstriction) command karta hai taaki core body temperature approximately 37°C maintain rahe. Sath hi Lateral hypothalamic area hunger drive initiate karta hai (feeding center) aur Ventromedial nucleus food intake stop karne ka satiety signal activate karta hai (satiety center), sath hi fluid thirst aur osmoregulation balance karta hai.

qe: Coordination of voluntary movements and balance is the primary function of:
qh: स्वैच्छिक आंदोलनों और संतुलन का समन्वय किसका प्राथमिक कार्य है?
e: Cerebellum infratentorial compartment mein positioned motor coordinator hai jiska core purpose voluntary skeletal muscle contraction ko smooth, rhythmic aur spatially accurate banana hai. Movement execution ke dauran cerebral motor cortex se intended action plan aur somatic proprioceptive receptors se actual limb position ki ongoing sensory stream cerebellum ke Purkinje cells aur deep cerebellar nuclei mein process hoti hai. Cerebellum intention aur execution ke differences detect karke corrective inhibitory signals dispatch karta hai, jisse jerky erratic motions eliminate hoti hain aur stable equilibrium balance, muscular coordination aur smooth posture sustain rehta hai.

qe: Joints are classified based on their structure and:
qh: जोड़ों को उनकी संरचना और किसके आधार पर वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
oh: अनुमत गति की डिग्री - Movements (Degree of movement)
e: Arthrology (joints ki study) mein skeletal articulations ko do complementary primary schemes par classify kiya jata hai: Structural classification jo articulating surfaces ko join karne wale binding tissue matrix par depend karti hai (Fibrous, Cartilaginous aur Synovial); aur Functional classification jo joint dwara allow ki jaane wali physical mechanical movement ki degree aur freedom range par based hoti hai. Functional groups mein immovable joints (Synarthroses, jaise skull sutures), slightly movable joints (Amphiarthroses, jaise intervertebral discs) aur freely movable joints (Diarthroses, jaise synovial joints) shamil hote hain.

qe: The study of surface landmarks on the human body is known as:
qh: मानव शरीर पर सतही स्थलचिह्नों के अध्ययन को कहा जाता है:
oh: सर्फेस एनाटॉमी / सतही शरीर रचना विज्ञान (Surface Anatomy)
e: Surface Anatomy (Topographical Anatomy) descriptive clinical medicine ki wo specialized methodology hai jo uninjured intact living human body par skin surface contours aur palpable bony landmarks ka detailed assessment karti hai. Surface anatomy external bony prominences (jaise clavicle, spine of scapula, ASIS, tibial tuberosity) aur superficial soft tissue reference lines (mid-clavicular line, mid-axillary line) ko project karke deeper underlying internal organs (heart valves, lung fissures, liver margins, appendix McBurney's point, major neurovascular bundles) ki exact location reveal karti hai, jo physical clinical examination, biopsy punctures aur surgical access incisions ke liye critical guide hoti hai.

qe: Which blood vessels carry oxygenated blood away from the heart?
qh: कौन सी रक्त वाहिकाएं ऑक्सीजन युक्त रक्त को हृदय से दूर ले जाती हैं?
e: Systemic Arteries muscular, elastic thick-walled conducting conduit vessels hoti hain jo high hydrostatic pressure par oxygenated nutrient-rich blood ko left ventricle se systemic circulation ke peripheral tissues aur target organs tak transport karti hain. Primary systemic conduit trunk Aorta hoti hai jo progressively muscular distributing arteries aur terminal arterioles mein bifurcate hoti hai. Is rule ka single anatomical exception Pulmonary Arteries hoti hain, jo anatomical definition ke mutabiq heart se blood door le jaati hain lekin physiologically deoxygenated venous blood carry karke right ventricle se gas exchange ke liye lungs tak deliver karti hain.

qe: The double-layered membrane surrounding the lungs is called:
qh: फेफड़ों के चारों ओर की दोहरी परत वाली झिल्ली कहलाती है:
e: Pleura thoracic cavity mein dono lungs ko independently envelop aur protect karne wali closed double-layered serous membrane hoti hai. Iski inner continuous layer ko Visceral Pleura kehte hain jo lung parenchyma ke external lobes aur fissures se tightly adhere karti hai; aur outer continuous layer ko Parietal Pleura kehte hain jo inner thoracic chest wall, superior diaphragm surface aur lateral mediastinum ko line karti hai. In dono serous layers ke beech ek microscopic potential Pleural Cavity hoti hai jisme lubricating serous fluid bhara rehta hai, jo breathing respiratory cycles ke dauran surface friction eliminate karke surface tension se lung expansion facilitate karta hai.

qe: Which part of the respiratory system is also known as the 'Voice Box'?
qh: श्वसन तंत्र के किस भाग को 'वॉयस बॉक्स' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
e: Larynx (Voice Box) ek complex hollow cartilaginous organ hai jo upper respiratory passage mein pharynx aur continuous trachea ke intermediate situated hota hai (cervical spine $C_3-C_6$ level). Iska architectural framework nine structural cartilages (unpaired thyroid, cricoid, epiglottis aur paired arytenoid, corniculate, cuneiform) aur intrinsic muscles se assembled hota hai. Larynx ka primary evolutionary function lower respiratory tract ko foreign body aspiration se protect karna aur cough reflex produce karna hai. Phonation ke dauran intrinsic laryngeal muscles true vocal cords (vocal folds) ki tension aur space adjust karti hain, jisse expired air flow vibration se human speech sound produce hota hai.

qe: Cartilage is an example of which type of tissue?
qh: कार्टिलेज किस प्रकार के ऊतक का एक उदाहरण है?
e: Cartilage ek specialized non-vascular skeletal connective tissue hai jo flexibility, structural firmness aur mechanical compression resistance provide karta hai. Iska extracellular solid matrix dense protein collagen fibers ya elastin fibers aur water-trapping proteoglycans (chondroitin sulfate) se construct hota hai, jiske lacunae chambers mein specialized Chondrocyte living cells reside karti hain. Cartilage avascular hota hai aur perichondrium membrane se slow passive diffusion dwara nutrient exchange maintain karta hai. Body mein ye teen standard histological types mein paya jata hai: Hyaline cartilage (articular surfaces, tracheal rings), Elastic cartilage (epiglottis, external ear) aur Fibrocartilage (intervertebral discs, joint menisci).

qe: The Urogenital system includes which two major systems?
qh: मूत्रजननांगी प्रणाली में कौन सी दो प्रमुख प्रणालियाँ शामिल हैं?
oh: मूत्र और जननांग / प्रजनन प्रणाली (Urinary and Genital/Reproductive system)
e: Urogenital System (Genitourinary system) do physiological aur functional organ systems—Urinary System aur Genital (Reproductive) System—ka unified structural grouping hai. Embryological development ke dauran dono systems common intermediate mesoderm layer se originate hote hain, pelvi-abdominal visceral space mein close anatomical proximity maintain karte hain, aur specific common conduits share karte hain (jaise males mein urethra urinary fluid aur reproductive seminal fluid dono ke conduction ke liye common terminal channel hoti hai). Is integration ke chalte clinical medicine aur radiology mein inke developmental disorders, imaging assessments aur pathological conditions interconnected study kiye jaate hain.

qe: Which histological component is responsible for transmitting electrical impulses?
qh: विद्युत आवेगों को प्रसारित करने के लिए कौन सा हिस्टोलॉजिकल घटक जिम्मेदार है?
e: Nervous Tissue body ka specialized electro-chemically excitable primary communication network hai jo information reception, signal processing aur rapid transmission manage karta hai. Is tissue ka functional core cellular unit Neuron (nerve cell) hota hai. Neurons specialized anatomical structures se compose hote hain: cell body (soma), incoming signals receive karne wale branching Dendrites, aur outward bio-electrical signals conduct karne wala elongated Axon. Axon membrane ke voltage-gated sodium/potassium ion channels rapid ionic flux create karke action potentials propagate karte hain, jo synaptic junctions par chemical neurotransmitters release karke target tissues tak microseconds mein electrical impulses deliver karte hain.

qe: The repair of bones after a fracture is a function studied under:
qh: फ्रैक्चर के बाद हड्डियों की मरम्मत का अध्ययन किसके अंतर्गत किया जाता है?
e: Fracture healing aur biological bone regeneration skeletal biology aur Osteology ke dynamic functions ka primary focus area hai. Jab bone fracture trauma sustain karti hai, osteology repair ki sequential phases study karti hai: Pehle fractured vessel disruption se localized fracture hematoma aur acute inflammatory response form hota hai; phir periosteal progenitor cells fibrocartilaginous soft callus formulate karte hain; osteoblasts woven mineralized bone synthesize karke hard bony callus banate hain; aur end mein osteoclasts aur mechanical stress remodeling ke through original trabecular architecture aur bone strength restore karte hain, jo radiology mein diagnostic imaging union evaluate karne ka standard benchmark banta hai.

qe: What is the primary role of divalent europium (Eu²⁺) in the BaFX:Eu²⁺ phosphor crystal used in PSP plates?
qh: PSP प्लेट में फॉस्फोर क्रिस्टल के रूप में उपयोग होने वाले BaFX:Eu²⁺ में डाइवलेंट यूरोपियम (Eu²⁺) की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
oe: To balance the physical weight of the plate
To act as electron traps and luminescence centers (Activator)
To protect the plate from physical scratches
oh: प्लेट के भौतिक वजन को संतुलित करना
इलेक्ट्रॉन ट्रैप और ल्यूमिनेसेंस केंद्र (एक्टिवेटर) के रूप में कार्य करना
लेज़र बीम को बाहर जाने से रोकना
प्लेट को खरोंचों से सुरक्षित रखना
e: Computed Radiography (CR) mein Photostimulable Phosphor (PSP) plate ka active functional material Barium Fluorohalide hota hai, jisme Europium ko activator ke roop mein trace amount mein add kiya jata hai. Jab diagnostic X-ray photons plate par incident hote hain, toh host crystal lattice ke electrons ionize ho jaate hain. Divalent Europium ($Eu^{2+}$) in electrons ko metastable energy states par trap karne ke liye F-centers (halogen vacancies) formulate karta hai, jisse invisible latent image create hoti hai. Readout phase mein laser stimulation ke dauran yahi trapped electrons wapas lower energy valence band mein drop hote hain aur characteristic blue-violet visible light emit karte hain. Bina $Eu^{2+}$ activator doping ke na toh stable latent energy storage possible hai aur na hi controlled luminescence luminescence read out ho sakti hai.

qe: Which layer is designed in the PSP plate of a CR cassette to reduce electrostatic charges and dust accumulation?
qh: CR कैसेट की PSP प्लेट में इलेक्ट्रोस्टैटिक चार्ज और धूल संचय को कम करने के लिए कौन सी परत डिज़ाइन की जाती है?
e: CR imaging cycle mein PSP plate cassette ke andar aur automatic laser reader ke mechanized rollers ke through repeatedly mechanical transport undergo karti hai. Continuous sliding aur physical contact friction se plate par static electricity charge build up ho jata hai. Static voltage discharge hone par na sirf emulsion par black branching static marks (artifacts) appear ho sakte hain, balki charged surface airborne dust aur debris particles ko magnetically attract karti hai jo laser scanning pathway ko block kar dete hain. Is hazard ko neutralize karne ke liye phosphor layer aur base support ke beech ek Conductive/Antistatic layer place ki jaati hai jo electro-conductive material se static charges ko safely dissipate kar deti hai, jisse plate ki operational life aur diagnostic image quality extend hoti hai.

qe: Which wavelength of laser beam is typically used in a CR reader to stimulate the trapped electrons?
qh: CR रीडर में ट्रैप्ड इलेक्ट्रॉनों को उत्तेजित (stimulate) करने के लिए आमतौर पर किस तरंगदैर्घ्य (wavelength) की लेज़र बीम का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Computed Radiography reader mein Photostimulated Luminescence (PSL) trigger karne ke liye Red spectrum laser ka use kiya jata hai, jiski nominal wavelength approximately 633 nm (Helium-Neon gas laser) ya 680 nm (solid-state semiconductor laser diode) hoti hai. Ye specific red photon energy trapped electrons ko metastable F-centers se un-trap karke conduction band tak elevate karne ke liye thermodynamically exact quantum energy level provide karti hai. Red laser select karne ka dusra sabse critical engineering reason ye hai ki ye emitted blue-violet light (~400 nm) se wavelength profile mein widely separated rehti hai. Is distinct optical gap ki wajah se optical filters laser reflection ko complete block kar dete hain aur detector tak sirf pure diagnostic light signal transmit hota hai.

qe: What is the color and wavelength of the light emitted from the PSP plate during the Photostimulated Luminescence (PSL) process?
qh: Photostimulated Luminescence (PSL) प्रक्रिया के दौरान PSP प्लेट से निकलने वाले प्रकाश का रंग और तरंगदैर्घ्य क्या होता है?
e: Jab CR reader ki focused red laser beam (~633 nm) phosphor crystal ke F-centers par padti hai, toh trapped electrons instant thermal stimulation paakar higher unstable state par excite hote hain aur fraction of microsecond mein ground state Europium ions ($Eu^{2+}$) par transition karte hain. Is transition energy drop ke dauran electrons stored latent energy ko release karte hain jo short-wavelength, high-energy Blue-violet photons (~390 se 400 nm) ke roop mein bahar aati hai. Is process ko Photostimulated Luminescence (PSL) kehte hain. Emitted light ki total photon intensity directly us anatomical region par absorb hue original X-ray dose ke proportional hoti hai, jise photomultiplier tube capture karke digital quantitative matrix mein decode karti hai.

qe: Which component in the CR reader is responsible for converting the emitted faint light into an amplified electrical signal?
qh: CR रीडर में उत्सर्जित मंद प्रकाश को विद्युत सिग्नल में बदलकर प्रवर्धित (amplify) करने का कार्य किसका है?
e: PSP plate se release hone wali photostimulated blue luminescence light optical intensity mein behad weak hoti hai. Is faint optical signal ko collect karne ke baad light guide assembly Photomultiplier Tube (PMT) ya Photodiode par focus karti hai. PMT ke photocathode par blue photons strike hote hi photoelectric effect ke zariye photoelectrons eject hote hain. Ye electrons internal dynodes ki continuous series se accelerate hote hain, jahan secondary emission ke zariye signal thousands to millions fold mathematically amplify ho jata hai. PMT is converted analog electrical continuous voltage wave ko system ke Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) ko forward karti hai, jahan continuous voltage discrete mathematical numbers aur pixels mein translate hota hai.

qe: What is used to erase the residual latent image trapped in the PSP plate after the reading process is complete?
qh: रीडिंग के बाद PSP प्लेट में बची हुई अवशिष्ट (residual) लेटेंट इमेज को मिटाने (Erase) के लिए क्या उपयोग किया जाता है?
oe: High-intensity white light or sodium vapor lamps
oh: तीव्र श्वेत प्रकाश या सोडियम वाष्प लैंप (High-intensity white light)
e: Laser beam scanning ke dauran PSP plate mein stored lagbhag 50% electrons release hokar signal emit karte hain, jabki bache hue residual trapped electrons crystal lattice ke deep energy states mein hi phased reh jaate hain. Agar in electrons ko clear na kiya jaye, toh previous patient ki anatomy next exposure par ghost shadow ban kar persist karegi. Isliye read cycle ke immediately baad plate reader ke Erase Section mein pass hoti hai, jahan bank of high-intensity white fluorescent lights ya sodium vapor discharge lamps active hote hain. Ye intense white light spectrum plate ko flooded illumination deti hai jisse remaining trapped electrons ground valence state mein collapse hokar plate ko zero residual background par completely reset kar dete hain.

qe: Which artifact appears on the subsequent radiographic image if the eraser lamp in the CR reader fails or the erase cycle is incomplete?
qh: यदि CR रीडर में इरेज़र लैंप ठीक से काम न करे या इरेज़र चक्र अपूर्ण रह जाए, तो अगली इमेज में कौन सा आर्टिफ़ैक्ट दिखाई देगा?
e: CR imaging workflow mein 'Ghosting Artifact' (ya Image Lag) tab generate hota hai jab PSP plate par purana latent image record residual form mein reh jaata hai. Aisa tab hota hai jab erasure unit ke high-intensity light bulbs age hone par flicker karein, illumination intensity drop ho jaye, plate read session ke baad un-erased prolonged period tak padi rahe, ya heavy anatomical over-exposure hua ho. Incomplete clearance ki wajah se next new patient ke fresh X-ray exposure ke sath purani anatomy (jaise bony margins ya radio-opaque markers) faint superimposition ke roop mein overlap dikhti hai, jisse false clinical interpretation aur mandatory repeat exposures ka risk create hota hai.

qe: What is the primary cause of the Moiré pattern artifact appearing in Computed Radiography (CR)?
qh: CR इमेजिंग में Moiré pattern आर्टिफ़ैक्ट बनने का मुख्य कारण क्या है?
oe: Interference between stationary grid frequency and CR reader laser scan line frequency
Accumulation of fine dust particles on the phosphor screen
Application of excessively high operational kVp values
Deposition of chemical sludge inside the light guide tube
oh: स्टेशनरी ग्रिड आवृत्ति और लेज़र स्कैन लाइन आवृत्ति के बीच हस्तक्षेप (Interference)
फॉस्फोर स्क्रीन पर धूल के कणों का जमना
लाइट गाइड ट्यूब का गंदा होना
e: Moiré pattern ek spatial frequency aliasing artifact hai jo CR image par geometric wavy lines, corduroy cloth pattern ya zebra stripes ke format mein visually appear hota hai. Ye tab trigger hota hai jab stationary anti-scatter grid use ki jaati hai aur grid ki lead strip frequency CR reader ke laser raster beam sampling pitch frequency ke nearly identical ya harmonic match par aa jaati hai. Sabse severe interference tab occur hoti hai jab grid lead strips reader ke laser scanning raster direction ke exactly parallel align hoti hain. Is issue ko prevent karne ke liye high-frequency grids (>60 lines/cm), moving bucky systems, ya grid lines ko laser scan path ke perpendicular orientation mein positioning di jaati hai.

qe: Which component in Indirect Flat Panel Detectors (FPD) converts incoming X-ray photons into visible light?
qh: Indirect Flat Panel Detectors में X-ray फोटॉनों को दृश्य प्रकाश (visible light) में परिवर्तित करने वाला घटक कौन सा है?
oh: सिंटिलेटर परत - जैसे CsI:Tl या Gd₂O₂S (Scintillator layer)
e: Indirect Digital Flat Panel Detectors do sequential physical steps par image construct karte hain: X-ray se visible light, aur phir light se electric charge. Is process ka pehla converting interface Scintillator layer hoti hai. Scintillator Phosphor materials jaise Thallium-doped Cesium Iodide ($CsI:Tl$) ya Gadolinium Oxysulfide ($Gd_2O_2S:Tb$) se construct kiya jata hai. Jab high-energy X-ray photons scintillator material se collide karte hain, fluorescence mechanism ke zariye incident X-ray energy instantly green-spectrum visible light photons mein convert ho jaati hai. Ye converted light secondary amorphous silicon ($a-Si$) photodiode layer par strike karti hai jo use readable electrical charges mein transform karta hai.

qe: Why is a Cesium Iodide (CsI:Tl) scintillator considered superior to Gadolinium Oxysulfide (Gd₂O₂S)?
qh: Cesium Iodide (CsI:Tl) सिंटिलेटर को Gadolinium Oxysulfide (Gd₂O₂S) की तुलना में बेहतर क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: It is much cheaper and easier to manufacture structurally
Its columnar needle-like crystalline structure channels light and minimizes lateral light spread
It completely eliminates the need for an underlying photodiode array
It attenuates 100% of all incident X-ray photons without fluorescence
oh: यह सस्ता और निर्माण में आसान होता है
इसकी सुई जैसी (स्तंभकार) संरचना प्रकाश के पार्श्व फैलाव को कम करती है (Columnar structure)
इसे किसी भी फोटोडायोड की आवश्यकता नहीं होती
यह पूरी तरह से एक्स-रे को ब्लॉक कर देता है
e: Gadolinium Oxysulfide ($Gd_2O_2S$) turbid crystalline powder form mein hota hai jisme generated light omnidirectional isotropic scattering karti hai, jisse adjacent pixels par light bleed hoti hai aur spatial unsharpness increase hoti hai. Iske contrast mein, Cesium Iodide ($CsI$) ko high-vacuum chamber mein vertically vapor-deposited karke microscopic columnar (needle-like) crystals (5-10 $\mu$m diameter) ke form mein grow kiya jata hai. Ye crystalline needles miniature fiber-optic light pipes ki tarah behave karti hain. Total internal reflection ke principle par visible light photons laterally spread hone ke bajaye vertically direct underlying photodiode pixels tak guide hote hain, jisse thick layer ke sath bhi high DQE aur superior spatial resolution preserve rehti hai.

qe: What is the correct sequence of signal conversion in an Indirect Flat Panel Detector?
qh: Indirect Flat Panel Detector में सिग्नल रूपांतरण का सही क्रम क्या है?
oh: एक्स-रे → दृश्य प्रकाश → विद्युत आवेश (X-ray → Visible Light → Electric Charge)
e: Indirect Flat Panel Detector technology do-tier sequential conversion chain follow karti hai. Stage 1: Patient se transmit hokar aane wale primary X-ray photons upper Scintillator layer (CsI ya $Gd_2O_2S$) par strike karte hain, jahan photon interaction ke baad X-ray photons optical visible light photons mein transform hote hain. Stage 2: Ye generated visible light photons underlying Amorphous Silicon ($a-Si$) semiconductor photodiode matrix par fall karte hain. Photodiodes light absorption ke proportionate localized electric charge pairs (electrons aur holes) generate karti hain jo storage capacitors par deposit hote hain. Aage chalkar TFT switches in charges ko scanlines ke zariye ADC par send karte hain jo final digital matrix output generate karta hai.

qe: Which photoconductor material is used in Direct Conversion Flat Panel Detectors to convert X-rays straight into electric charge?
qh: Direct Conversion Flat Panel Detectors में एक्स-रे फोटॉनों को सीधे चार्ज में बदलने के लिए किस फोटोकंडक्टर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Direct Conversion Flat Panel Detectors mein intermediate light emission stage completely absent hoti hai. Is system ka primary active functional element Amorphous Selenium ($a-Se$) layer hota hai jo ek non-crystalline high-resistivity photoconductor hai. Jab incident X-ray photons amorphous selenium layer par fall karte hain, toh photoelectric absorption aur Compton interactions ke zariye selenium valence band electrons directly conduction band mein promote ho jaate hain. Is single-step process se electron-hole charge pairs generate hote hain. Kyunki yahan intermediate optical phosphor step nahi hota, photon scatter blur ka koi chance nahi banta, jisse inherently sharp edge boundary profile maintain rehti hai.

qe: Why is a high electric bias voltage applied across the Amorphous Selenium layer in Direct Conversion detectors?
qh: Direct Conversion डिटेक्टर्स में Amorphous Selenium लेयर पर उच्च वोल्टेज (High bias voltage) क्यों लगाया जाता है?
oe: To guide electron-hole pairs along vertical electric field lines without lateral divergence
To regulate internal operating temperature inside the detector cassette
To induce intense secondary visible light luminescence
To chemically preserve the selenium material from atmospheric oxidation
oh: इलेक्ट्रॉन-होल जोड़ों को बिना पार्श्व फैलाव के सीधा इलेक्ट्रोड पर आकर्षित करने के लिए
डिटेक्टर प्लेट के आंतरिक तापमान को नियंत्रित करने के लिए
तीव्र द्वितीयक दृश्य प्रकाश उत्पन्न करने के लिए
सेलेनियम को रासायनिक रूप से स्थिर रखने के लिए
e: Direct digital flat panel detectors mein 500 $\mu$m thick amorphous selenium layer ke across top electrode aur bottom TFT array ke beech multiple kilovolts (lagbhag 5000 se 10000 Volts DC) ka High Bias Voltage continuously maintain kiya jata hai. Ye high electrical gradient selenium layer ke andar ek strong parallel, vertical electric field build karta hai. X-ray absorption se jaise hi electron-hole charge pairs create hote hain, ye electric field force unhe instantaneously capture kar leta hai.
