Negative electrons aur positive holes bina kisi lateral sideways diffusion ya spread ke strictly vertical straight trajectories par bottom collection capacitors par pull hote hain, jisse absolute micro-level spatial sharpness provide hoti hai.

qe: Why are Direct Conversion (a-Se) detectors primarily preferred in Digital Mammography?
qh: मैमोग्राफी में मुख्य रूप से Direct Conversion (a-Se) डिटेक्टर्स को प्राथमिकता क्यों दी जाती है?
oe: They eliminate the requirement for any lead shielding protection
Absence of intermediate light spread yields ultra-high spatial resolution needed to detect microcalcifications
They represent the least expensive flat panel manufacturing technology
They construct anatomical images without ionizing X-ray interaction
oh: इनमें किसी भी रेडिएशन शील्डिंग की आवश्यकता नहीं होती
प्रकाश फैलाव न होने से माइक्रो-कैल्सीफिकेशन देखने हेतु अति-उच्च स्थानिक रिज़ॉल्यूशन मिलता है
यह सबसे सस्ता निर्माण विकल्प है
यह बिना एक्स-रे के इमेज बनाता है
e: Full-Field Digital Mammography (FFDM) mein earliest stages of breast carcinoma detect karne ke liye microscopic microcalcifications (50 se 100 microns size) aur subtle soft-tissue architectural distortions visualize karna primary clinical goal hota hai. Indirect detectors mein scintillator se light emit hone par light isotropic spread karti hai, jisse fine margins blur ho jaate hain. Direct a-Se detectors intermediate light formation ko completely bypass karte hain. High electric bias field charges ko seedhe perpendicularly pull karta hai bina kisi transverse blur ke, jisse 10 se 20 lp/mm tak ka exceptionally high spatial resolution achieve hota hai, jo micro-calcification detection ke liye clinical gold standard hai.

qe: In the context of a Detector Element (DEL), how is 'Fill Factor' defined?
qh: एक डिटेक्टर एलिमेंट (DEL) के संदर्भ में 'Fill Factor' को कैसे परिभाषित किया जाता है?
oe: Total DEL Structural Area / Radiation Sensing Area
Radiation Sensing Area / Total DEL Structural Area
Storage Capacitor Area / Thin Film Transistor Switch Area
Matrix Acquisition Size / Total System Field of View
oh: कुल DEL क्षेत्र / विकिरण संवेदी क्षेत्र
विकिरण संवेदी क्षेत्र / कुल DEL क्षेत्र - Fill Factor = (Sensing Area / Total DEL Area)
e: Flat panel detector surface billions of discrete square physical Detector Elements (DELs) se assemble hoti hai. Ek DEL ke physical envelope ke andar active radiation-sensitive sensing area (photodiode ya a-Se collection area) ke alawa electronic circuitry shamil hoti hai—jaise Thin Film Transistor (TFT) switch, conductive address lines, read data lines aur storage capacitor. 'Fill Factor' mathematically radiation-sensitive active area aur total physical DEL geometric footprint area ka percentage ratio hota hai: $\text{Fill Factor} = (\text{Sensing Area} / \text{Total DEL Area}) \times 100$. Fill factor jitna high hoga, detector ki photon capture efficiency aur radiation sensitivity utni hi superior hogi.

qe: If a detector element (DEL) size is reduced to improve spatial resolution, what effect will it have on the Fill Factor and DQE?
qh: यदि किसी डिटेक्टर का DEL आकार छोटा कर दिया जाए (स्थानिक रिज़ॉल्यूशन बढ़ाने के लिए), तो Fill Factor और DQE पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
oe: Both Fill Factor and Detective Quantum Efficiency will increase proportionally
Fill Factor will decrease, potentially reducing DQE and detector radiation sensitivity
Fill Factor remains completely unaffected by geometric miniaturization
Detective Quantum Efficiency will reach 100 percent theoretical efficiency
oh: Fill Factor और DQE दोनों आनुपातिक रूप से बढ़ जाएंगे
Fill Factor घटेगा, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप DQE और डिटेक्टर संवेदनशीलता कम हो सकती है
Fill Factor पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ेगा
e: Spatial resolution improve karne ke liye jab detector element (DEL) ke physical pitch ko shrink kiya jata hai, toh ek technological trade-off encounter hota hai. DEL ke andar electronic components (TFT gate switch, address lines, bias rails aur storage capacitor) ka physical size semiconductor fabrication limits ki wajah se ek fixed cutoff limit se chhota nahi kiya ja sakta. Consequently, total DEL area reduce hone par electronics ka occupied percentage badh jata hai aur radiation capture sensing area drastically drop ho jata hai, jisse Fill Factor decrease ho jata hai. Low fill factor hone par incoming X-ray photons non-sensitive electronic components par waste hote hain, jisse overall Detective Quantum Efficiency (DQE) aur low-dose performance degrade ho sakti hai.

qe: What component acts as an electronic switch for pixel readout in each detector element (DEL) of a Flat Panel Detector?
qh: एक Flat Panel Detector के प्रत्येक पिक्सेल (DEL) में रीडआउट के लिए इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्विच के रूप में क्या लगा होता है?
oh: थिन फिल्म ट्रांजिस्टर - Thin Film Transistor (TFT)
e: Flat panel detectors ke active matrix array (AMA) mein har single pixel element (DEL) ke corner par ek micro-electronic switch integrated hota hai jise Thin-Film Transistor (TFT) kehte hain. Exposure capture phase ke dauran TFTs 'OFF' non-conducting state mein rehte hain, jisse X-ray interactions se generate hua continuous electric charge DEL ke storage capacitor par safely accumulate rehta hai. Readout phase mein row driver circuits specific horizontal control gate line ko sequential positive pulse dekar us row ke sabhi TFTs ko turn 'ON' kar dete hain. Stored charge instant drain hokar vertical column data lines ke through charge-sensitive amplifiers aur ADC conversion stage par read out ho jata hai.

qe: Which coupling mechanism is used in CCD and CMOS imaging systems to convey light from the scintillator to the sensor with minimal signal loss?
qh: CCD और CMOS इमेजिंग सिस्टम में सिंटिलेटर से उत्पन्न प्रकाश को सेंसर चिप तक न्यूनतम प्रकाश हानि के साथ पहुँचाने के लिए किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
oe: Fiber-optic coupling (Fiber-optic plate or tapered bundle)
oh: फाइबर ऑप्टिक कपलिंग - प्लेट या टेपर (Fiber-optic plate/taper)
e: Charge-Coupled Device (CCD) aur Complementary Metal-Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) sensor chips physical surface area mein miniature dimension (2-4 cm square) ki hoti hain, jabki diagnostic imaging field of view bada (35 se 43 cm) hota hai. Large scintillator screen par release hone wali visible light ko small sensor matrix tak transfer karne ke liye optical coupling ki zaroorat padti hai. Optical lenses refractive efficiency loss aur geometric spherical distortion generate karti hain. Isliye direct contact Fiber-Optic Bundles (Fiber Optic Taper / Faceplate) use kiye jaate hain. Ye microscopic total internal reflection light channels light transmission efficiency ko drastically optimize karte hain bina light flare aur spatial distortion create kiye.

qe: If the Field of View (FOV) is 300 mm and the Matrix Size is 1024 × 1024, what is the resulting Pixel Size?
qh: यदि Field of View (FOV) 300 mm है और Matrix Size 1024 × 1024 है, तो पिक्सेल का आकार (Pixel Size) क्या होगा?
e: Digital radiography aur medical computed imaging mein digital image ka spatial resolution directly pixel dimensions par depend karta hai. Pixel dimension calculate karne ka universal mathematical relationship hota hai: $\text{Pixel Size} = \text{Field of View (FOV)} / \text{Matrix Size}$. Is problem statement mein FOV $300\text{ mm}$ diya gaya hai aur digital matrix linear resolution $1024\text{ pixels}$ hai. Formula apply karne par: $\text{Pixel Size} = 300\text{ mm} / 1024 \approx 0.293\text{ mm}$ (ya $293\,\mu\text{m}$). Agar FOV constant rakhte hue matrix size badha diya jaye, toh pixel size shrink hoga jisse image ki spatial detail resolution enhance ho jayegi.

qe: What is the physical distance between the centers of two adjacent pixels called?
qh: दो आसन्न (adjacent) पिक्सेलों के केंद्रों के बीच की दूरी को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Digital imaging displays aur digital flat-panel detectors mein 'Pixel Pitch' ek pixel ke exact center coordinates se uske immediate adjacent pixel ke center coordinates ke beech physical linear distance ko define karta hai, jise microns ($\,\mu\text{m}$) mein measure kiya jata hai. Pixel pitch pixel ke aperture physical size aur dono pixels ke intermediate non-sensing interspacing boundary lines dono ko cover karta hai. Pixel pitch jitna minimum aur narrow hoga, per unit millimeter area pixels ka population density count utna high hoga. Consequently, fine anatomical trabeculae sharpness aur spatial resolution significantly enhance hoti hai.

qe: How many distinct shades of gray can an imaging system display if it possesses a Bit Depth of 12 bits?
qh: 12-bit की Bit Depth वाला एक इमेजिंग सिस्टम कितने ग्रे शेड्स (Shades of Gray) प्रदर्शित कर सकता है?
e: Digital imaging systems mein 'Bit Depth' (pixel depth) kisi pixel dwara store kiye ja sakne wale binary bits ($0$ aur $1$) ke maximum number ko signify karti hai. Ye system ke contrast resolution aur gray dynamic range ko mathematically define karti hai. Available shades of gray ka total number calculate karne ka binary formula $2^n$ hota hai, jahan $n$ bit depth value hai. Given $12\text{-bit}$ system ke liye: $2^{12} = 4096$ discrete gray shades available hote hain. High bit depth display systems subtle anatomical attenuation variations (jaise soft tissue masses aur fluids) ko clinically distinguish karne ke liye exceptional contrast differentiation provide karte hain.

qe: If a detector exhibits a pixel size of 0.1 mm (100 µm), what is its theoretical maximum Nyquist Frequency (spatial resolution limit)?
qh: यदि किसी डिटेक्टर का पिक्सेल आकार 0.1 mm (100 µm) है, तो उसकी Nyquist Frequency (अधिकतम सैद्धांतिक स्थानिक रिज़ॉल्यूशन) क्या होगी?
e: Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem ke anusar kisi spatial object line-pair pattern ko accurately resolve aur record karne ke liye sampling frequency line frequency se kam se kam double honi mandatory hai. Ek line pair mein ek dense absorbing line aur ek radiolucent space (do elements) shamil hote hain, isliye Nyquist cutoff frequency ka mathematical formula $f_N = 1 / (2 \times \text{Pixel Size})$ hota hai. Is scenario mein pixel size $0.1\text{ mm}$ diya gaya hai: $f_N = 1 / (2 \times 0.1\text{ mm}) = 1 / 0.2\text{ mm} = 5\text{ lp/mm}$. Agar anatomical line structure frequency $5\text{ lp/mm}$ se exceed karegi, toh digital aliasing distortion aur false Moiré artifacts create ho jayenge.

qe: What metric quantifies a detector's efficiency in converting X-ray photons into an image, defined as the squared ratio of output SNR to input SNR?
qh: डिटेक्टर की एक्स-रे फोटॉनों को उपयोगी सिग्नल में बदलने की दक्षता और आउटपुट SNR बनाम इनपुट SNR के अनुपात के वर्ग को क्या कहा जाता है?
oh: डिटेक्टिव क्वांटम एफिशिएंसी - Detective Quantum Efficiency (DQE)
e: Detective Quantum Efficiency (DQE) medical digital imaging detector systems ki radiation dose efficiency aur signal transfer quality measure karne ka ultimate standard quantitative parameter hai. Ye measure karta hai ki incoming radiation photons mein available Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) detector electrical output par kitne fidelity ke sath preserve rehta hai: $\text{DQE} = (\text{SNR}_{\text{out}})^2 / (\text{SNR}_{\text{in}})^2$. High DQE rating wala detector system low operational patient exposure dose par bhi crystal-clear low-noise diagnostic images deliver kar sakta hai, jo patient protection aur ALARA compliance ke liye crucial benchmark hota hai.

qe: What is the typical descending order of Detective Quantum Efficiency (DQE) among common medical imaging modalities?
qh: आमतौर पर विभिन्न इमेजिंग तकनीकों में DQE (Detective Quantum Efficiency) का सही अवरोही क्रम (Descending order) क्या है?
oe: Conventional Film-Screen > Computed Radiography (CR) > Direct Digital Radiography (DDR)
Direct Digital Radiography (DDR) > Computed Radiography (CR) > Conventional Film-Screen
Computed Radiography (CR) > Conventional Film-Screen > Direct Digital Radiography (DDR)
Conventional Film-Screen > Direct Digital Radiography (DDR) > Computed Radiography (CR)
e: Detective Quantum Efficiency (DQE) evaluation mein direct digital flat panel detectors (DDR) highest operational performance represent karte hain. DDR Flat Panel Detectors (especially structured CsI indirect aur a-Se direct systems) ki DQE lagbhag 60% se 70% achieve hoti hai, jiska matlab hai ki incident photons ka majority fraction diagnostic signal mein retain hota hai. Computed Radiography (CR) photostimulable phosphor systems lagbhag 30% DQE deliver karte hain light emission scattering losses ki wajah se. Traditional analog Film-Screen cassette combinations lowest performance deliver karte hain (approx 20% to 25% DQE). Is comparative sequence ka descending order DDR > CR > Film-Screen hota hai.

qe: In digital radiography exposure analysis, what does a Deviation Index (DI) value of '0' indicate?
qh: डिजिटल रेडियोग्राफी में Deviation Index (DI) का मान '0' (शून्य) क्या दर्शाता है?
oe: The clinical image is severely over-exposed
No measurable radiation exposure reached the detector surface
The radiation exposure perfectly matches the targeted institutional standard (Target EI)
The image suffers from catastrophic quantum mottle noise
oh: डिटेक्टर पर कोई एक्सपोज़र नहीं हुआ
एक्सपोज़र बिल्कुल लक्षित एक्सपोज़र (Target EI) के अनुरूप है (Target Exposure)
e: International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) standard ke mutabiq Deviation Index (DI) ek dimensionless quantitative feedback metric hai jo console operator ko batata hai ki detector par receive hua actual Exposure Index ($EI$) target reference exposure ($EI_T$) se kitna deviate hua hai: $\text{DI} = 10 \times \log_{10}(EI / EI_T)$. Agar $\text{DI} = 0$ hai, toh iska meaning hai ki detector exposure target institutional diagnostic level ke perfectly identical achieve hua hai. Positive DI values ($+1$ to $+3$) over-exposure indicate karti hain, jabki negative DI values ($-1$ to $-3$) under-exposure aur quantum mottle noise risk signify karti hain.

qe: In medical imaging information technology, what does a DICOM file encapsulate?
qh: मेडिकल इमेजिंग में उपयोग होने वाले DICOM मानक में एक इमेज फ़ाइल के अंदर क्या समाहित होता है?
oe: Raw unpacked pixel data exclusively without identifiers
Patient demographics and acquisition metadata coupled with the raw pixel image data in a single file
oh: मेटाडेटा (जनसांख्यिकी) और इमेज पिक्सेल डेटा दोनों एक साथ (Header + Pixel Data)
e: Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) standard format medical images ko standalone raster images (jaise standard JPEG ya PNG) ki tarah store nahi karta. Har DICOM file ke structure mein ek standardized binary Header (Metadata) aur actual binary Image Pixel Data ek sath comprehensively encapsulate hote hain. DICOM header tag architecture contain karti hai jisme patient name, medical record ID, study accession number, acquisition modality parameters (kVp, mAs, slice thickness), institutional origin aur calibration metrics shamil hote hain. Ye structural integration ensure karti hai ki clinical image kabhi bhi patient demographic identification se detach na ho sake.

qe: Which dedicated enterprise software system manages radiology patient scheduling, exam tracking, and diagnostic report generation?
qh: रेडियोलॉजी विभाग में मरीज़ों के अपॉइंटमेंट, शेड्यूलिंग, ट्रैकिंग और रेडियोलॉजिस्ट की रिपोर्ट तैयार करने के लिए कौन सा सॉफ्टवेयर सिस्टम समर्पित होता है?
oh: रेडियोलॉजी इंफॉर्मेशन सिस्टम - Radiology Information System (RIS)
e: Radiology Information System (RIS) dedicated clinical management software platform hai jo radiology departmental administrative workflow ko complete operational control provide karta hai. Jabki PACS medical visual images ke storage aur visual distribution ke liye responsible hota hai, RIS non-imaging core administrative data manage karta hai: patient registration, department scheduling, examination room booking, radiographer modality worklist distribution via DICOM modality worklist (DMWL), billing verification, diagnostic tracking aur radiologist interpretation transcription report formulation. RIS enterprise level par Hospital Information System (HIS) aur diagnostic PACS ke intermediate coordination link establish karta hai.

qe: Which standard protocol is employed for exchanging textual and clinical demographic information between medical software platforms like HIS, RIS, and EMR?
qh: विभिन्न मेडिकल सॉफ्टवेयर सिस्टम (जैसे HIS, RIS और EMR) के बीच टेक्स्ट-आधारित और नैदानिक डेटा के आदान-प्रदान के लिए कौन सा मानक प्रोटोकॉल उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Health Level Seven International (HL7) standard ANSI-accredited electronic data communication framework hai jo clinical healthcare systems (jaise Hospital Information System - HIS, Radiology Information System - RIS, Laboratory Information System - LIS, aur Electronic Medical Record - EMR) ke beech textual clinical aur administrative information exchange execute karta hai. HL7 standardized syntax message segments (jaise ADT patient admit/discharge, ORM order requests, ORU observation results) use karta hai. DICOM medical image visual files aur acquisition devices ko govern karta hai, jabki HL7 patient textual metadata ko smooth real-time cross-platform interchange provide karta hai.

qe: Which form of digital data compression is medically and legally approved for primary diagnostic interpretation in radiology?
qh: प्राइमरी डायग्नोस्टिक रेडियोलॉजी व्याख्या (Primary Interpretation) के लिए आमतौर पर किस प्रकार के डेटा कम्प्रेशन की अनुमति होती है?
oe: Lossless compression (ensuring zero loss of diagnostic pixel information)
Standard web JPEG baseline lossy algorithm
oh: लॉसलेस कम्प्रेशन - Lossless compression (शून्य डेटा हानि)
e: Radiological primary diagnostic interpretation ke clinical workflow mein sirf Lossless Compression algorithms (typically 2:1 ya 3:1 ratio, jaise reversible JPEG 2000 ya Run-Length Encoding) universally mandatory hote hain. Lossless compression digital image mathematical file size ko compress karti hai, lekin decompression ke time raw image ke original pixel numerical attenuation values ($100\%$) without any loss recreate ho jaate hain. Iske contrast mein Lossy compression redundant pixel details ko permanently discard kar deti hai, jisse subtle hairline fractures, microcalcifications aur faint tissue interfaces erase ho sakti hain, jo primary diagnosis mein clinically aur legally unacceptable hota hai.

qe: According to the Anode Heel Effect, what is the spatial distribution of the X-ray beam intensity?
qh: एनोड हील इफ़ेक्ट (Anode Heel Effect) के अनुसार एक्स-रे बीम की तीव्रता का वितरण कैसा होता है?
oe: Maximum intensity toward the anode and minimum toward the cathode
Higher intensity toward the cathode (~120%) and lower intensity toward the anode (~75%)
Uniform intensity across both ends relative to the central ray
Only low-energy photons are present toward the cathode side
oh: एनोड की ओर तीव्रता अधिकतम और कैथोड की ओर न्यूनतम होती है
कैथोड की ओर तीव्रता अधिक (~120%) और एनोड की ओर तीव्रता कम (~75%) होती है
सेंट्रल रे से दोनों सिरों पर तीव्रता पूरी तरह समान रहती है
कैथोड की ओर बीम में केवल लो-एनर्जी फोटॉन्स पाए जाते हैं
e: Anode Heel Effect target material ke geometrical arrangement aur target self-absorption ki wajah se hota hai. Jab accelerated projectile electrons beveled tungsten target mein thodi depth par penetrate karke X-ray photons produce karte hain, toh anode side nikalne wale photons ko target material ke thicker heel region se pass hona padta hai. Is intrinsic absorption ke chalte anode side beam intensity drop hokar nominal value ki lagbhag 75% reh jaati hai. Wahi cathode side nikalne wale photons target material ke thin margin se emerge hote hain, jisse unka self-absorption negligible rehta hai aur intensity badhkar lagbhag 120% ho jaati hai. Dono ends ke beech total intensity difference lagbhag 45% tak ho sakta hai.

qe: Under which combination of radiographic conditions is the Anode Heel Effect most pronounced?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किन परिस्थितियों में एनोड हील इफ़ेक्ट सबसे अधिक स्पष्ट (pronounced) दिखाई देगा?
oe: Large anode angle, long SID, and small field size
Small anode angle, short SID, and large field size
Small anode angle, long SID, and small field size
Large anode angle, short SID, and large field size
oh: बड़ा एनोड एंगल, लंबी SID और छोटा फील्ड साइज़
छोटा एनोड एंगल, कम SID और बड़ा फील्ड साइज़
छोटा एनोड एंगल, लंबी SID और छोटा फील्ड साइज़
बड़ा एनोड एंगल, कम SID और बड़ा फील्ड साइज़
e: Heel effect ka magnitude teen primary geometric factors par rely karta hai. Jab anode bevel angle small hota hai (less than 12 degrees), tab target ki physical heel anode-directed photons ke liye path length substantially badha deti hai, jisse self-attenuation peak ho jata hai. Source-to-Image Distance (SID) short hone par beam ka wide divergent perimeter receptor plane par land karta hai, jisse central ray se periphery ka intensity gradient visually amplify hota hai. Isi tarah large collimation field size ya wide image receptor size use karne se beam ke extreme peripheral zones capture hote hain jahan cathode aur anode intensity ka contrast maximum hota hai. Isliye small target angle, short distance aur wide field par heel effect sabse prominent dikhta hai.

qe: To utilize the Anode Heel Effect effectively, what is the correct clinical positioning for an AP view of the Femur?
qh: Femur (जांघ की हड्डी) के AP व्यू में हील इफ़ेक्ट का लाभ उठाने के लिए सही क्लिनिकल पोज़ीशनिंग क्या होगी?
oe: Orient the cathode toward the hip joint and the anode toward the knee
Orient the anode toward the hip joint and the cathode toward the knee
Orient the tube randomly regardless of cathode and anode placement
Center the central ray exclusively over the patella
oh: कैथोड को हिप जॉइंट की तरफ और एनोड को घुटने (Knee) की तरफ रखना
एनोड को हिप जॉइंट की तरफ और कैथोड को घुटने की तरफ रखना
कैथोड और एनोड किसी भी दिशा में रखे जा सकते हैं
सेंट्रल रे को केवल पटेला पर केंद्रित करना
e: Radiography ka universal positioning rule kehta hai ki tube ke high-intensity cathode terminal ko patient ke anatomically thicker aur denser body part par align karna chahiye. Femur bone mein proximal aspect (hip joint aur upper thigh muscle mass) distal aspect (knee joint aur lower femoral condyles) ki tulna mein considerably thick aur structurally dense hota hai. Proximal hip region ko penetrate karne ke liye higher photon fluence ki requirement hoti hai. Isliye cathode ko hip joint ki taraf orient karke dense soft tissue ko adequate optical density di jaati hai, jabki thinner knee joint ko anode side par rakha jata hai taaki wahan over-exposure aur burn-out prevent ho sake aur uniform radiograph prapt ho.

qe: How should the X-ray tube be oriented to achieve uniform optical density in AP Thoracic Spine radiography?
qh: Thoracic Spine AP रेडियोग्राफी में एक समान ऑप्टिकल डेंसिटी प्राप्त करने के लिए ट्यूब का ओरिएंटेशन कैसा होना चाहिए?
oe: Cathode toward the cervical neck and anode toward the abdomen
Cathode toward the abdomen/diaphragm and anode toward the cervical neck
Anode always toward the diaphragm regardless of anatomy
No specific tube orientation is required
oh: कैथोड गर्दन (Cervical) की ओर, एनोड पेट (Abdomen) की ओर
कैथोड पेट/निचले वक्ष (Diaphragm) की ओर, एनोड गर्दन की ओर
एनोड हमेशा डायफ्राम की ओर होना चाहिए
किसी विशिष्ट ओरिएंटेशन की आवश्यकता नहीं होती
e: Thoracic spine anatomy wedge-shaped thickness gradient display karti hai. Upper thoracic vertebrae (T1-T4) neck aur shoulder girdle ke proximity mein hone ke bawajood lower thorax ke comparison mein kafi thin aur less dense hote hain. Lower thoracic region (T9-T12) diaphragm, dense liver shadow aur upper abdominal organs se overlay hone ke kaaran substantially thick hota hai. Agar tube randomly orient ki jaye toh upper spine over-penetrate hokar black ho jayegi ya lower spine under-penetrated reh jayegi. Uniform image balance ke liye high-intensity cathode end ko lower thoracic/abdominal level par aur lower-intensity anode end ko superior cervical-thoracic level par orient kiya jata hai.

qe: Due to the Anode Heel Effect, how is the cathode aligned in a dedicated Mammography X-ray tube?
qh: मैमोग्राफी एक्स-रे ट्यूब में हील इफ़ेक्ट के कारण कैथोड को किस संरचना की ओर संरेखित (align) किया जाता है?
oe: Directly toward the center of the image receptor
oh: इमेज रिसेप्टर के केंद्र की ओर
e: Mammography mein compressed breast tissue uniform geometric cylinder nahi hota balki posterior chest wall par base thick aur dense glandular tissue se bana hota hai, jabki anterior apex nipple ki taraf taper hokar naturally thin ho jata hai. Mammography unit designers heel effect ko deliberate advantage ki tarah incorporate karte hain. X-ray tube ko rotate karke cathode ko strictly posterior chest wall ki taraf place kiya jata hai jahan highest photon intensity ki zaroorat hoti hai. Lower-intensity anode ko anterior aspect (nipple) par position kiya jata hai. Is intentional alignment se pure breast tissue par uniform optical density milti hai aur chest wall par under-penetration eliminate hoti hai.

qe: If the anode angle is reduced from 17° to 10°, what happens to the Anode Heel Effect and the effective focal spot size?
qh: यदि एनोड एंगल को 17° से घटाकर 10° कर दिया जाए, तो हील इफ़ेक्ट और इफेक्टिव फोकल स्पॉट साइज़ पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
oe: Heel effect decreases, effective focal spot size increases
Heel effect increases, effective focal spot size decreases
oh: हील इफ़ेक्ट घटेगा, फोकल स्पॉट साइज़ बढ़ेगा
हील इफ़ेक्ट बढ़ेगा, इफेक्टिव फोकल स्पॉट साइज़ घटेगा
e: Line Focus Principle ke formula ($EFS = AFS \times \sin\theta$) ke anusar target angle ($\theta$) ko 17° se reduce karke 10° karne par effective focal spot linearly shrink ho jata hai, jisse structural detail aur spatial resolution mein clear improvement hoti hai. Lekin is steep mechanical target angle ke kaaran anode bevel ki sloping edge sharp ho jaati hai, jisse target mein generate hue X-ray photons ko anode ki taraf nikalne ke liye target mass ke deep layers se traverse karna padta hai. Is increased path length se target self-absorption drastically badh jata hai, jisse anode side ka cut-off aur heel effect severity markedly increase ho jaati hai.

qe: To achieve uniform optical density in AP Foot radiography, toward which anatomical region should the cathode be directed?
qh: AP Foot रेडियोग्राफी करते समय यूनिफॉर्म फिल्म डेंसिटी प्राप्त करने के लिए कैथोड सिरे को किधर निर्देशित किया जाना चाहिए?
oe: Toward the toes and distal phalanges
Toward the heel and ankle (tarsal region)
Toward the lateral border of the foot
Toward the medial border of the foot
oh: पैर के पार्श्व (Lateral) किनारे की तरफ
पैर के मीडियल किनारे की तरफ
e: Human foot ka dorsoplantar (AP) projection significant tissue wedge profile represent karta hai. Distal phalanges aur anterior metatarsals flat aur structurally thin hote hain, jabki proximal tarsals, cuneiforms, navicular aur calcaneus region high bone mass aur thick plantar musculature se covered hote hain. Agar heel effect ka dhyaan na rakha jaye toh phalanges over-exposed ho jayenge aur tarsal joints under-penetrated rahenge. Isliye tube ke powerful cathode end ko posterior tarsus aur ankle joint ki taraf direct kiya jata hai aur anode end ko distal toes ki taraf rakha jata hai, jisse single exposure par foot ki entire anatomy balanced contrast ke sath visualize hoti hai.

qe: What is the primary scientific reason for alloying 10% rhenium with 90% tungsten in the focal track of a rotating anode?
qh: रोटेटिंग एनोड के फोकल ट्रैक में टंगस्टन (90%) के साथ रीनियम (10%) मिलाने का प्राथमिक वैज्ञानिक कारण क्या है?
oe: To double the output X-ray photon energy (kVp)
To prevent surface cracking and pitting caused by thermal stress
To reduce the overall physical weight of the anode disc by 50%
To directly attract accelerated electrons electrostatically
oh: एक्स-रे की आउटपुट ऊर्जा (kVp) को दोगुना करना
थर्मल स्ट्रेस के कारण होने वाली सतह की क्रैकिंग और पिटिंग (Pitting) को रोकना
एनोड डिस्क के कुल वजन को 50% तक कम करना
e: Rotating anode ka focal track exposure ke dauran fractions of a second mein room temperature se 1000°C–2000°C tak thermal shock experience karta hai. Pure tungsten naturally brittle metal hai jo continuous rapid thermal expansion aur contraction cycles ke dauran surface fatigue sustain nahi kar pata, jisse track par microscopic cracks aur track pitting (gaddhe) develop ho jaate hain. Pitting hone par primary radiation in pits ke edges dwara scatter aur absorb hokar X-ray output drop kar deti hai. Tungsten mein 5% se 10% Rhenium alloy karne se material ki tensile ductility aur thermal elasticity dramatically enhance hoti hai, jo anode target ko physical surface disintegration se protect karti hai.

qe: Why are molybdenum and graphite commonly used as backing materials for rotating anode discs?
qh: रोटेटिंग एनोड डिस्क के पिछले हिस्से (Backing) में मोलिब्डेनम और ग्रेफाइट का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
oe: To increase thermal storage capacity while keeping the disc lightweight
To emit maximum secondary diagnostic X-ray photons
To elevate rotor motor rotational speed beyond 20,000 RPM
To completely insulate electrical current flow
oh: थर्मल स्टोरेज क्षमता बढ़ाने और डिस्क का समग्र भार कम रखने के लिए
अधिकतम द्वितीयक एक्स-रे फोटॉन उत्सर्जित करने के लिए
रोटर मोटर की गति को 20,000 RPM से ऊपर ले जाने के लिए
इलेक्ट्रिक करंट को पूरी तरह ब्लॉक करने के लिए
e: Tungsten exceptionally dense aur heavy metal ($19.3\text{ g/cm}^3$) hai. Agar puri rotating disc pure solid tungsten se fabricate ki jaye, toh disc ka excessive physical inertia rotor assembly aur drive motor bearings par destructive mechanical stress dalega. Iske solution ke roop mein tungsten-rhenium track ke piche Molybdenum aur Graphite layers bond ki jaati hain. Graphite ki specific heat capacity tungsten se lagbhag 10 guna zyada hoti hai ($C = 0.71\text{ J/g}\cdot\text{K}$) jabki iski density extremely low hoti hai. Ye backing anode target ki total thermal storage capacity (heat units) massive scale par multiply karti hai aur disc ko lightweight rakhti hai, jisse rapid rotation aur smooth braking possible hoti hai.

qe: Why is the stem connecting the rotating anode disc to the rotor deliberately designed to be thin and made of molybdenum?
qh: रोटेटिंग एनोड डिस्क को रोटर से जोड़ने वाला तना (Stem) पतला और मोलिब्डेनम का ही क्यों बनाया जाता है?
oe: To minimize conductive heat transfer toward the rotor bearings, preventing thermal seizure
To increase the rotational speed of the anode up to 50,000 RPM
To maintain a microscopic focal spot dimension
To allow the primary X-ray beam to escape without filtration
oh: ताकि रोटर बियरिंग्स तक थर्मल कंडक्शन कम से कम हो और वे पिघलने/जाम होने से बचें
ताकि एनोड की गति 50,000 RPM तक बढ़ाई जा सके
ताकि फोकल स्पॉट का आकार सूक्ष्म रहे
ताकि एक्स-रे बीम सीधे बाहर निकल सके
e: Heavy exposure cycles ke dauran rotating anode disc white-hot thermal state reach kar leti hai. Rotor assembly ke andar precise steel ball bearings vacuum environment mein solid metallic lubricants (jaise silver ya lead coating) ke sath mount rehte hain. Agar anode disc ki ye intense heat direct conductive pathway se rotor shaft tak transfer ho jaye, toh bearings excessive thermal expansion se deform aur weld ho jayenge. Isliye anode stem ko narrow cylindrical cross-section ka banaya jata hai aur Molybdenum select kiya jata hai, kyunki Molybdenum tungsten aur copper ke comparison mein poor thermal conductor hota hai. Ye structural heat choke bearings tak thermal leakage ko prevent karta hai.

qe: According to AERB and ICRP regulatory standards, what is the maximum permissible leakage radiation limit from an X-ray tube housing at a distance of 1 meter?
qh: AERB और ICRP मानकों के अनुसार, एक्स-रे ट्यूब हाउसिंग से 1 मीटर की दूरी पर लीकेज रेडिएशन की अधिकतम अनुमेय सीमा क्या है?
e: Target par produce hone wale X-ray photons isotropic distribution (sab taraf) mein radiate karte hain. Sirf useful port window se nikalne wali beam useful beam hoti hai; bachi hui radiation jo lead-lined tube housing ko penetrate karke bahar aati hai use 'Leakage Radiation' kehte hain. International Commission on Radiological Protection (ICRP) aur Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) ke radiation safety standards mandate karte hain ki jab tube continuous maximum operational voltage (kVp) aur current (mA) par function kar rahi ho, tab housing surface se 1 meter ke distance par leakage radiation rate kisi bhi halat mein 1 mGy per hour (approximately 100 mR/hr) se exceed nahi hona chahiye.

qe: What is the primary function of the dielectric transformer oil filling the X-ray tube housing?
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब हाउसिंग में भरे डाई-इलेक्ट्रिक ट्रांसफॉर्मर ऑयल का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
oe: Exclusively to lubricate the high-speed rotor bearings
To provide high-voltage electrical insulation and dissipate heat via convection
To filter the primary beam and make it monochromatic
To maintain internal vacuum within the glass envelope
oh: केवल रोटर के बियरिंग्स को चिकनाई (lubrication) देना
हाई-वोल्टेज इलेक्ट्रिकल इंसुलेशन प्रदान करना और कन्वेक्शन द्वारा ऊष्मा का प्रसार करना
एक्स-रे बीम को फिल्टर करके मोनोक्रोमैटिक बनाना
ट्यूब ग्लास एनवेलप में वैक्यूम बनाए रखना
e: X-ray tube glass envelope aur metallic lead-lined protective housing ke intermediate sealed space ko purified high-grade Dielectric Transformer Oil se fill kiya jata hai. Is oil ke do non-negotiable functions hote hain: Pehla, electrical insulation—chunki tube 40 kVp se 150 kVp ke massive electrical potentials par operate karti hai, high dielectric strength wala ye oil cathode/anode terminals aur grounded outer metal housing ke beech violent electrical arcing ya short circuiting ko permanently block karta hai. Doosra, thermal dissipation—oil tube glass insert se conduction dwara excessive heat absorb karta hai aur thermal convection currents ke through use external housing shell aur cooling fans tak circulate karta hai.

qe: What safety purpose is served by the expansion bellows and internal microswitch installed in an X-ray tube housing?
qh: ट्यूब हाउसिंग में लगा एक्सपेंशन बेलो (Expansion Bellows) और माइक्रोस्विच किस सुरक्षा उद्देश्य से कार्य करता है?
oe: Shuts down main power if room ambient temperature increases
Interlocks and trips the exposure circuit when dielectric oil overheats and expands
Triggers an audible alarm if the vacuum envelope fractures
Automatically activates a backup filament upon primary filament burnout
oh: कमरे का तापमान बढ़ने पर बिजली बंद करना
तेल के अत्यधिक गर्म होकर फैलने पर एक्सपोज़र को इंटरलॉक/ट्रिप करना
ट्यूब के वैक्यूम टूटने पर अलार्म बजाना
फिलामेंट के जलने पर नया फिलामेंट एक्टिवेट करना
e: Continuous high-workload procedures (jaise fluoroscopy, CT scanning ya interventional angiographies) ke dauran housing ke andar maujood dielectric transformer oil intense heat absorb karta hai. High temperature reach hone par thermal expansion physics ke chalte oil ka volumetric volume rapidly expand hota hai. Is volumetric pressure ko accommodate karne ke liye housing ke posterior end par flexible metallic Expansion Bellows assemble rehta hai. Agar oil temperature critical safety ceiling exceed kar de, toh expanded bellows mechanical limit switch (microswitch) ko trip kar deta hai. Ye microswitch exposure control console ko instantly interlock/block kar deta hai, jisse casing rupture aur tube damage prevent hota hai.

qe: A single-phase radiographic unit is operated at 80 kVp, 200 mA, and 0.5 seconds. Calculate the total Heat Units (HU) generated:
qh: एक सिंगल-फेज (Single-phase) एक्स-रे यूनिट पर 80 kVp, 200 mA और 0.5 सेकंड का एक्सपोज़र दिया गया। उत्पन्न हीट यूनिट्स (HU) की गणना करें:
e: Single-phase full-wave rectified radiographic generators ke liye standard Heat Unit (HU) calculation equation $HU = kVp \times mA \times \text{time (seconds)} \times W_f$ hoti hai. Single-phase alternating current supply ka generator modification factor ya waveform constant ($W_f$) baseline standard $1.0$ define kiya gaya hai ($1\text{ HU} = 1\text{ kVp} \times 1\text{ mA} \times 1\text{ s}$). Problem data substitute karne par: $HU = 80\text{ kVp} \times 200\text{ mA} \times 0.5\text{ s} \times 1.0 = 8000\text{ HU}$. Is calculation se ensure hota hai ki single target load exposure tube rating chart ki safe thermal boundary ke andar rahe.

qe: If an exposure of 90 kVp, 300 mA, and 0.2 seconds is performed on a high-frequency generator, how many total Heat Units (HU) are produced?
qh: यदि एक हाई-फ्रीक्वेंसी (High-frequency) जनरेटर पर 90 kVp, 300 mA और 0.2 सेकंड का एक्सपोज़र दिया जाता है, तो कुल कितनी हीट यूनिट्स (HU) उत्पन्न होंगी?
e: High-Frequency (HF) generators mein continuous near-constant potential voltage produce hota hai jiska voltage ripple less than 1% hota hai. High electrical efficiency ki wajah se constant tube voltage single-phase units ke comparison mein 40-45% zyada thermal heating generate karta hai. Iska generator waveform correction factor $1.45$ (ya modern literature mein $1.41$) assign kiya jata hai. Standard formula apply karte hain: $HU = kVp \times mA \times \text{time} \times 1.45$. Data values assign karne par: $HU = 90 \times 300 \times 0.2 \times 1.45 = 5400 \times 1.45 = 7830\text{ HU}$. Ye increased thermal value anode target par rapid heating calculate karne ke liye vital metric hai.

qe: What is the Heat Unit modification factor (rectification constant) for a 3-phase, 12-pulse X-ray generator?
qh: 3-Phase, 12-Pulse एक्स-रे जनरेटर का हीट यूनिट मॉडिफिकेशन फैक्टर (Rectification Constant) कितना होता है?
e: Generator power supplies ki waveform efficiency unke rectification circuitry aur voltage ripple profile par depend karti hai. Single-phase systems mein 100% ripple hone ki wajah se waveform constant $1.00$ hota hai. Three-phase 6-pulse generators lagbhag 13.5%-14% voltage ripple exhibit karte hain, isliye inka correction factor $1.35$ evaluate kiya jata hai. Three-phase 12-pulse generators star aur delta secondary coils ke phase combination se ultra-smooth wave produce karte hain jiska voltage ripple sirf 3.5%-4% hota hai; iske liye engineering factor exactly $1.41$ standard set kiya gaya hai. High-frequency generators ke liye ye factor $1.45$ hota hai.

qe: In a half-wave rectified single-phase unit operating on a 60 Hz AC line supply, how many useful voltage pulses are delivered per second?
qh: हाफ-वेव रेक्टिफाइड (Half-wave rectified) सिंगल-फेज यूनिट में 60 Hz AC सप्लाई पर प्रति सेकंड कितने उपयोगी वोल्टेज पल्स प्राप्त होते हैं?
e: Standard AC mains electrical supply standard 60 Hz frequency par continuous sine wave operate karti hai, jisme har second 60 positive half-cycles aur 60 negative half-cycles shamil hote hain (total 120 alternations). Half-wave rectification circuits mein (jo 1 ya 2 rectifying diodes use karte hain ya self-rectifying tube operate karte hain) diode polarity inverse hone par negative alternation current flow ko completely block/suppress kar deta hai. Is circuit design ki wajah se sirf positive 60 half-cycles hi X-ray tube ke across transmit hote hain, jisse output rate exactly 60 discrete voltage pulses per second reh jaata hai, jo exposure time ko double lengthen karta hai.

qe: What is the minimum number of diodes required in a full-wave bridge rectifier circuit to completely rectify single-phase alternating current (AC)?
qh: फुल-वेव ब्रिज रेक्टिफायर सर्किट में प्रत्यावर्ती धारा (AC) को पूर्ण रूप से रेक्टिफाई करने के लिए न्यूनतम कितने डायोड की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Single-phase full-wave bridge rectification design complete AC sine wave cycle ko unidirectional pulsating DC current mein invert karne ke liye design kiya jata hai. Is bridge circuit topology mein minimum four solid-state silicon diodes bridge configuration mein wired rehte hain. Positive half-cycle ke dauran do opposed forward-biased diodes current ko tube cathode-to-anode route karte hain. Negative half-cycle ke dauran baaki do diodes alternate path provide karke inverted negative voltage ko positive orientation mein redirect kar dete hain. Char diodes ke coordinated operation se koi power cycle waste nahi hota aur continuous 120 pulses/second output achieve hota hai.

qe: What is the percentage of voltage ripple characteristic of a three-phase, 6-pulse X-ray generator?
qh: थ्री-फेज, 6-पल्स (Three-phase 6-pulse) जनरेटर में वोल्टेज रिपल (Voltage Ripple) का प्रतिशत कितना होता है?
e: Voltage ripple generator dwara produced high-voltage waveform ke peak potential aur minimum trough voltage ke difference ka percentage quantification hota hai. Single-phase units ka voltage har alternation par zero tak drop hota hai (100% ripple). Three-phase 6-pulse circuits mein three distinct alternating current phases 120° phase offset par synchronize rehte hain aur 6 diodes ke through rectify hote hain, jisse per cycle 6 pulses form hote hain. Waveform valley peak voltage se approx 13.5% se 14% se zyada drop nahi hoti. Ye reduced ripple beam ki average photon energy elevate karta hai aur overall exposure time shorten karta hai.

qe: What is the primary clinical advantage of a High-Frequency generator exhibiting less than 1% voltage ripple?
qh: हाई-फ्रीक्वेंसी (High-Frequency) जनरेटर का वोल्टेज रिपल 1% से भी कम होने का मुख्य नैदानिक लाभ क्या है?
oe: The X-ray beam is emitted at a nearly constant peak voltage, reducing soft radiation and patient dose
The tube housing remains completely cold during all procedures
Compton scatter radiation is reduced to absolute zero
The clinical requirement for an anti-scatter grid is permanently eliminated
oh: एक्स-रे बीम लगभग स्थिर पीक वोल्टेज पर निकलती है, जिससे सॉफ्ट रेडिएशन और पेशेंट डोज़ घटती है
ट्यूब की हाउसिंग पूरी तरह ठंडी रहती है
स्कैटर रेडिएशन पूरी तरह शून्य हो जाता है
ग्रिड की आवश्यकता समाप्त हो जाती है
e: High-Frequency (HF) generators DC voltage ko thousands of hertz (kHz) switching frequency par invert karte hain, jisse output voltage ripple 1% se bhi niche drop ho jata hai. Voltage never drops to low levels, iska clinical significance ye hai ki tube continuously set peak kilovoltage (kVp) par operate karti hai. Low-ripple supply low-energy 'soft' X-ray photons ke emission ko eliminate karti hai jo image form kiye bina patient ki skin mein absorb hokar dose multiply karte hain. Is continuous high effective energy se shorter exposure timings, lower patient radiation dose, reproducible exposure parameters aur superior image contrast achieve hota hai.

qe: Which transformer is utilized in the primary circuit of an X-ray machine to allow the operator to select kVp at the control console?
qh: एक्स-रे मशीन के कंसोल पर ऑपरेटर द्वारा kVp का चयन करने के लिए सर्किट में कौन सा ट्रांसफॉर्मर उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Autotransformer X-ray primary circuit ka preliminary regulatory core component hota hai jo incoming line voltage (e.g., 220V/440V) ko precision tapping provide karta hai. Faraday ke self-induction principle par operate karte hue isme laminated iron core par ek single continuous copper winding wrap rehti hai. Is winding par multiple tapped electrical contacts exist karte hain. Jab operator console par major aur minor kVp selection dials switch karta hai, toh variable tap points select hote hain. Autotransformer high-tension step-up transformer ki primary winding ko calibrated step-voltage supply karta hai jo baad mein high kilovoltage mein elevate hoti hai.

qe: Which transformer is responsible for heating the cathode filament to control tube current (mA) via thermionic emission?
qh: कैथोड फिलामेंट को गर्म करके थर्मिओनिक एमिशन द्वारा मिलीएम्पीयर (mA) नियंत्रित करने के लिए कौन सा ट्रांसफॉर्मर जिम्मेदार है?
oe: Step-down transformer (Decreases voltage to increase current)
oh: स्टेप-डाउन ट्रांसफॉर्मर - वोल्टेज घटाकर करंट बढ़ाने वाला (Step-down transformer)
e: Cathode filament ko incandescent state tak heat karne ke liye high electric current (amperage) ki zaroorat hoti hai. Filament circuit mein ek specialized Step-down Transformer integrate kiya jata hai jiska turns ratio standardly low hota hai (approx 1:10 se 1:20). Ye step-down unit incoming primary voltage ko safely drop karke roughly 6 se 12 Volts par regulate karta hai, jabki current flow ko dramatically elevate karke 3 se 6 Amperes range par deliver karta hai. Ye heavy electric amperage coiled tungsten filament ko red-hot temperature tak heat karta hai, jisse space-charge electron cloud boil-off hokar console-selected tube current (mA) generate karta hai.

qe: What is the primary function of the Inverter circuit in a modern High-Frequency X-ray generator?
qh: हाई-फ्रीक्वेंसी जनरेटर में इन्वर्टर सर्किट (Inverter) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
oe: To convert low-voltage DC into high-frequency (kHz) AC pulses
To circulate cooling oil through the tube housing
To digitize the analog image receptor signals
To provide safety electrical earth grounding
oh: लो वोल्टेज डीसी (DC) को हाई-फ्रीक्वेंसी (kHz) एसी (AC) में बदलना
e: High-Frequency generator architecture mein standard 50/60 Hz AC incoming supply pehle full-wave rectify hokar smooth DC voltage mein convert hoti hai. Uske baad circuit ka central engine yaani Inverter (high-speed semiconductor switches jaise SCRs ya IGBTs se bana module) start hota hai. Inverter is steady DC current ko extremely high frequency alternating pulses (typically 1 kHz se 100 kHz) mein chop/convert karta hai. Transformer efficiency operating frequency ke directly proportional hoti hai, isliye high frequency utilize karne se bulky magnetic transformers ki jagah ultra-compact step-up transformers use hote hain aur precision square-wave kilovoltage output attain hota hai.

qe: What is the minimum number of rectifier diodes used to achieve full-wave rectification in a 3-phase, 12-pulse generator circuit?
qh: थ्री-फेज, 12-पल्स जनरेटर सर्किट में फुल-वेव रेक्टिफिकेशन प्राप्त करने के लिए न्यूनतम कितने डायोड्स का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Three-phase 12-pulse high-tension circuits advanced transformer configurations employ karte hain jisme primary winding general Delta geometry mein hoti hai aur high-voltage secondary windings do complementary sets mein divide hoti hain: ek Star (Y) aur dusri Delta ($\Delta$). Dono sets ke voltages ke beech 30° electrical phase displacement develop hota hai. Har three-phase secondary output bridge ko full-wave rectify karne ke liye 6 solid-state diodes ki requirement hoti hai. Dono sets ko combine karne par total 12 rectifier diodes parallel bridge mein integrate kiye jaate hain jo combined 12 pulses per cycle (720 pulses/second) produce karte hain.

qe: If the lead strips of a grid have a height (h) of 2.4 mm and the distance between them (D) is 0.2 mm, what is the Grid Ratio?
qh: यदि किसी ग्रिड की लेड स्ट्रिप्स की ऊंचाई (h) 2.4 mm है और स्ट्रिप्स के बीच की दूरी (D) 0.2 mm है, तो ग्रिड रेशियो (Grid Ratio) क्या होगा?
e: Grid Ratio anti-scatter grid design ka primary geometric parameter hai jo scatter cleanup capability define karta hai. Mathematical definition ke anusar Grid Ratio ($R$) absorbing lead strips ki physical height ($h$) aur adjacent lead strips ke intermediate interspace material distance ($D$) ka ratio hota hai: $R = h / D$. Given problem values: $h = 2.4\text{ mm}$ aur $D = 0.2\text{ mm}$. Substitution perform karne par: $R = 2.4 / 0.2 = 12$. Iska result $12:1$ grid ratio nikal kar aata hai. High grid ratio angled scattered photons ke maximum fraction ko lead strips ke andar trap kar leta hai.

qe: How is 'Grid Frequency' formally defined in radiographic physics?
qh: ग्रिड फ्रीक्वेंसी (Grid Frequency) को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है?
oe: The number of mechanical oscillations performed by the Bucky grid per second
The number of lead strip lines per unit length (per centimeter or per inch)
The dimensional ratio between lead strip thickness and height
The percentage fraction of primary beam attenuated by the interspace material
oh: प्रति सेकंड ग्रिड के दोलन (oscillations) की संख्या
प्रति सेंटीमीटर या प्रति इंच लेड स्ट्रिप्स (लाइनों) की संख्या - Grid Frequency
लेड की मोटाई और ऊंचाई का अनुपात
ग्रिड द्वारा अवशोषित प्राइमरी बीम का प्रतिशत
e: Grid Frequency anti-scatter grid ke physical surface design ka metric hai jo per unit linear distance mein packed lead strips (lines) ki count ko represent karta hai, jise routinely 'Lines per cm' (lines/cm) ya 'Lines per inch' (lines/inch) mein measure kiya jata hai. Standard stationary grids typically 25 se 45 lines/cm range exhibit karti hain, jabki digital radiography aur stationary high-resolution grids 60 se 80 lines/cm feature karti hain. Thin, dense lead lines hone se processed digital radiograph par grid lines visually faint ho jaati hain, jisse CR laser scanning systems mein moiré pattern artifact risk minimize ho jata hai.

qe: Why are carbon fiber or plastic fiber interspace materials preferred over aluminum in low-kVp and Mammography examinations?
qh: लो kVp और मैमोग्राफी परीक्षाओं में एल्युमिनियम के बजाय कार्बन फाइबर या प्लास्टिक फाइबर इंटरस्पेस सामग्री को प्राथमिकता क्यों दी जाती है?
oe: Carbon fiber minimally attenuates the low-energy primary diagnostic beam
Carbon fiber hygroscopically absorbs environmental moisture completely
It automatically doubles the effective physical grid ratio
It regulates X-ray tube current electronically
oh: कार्बन फाइबर प्राइमरी बीम के लो-एनर्जी फोटॉनों का न्यूनतम अवशोषण करता है
कार्बन फाइबर नमी को पूरी तरह सोख लेता है
यह ग्रिड रेशियो को स्वचालित रूप से बढ़ा देता है
यह एक्स-रे ट्यूब के करंट को नियंत्रित करता है
e: Anti-scatter grids mein lead strips ke beech structural interspace support ki zaroorat hoti hai. General radiography mein Aluminium ($Z = 13$) standard durable interspace material hai. Lekin low-kVp clinical procedures jaise Mammography (25-32 kVp) mein primary beam ke photons naturally low-energy soft photons hote hain. Aluminum ka atomic number high hone ke kaaran Photoelectric effect se useful primary diagnostic photons heavy scale par absorb ho jayenge, jisse mAs badhana padega aur patient dose shoot up karegi. Carbon fiber aur organic plastics ($Z \approx 6$) ultra-low atomic numbers display karte hain, jisse primary low-energy transmission maximum rehti hai.

qe: A non-grid pelvis radiograph was performed at 10 mAs. If the examination is repeated using a 12:1 grid (GCF = 5), what is the new mAs required to maintain identical density?
qh: एक नॉन-ग्रिड पेल्विस रेडियोग्राफी 10 mAs पर की गई। यदि उसी परीक्षण को 12:1 ग्रिड (GCF = 5) लगाकर दोहराया जाए, तो समान डेंसिटी के लिए नया mAs क्या होगा?
e: Grid Conversion Factor (GCF / Bucky Factor) evaluate karta hai ki scatter aur primary absorption compensate karke image optical density constant rakhne ke liye kitna exposure increase mandatory hai: $mAs_2 = mAs_1 \times (GCF_2 / GCF_1)$. Non-grid baseline radiography mein $GCF_1 = 1.0$ hota hai. Given scenario mein non-grid exposure $mAs_1 = 10\text{ mAs}$ hai, aur $12:1$ grid ke liye standardized $GCF_2 = 5$ provide kiya gaya hai. Values substitute karne par: $mAs_2 = 10 \times (5 / 1) = 50\text{ mAs}$. Scatter cleanup ke reward ke sath patient dose 5-fold multiply hoti hai.

qe: If a radiographic technique utilizes 20 mAs with an 8:1 grid (GCF = 4) and is upgraded to a 16:1 grid (GCF = 6), what is the newly required mAs?
qh: यदि 8:1 ग्रिड (GCF = 4) पर 20 mAs का उपयोग हो रहा था और इसे बदलकर 16:1 ग्रिड (GCF = 6) लगाया जाता है, तो आवश्यक mAs की गणना करें:
e: Jab ek grid ratio ko doosre higher grid ratio se swap kiya jata hai, toh mAs compensation formula $mAs_2 = mAs_1 \times (GCF_2 / GCF_1)$ use hota hai. Given problem parameters: Initial technique $mAs_1 = 20\text{ mAs}$ at $8:1$ grid ($GCF_1 = 4$), aur targeted replacement $16:1$ grid ($GCF_2 = 6$) hai. Calculation execute karte hain: $mAs_2 = 20 \times (6 / 4) = 20 \times 1.5 = 30\text{ mAs}$. Higher ratio grid cleaner scatter cleanup aur superior subject contrast deliver karti hai, jiske liye tube exposure 20 mAs se elevate karke 30 mAs set karna padega.

qe: What visual manifestation appears across a radiographic image as a result of an Off-Level Grid artifact?
qh: Off-Level Grid आर्टिफ़ैक्ट होने पर रेडियोग्राफ़िक छवि पर क्या प्रभाव दिखाई देता है?
oe: Severe uniform loss of radiographic optical density across the entire image
Underexposure confined strictly to the two peripheral lateral margins
A white band through the center with heavy blackening along the edges
Complete physical disappearance of all visible grid lines
oh: पूरी छवि पर एक समान (Uniform) डेंसिटी का गंभीर नुकसान
केवल छवि के दोनों पार्श्व किनारों पर अंडर-एक्सपोज़र
छवि के केंद्र में एक सफ़ेद पट्टी और किनारों पर अधिक कालापन
ग्रिड लाइनों का पूरी तरह गायब हो जाना
e: Off-Level Grid artifact tab generate hota hai jab central X-ray beam aur grid surface plane ke beech perpendicular 90° geometric alignment lose ho jati hai. Ye tab happen hota hai jab tube central ray grid lead strips ke across angled strike karti hai ya mobile cassette bedside par patient body weight se tilt ho jaati hai. Is misalignment ke chalte diverging primary X-ray photons grid ke center se lekar margins tak har jagah lead strips se collide karte hain. Is continuous absorption ka result ye hota hai ki pure processed radiograph par uniform loss of optical density (severe overall underexposure) appear hota hai.

qe: What visual artifact occurs if a Focused Grid is positioned at a distance significantly outside its designated focal range (Off-Focus Grid)?
qh: यदि एक फोकस्ड ग्रिड (Focused Grid) को ट्यूब की अनुशंसित फोकल रेंज (SID) से बहुत अधिक दूरी या बहुत कम दूरी (Off-Focus) पर रखा जाए, तो क्या होगा?
oe: The entire radiograph becomes uniformly pitch black
Severe density loss (grid cut-off) occurs symmetrically along both lateral peripheral edges
Severe underexposure occurs strictly at the anatomical center
Image contrast improves uniformly across the receptor
oh: पूरी फिल्म बिल्कुल काली हो जाएगी
रेडियोग्राफ़ के दोनों बाहरी किनारों (Periphery) पर गंभीर डेंसिटी लॉस (कट-ऑफ) होगा
केवल फिल्म का केंद्र अंडर-एक्सपोज़्ड होगा
e: Focused grid ki lead strips bilkul parallel na hokar X-ray beam ke divergent angles ke sath match hone ke liye precisely tilted (canted) hoti hain, jo ek specific convergence distance (focal distance/range, e.g., 100 cm ya 180 cm) form karti hain. Agar technician SID ko is prescribed focal range se significantly closer ya significantly farther position kar deta hai, toh center mein nikalne wali perpendicular rays toh bina obstruction pass ho jaati hain. Lekin periphery par diverge hone wali primary rays tilted lead strips se severely intercept ho jaati hain. Resultantly, film center normally exposed rehta hai jabki dono lateral edges par severe cut-off (white/pale borders) appear hota hai.

qe: What distinct artifact pattern is produced on a radiograph if a radiographer accidentally positions a Focused Grid Upside-Down?
qh: रेडियोग्राफ़र द्वारा गलती से एक फोकस्ड ग्रिड को उल्टा (Upside-Down Focused Grid) रखने पर प्राप्त रेडियोग्राफ कैसा दिखेगा?
oe: The processed radiograph appears completely normal
Only a narrow central vertical band is exposed, while both lateral margins are severely underexposed/white
The center of the film is severely underexposed while both peripheral edges appear pitch black
Uniform blackening occurs across the entirety of the film base
oh: पूरी फिल्म पूरी तरह सामान्य दिखेगी
केवल केंद्र में एक संकीर्ण पट्टी एक्सपोज़ होगी और दोनों बाहरी हिस्से गंभीर रूप से कटे हुए (सफ़ेद/Underexposed) होंगे
केवल केंद्र अंडर-एक्सपोज़्ड होगा और किनारे डार्क होंगे
पूरी फिल्म पर एक समान ब्लैकनिंग होगी
e: Upside-down focused grid severe positioning error hai. Focused grid ke lead strips ka mechanical tilt tube focus point ki taraf converge hona chahiye. Agar grid upside down flip kar di jaye, toh strips beam divergence ke sath converge hone ke bajaye outwards diverge ho jaati hain. Central ray strips ke orientation ke parallel hoti hai, isliye film center par ek narrow vertical strip adequately penetrate hokar dark expose hoti hai. Center se thoda sa bahar nikalte hi primary divergent rays lead strips ke opposing physical angles se directly collide karti hain aur 100% absorb ho jaati hain. Resultantly, central exposed strip ke alawa dono sides completely white blank cut-off dikhte hain.

qe: What physical principle enables the Air-Gap Technique to prevent scatter radiation from reaching the image receptor?
qh: एयर-गैप तकनीक (Air-Gap Technique) में स्कैटर रेडिएशन को फिल्म तक पहुँचने से रोकने के लिए कौन सा सिद्धांत कार्य करता है?
oe: Introducing a 10–15 cm OID allows highly scattered photons to disperse in air, missing the receptor
Generating a localized atmospheric vacuum within the examination room
Restricting the radiographic tube collimation shutters by 50%
oh: मरीज़ और फिल्म के बीच 10–15 सेमी की OID देना, जिससे स्कैटर फोटॉन हवा में फैलकर रिसेप्टर से चूक जाते हैं
कमरे की हवा में वैक्यूम उत्पन्न करना
ट्यूब के कोलीमेशन को 50% तक बंद करना
e: Air-Gap Technique anti-scatter grid use kiye bina scatter clean karne ka geometric method hai. Patient body aur image receptor plane ke beech intentionally 10 se 15 cm ka Object-to-Image Distance (OID) create kiya jata hai. Patient ke andar Compton scatter se generate hone wale secondary photons omnidirectional random paths par diverge karte hain. Is physical gap (air space) ko traverse karte waqt angled scatter photons laterally deflect hokar cassette boundary se bahar miss ho jaate hain aur detector tak nahi pahunch paate. Ye clean-up approximately 8:1 grid equivalent contrast cleanup deliver karta hai. OID badhne se magnification create hoti hai, jise compensate karne ke liye SID ko 180-300 cm tak extend kiya jata hai.

qe: Why are the primary and secondary windings of a three-phase generator transformer interconnected in Star and Delta configurations?
qh: एक तीन-फेज (3-phase) ट्रांसफॉर्मर की प्राथमिक (Primary) और द्वितीयक (Secondary) कुंडलियों को स्टार और डेल्टा कॉन्फ़िगरेशन में क्यों जोड़ा जाता है?
oe: To produce a 30° phase shift between waveforms, generating a smooth 12-pulse output
Solely to reduce the structural weight of the transformer iron core
To completely prevent dielectric oil leakage within the tank
To supply pure DC current directly to the cathode filament
oh: वोल्टेज तरंगों के बीच 30° का फेज़ शिफ्ट पैदा करके 12-पल्स आउटपुट प्राप्त करने के लिए
केवल ट्रांसफॉर्मर का वजन कम करने के लिए
ऑयल लीकेज को रोकने के लिए
फिलामेंट को डीसी करंट प्रदान करने के लिए
e: Three-phase 12-pulse generator engineering ka primary goal voltage ripple ko minimize karke continuous steady output banana hota hai. High-tension transformer primary winding delta configuration mein wired hoti hai, jabki high-voltage secondary stage par do separate three-phase coils build ki jaati hain: ek Star (Wye / Y) aur doosri Delta ($\Delta$). Electrical engineering physics ke mutabiq Delta-to-Star transformation dono secondary coil sets ke voltages ke beech exactly 30 degrees ($30^\circ$) ka phase shift create karti hai. Dono phase-shifted outputs ko independent 6-diode bridges se rectify karke series mein combine kiya jata hai, jisse per AC cycle 12 overlapping peaks (720 pulses/sec) generate hoti hain aur voltage ripple 3.5%-4% par drop ho jata hai.

qe: In dry air under standard conditions, 1 Roentgen (R) of radiation exposure is equivalent to how many Coulombs per kilogram (C/kg)?
qh: हवा में शुष्क परिस्थितियों में 1 Roentgen (R) एक्सपोज़र कितने कूलॉम प्रति किलोग्राम (C/kg) के बराबर होता है?
e: Radiation exposure ki classical traditional unit Roentgen (R) hoti hai, jise air ionization measure karne ke liye define kiya gaya tha. Standard temperature aur pressure (STP: 0°C aur 760 mm Hg) par 1 cubic centimeter dry air mein jab X-ray ya gamma photons interact karke exactly 1 Electrostatic Unit (esu) charge create karte hain, toh use 1 Roentgen kehte hain. SI unit system mein exposure ko Coulomb per kilogram (C/kg) mein convert kiya jata hai. Calculation ke anusar 1 R exactly $2.58 \times 10^{-4}\text{ C/kg}$ air ionization ke equivalent hota hai. Ye unit biological tissues par absorbed dose nahi balki radiation beam ki air mein ionization intensity quantify karti hai.

qe: What is the correct physical relationship between the SI unit of Absorbed Dose 'Gray' (Gy) and the traditional unit 'Rad'?
qh: अवशोषित खुराक (Absorbed Dose) की SI इकाई 'Gray' (Gy) और पारंपरिक इकाई 'Rad' के बीच सही संबंध क्या है?
e: Absorbed Dose biological ya non-biological mass dwara per unit weight absorb ki gayi energy ko measure karti hai. Traditional radiation unit system mein Absorbed Dose ki unit Rad (Radiation Absorbed Dose) hoti hai, jise mathematically $100\text{ ergs/g}$ of absorbing material define kiya jata hai. Modern International System of Units (SI) ke under iski standard unit Gray (Gy) hoti hai, jahan $1\text{ Gray} = 1\text{ Joule per kilogram (J/kg)}$. In dono metric systems ko bridge karne par $1\text{ Gy} = 100\text{ rad}$ aur inverse conversion par $1\text{ rad} = 0.01\text{ Gy} = 10\text{ mGy}$ nikalta hai, jo diagnostic dosimetry calculations ka standard reference hai.

qe: If a tissue absorbs 0.05 Gy of alpha (α) radiation (Radiation Weighting Factor, W_R = 20), what is the calculated Equivalent Dose?
qh: यदि किसी ऊतक को 0.05 Gy का अल्फा (α) विकिरण अवशोषित होता है (अल्फा कणों के लिए W_R = 20), तो समतुल्य खुराक (Equivalent Dose) क्या होगी?
e: Equivalent Dose ($H$) biological damage ki severity quantify karti hai kyunki different radiation types ki Linear Energy Transfer (LET) capability vary karti hai. Iska mathematical relationship $H = D \times W_R$ hota hai, jahan $D$ absorbed dose (Gy) hai aur $W_R$ radiation weighting factor hai. X-rays, gamma rays aur electrons ke liye $W_R = 1$ hota hai, jabki heavy mass aur high ionization wale alpha particles ke liye $W_R = 20$ standard assign kiya gaya hai. Values substitute karne par: $H = 0.05\text{ Gy} \times 20 = 1.0\text{ Sievert (Sv)}$. Iska clinical matlab ye hai ki 0.05 Gy alpha radiation body par 1.0 Gy X-rays ke barabar biological damage create karti hai.

qe: In the measurement of Equivalent Dose, 1 Sievert (Sv) is equivalent to how many Rem in the traditional system?
qh: समतुल्य खुराक (Equivalent Dose) के संबंध में 1 Sievert (Sv) कितने Rem के समतुल्य है?
e: Radiation protection dosimetry mein Equivalent Dose aur Effective Dose dono biological risk quantify karte hain. Traditional system mein is purpose ke liye Rem (Roentgen Equivalent Man) unit employ ki jaati thi, jo absorbed dose rad aur relative biological effectiveness ka product ($rem = rad \times Q$) hoti thi. SI metric system mein iski derived unit Sievert (Sv) adopt ki gayi hai, jahan $1\text{ Sv} = 1\text{ J/kg}$. Dono systems ka physical correlation $1\text{ Sievert (Sv)} = 100\text{ rem}$ hota hai. Clinical radiation safety reports aur personnel monitoring logs mein fractional values use hoti hain, jahan $1\text{ mSv} = 100\text{ mrem}$ aur $10\text{ mSv} = 1\text{ rem}$ hota hai.

qe: When calculating the whole-body Effective Dose (E), what must be the total sum of all Tissue Weighting Factors (∑W_T)?
qh: प्रभावी खुराक (Effective Dose, E) की गणना करते समय मानव शरीर के सभी ऊतक भार कारकों (Tissue Weighting Factors, ∑W_T) का कुल योग कितना होना चाहिए?
e: Effective Dose ($E$) human body ke kisi specific irradiated organ par stochastically induced overall cancer risk aur genetic harm ka global assessment hoti hai ($E = \sum H_T \times W_T$). Har organ ka radiation sensitivity level differ karta hai, jise quantify karne ke liye ICRP ne dimensionless fractional multipliers assign kiye hain jinhe Tissue Weighting Factors ($W_T$) kehte hain. Agar entire human body par perfectly uniform whole-body radiation exposure deliver kiya jaye, toh sabhi anatomical organs aur remaining residual tissues ke individual $W_T$ values ka mathematical sum strictly $1.0$ (ya $100\%$) hona mandatory hota hai taaki baseline whole-body equivalent risk preserve rahe.

qe: What is the correct physical relationship between the traditional unit of Radioactivity Curie (Ci) and the SI unit Becquerel (Bq)?
qh: रेडियोधर्मिता (Radioactivity) की पारंपरिक इकाई क्यूरी (Ci) और SI इकाई बेकरेल (Bq) के बीच सही संबंध क्या है?
e: Radioactivity radioactive source ke unstable nuclei ke spontaneous decay rate (disintegrations per second) ko measure karti hai. Traditional historical unit Curie (Ci) ko originally exactly 1 gram Radium-226 ke nuclear disintegration rate par benchmark kiya gaya tha, jo $3.7 \times 10^{10}$ disintegrations per second (dps) banta hai. International SI system mein iski derived base unit Becquerel (Bq) establish ki gayi hai, jahan $1\text{ Bq} = 1\text{ dps}$ hota hai. Consequently, $1\text{ Curie (Ci)} = 3.7 \times 10^{10}\text{ Becquerels (Bq)} = 37\text{ GBq}$ hota hai. Clinical nuclear medicine mein routinely millicurie ($1\text{ mCi} = 37\text{ MBq}$) aur microcurie ($1\,\mu\text{Ci} = 37\text{ kBq}$) scale conversions use hote hain.

qe: What is the fundamental definition of 'Air Kerma' and in which physical unit is it routinely expressed?
qh: Air Kerma की मूल परिभाषा क्या है और इसे आमतौर पर किस इकाई में व्यक्त किया जाता है?
oe: Total ion pairs produced in air, expressed in Coulomb/kg
Kinetic Energy Released per unit Mass in air, expressed in Gray (Gy)
Total biological damage sustained by human tissue, expressed in Sievert (Sv)
Spontaneous radioactive nuclear decay rate, expressed in Becquerel (Bq)
oh: हवा में निर्मित कुल आयन जोड़े (Coulomb/kg)
हवा के प्रति यूनिट द्रव्यमान में अवमुक्त गतिज ऊर्जा (Kinetic Energy Released per unit Mass), इकाई Gy
जैविक ऊतकों में होने वाला कुल जैविक नुकसान, इकाई Sv
रेडियोधर्मी नाभिकों के क्षय की दर, इकाई Bq
e: KERMA radiation physics ka fundamental acronym hai jiska expanded form 'Kinetic Energy Released per unit MAss' hota hai. Ye measure karta hai ki uncharged ionizing photons (X-rays ya gamma rays) target air volume ke per unit mass mein initial interaction ke dauran secondary electrons ko kitni total kinetic energy transfer karte hain. Chunki ye transferred kinetic energy per unit mass ($Joules/kg$) calculate karta hai, iski standard SI unit Gray ($Gy_a$) hoti hai. Classical exposure unit Roentgen (R) ko modern digital radiology, DAP meters aur CTDI calculations mein progressively Air Kerma dwara replace kiya gaya hai, jahan dry air mein $1\text{ R} \approx 8.76\text{ mGy}$ air kerma banta hai.

qe: According to ICRP 103 recommendations, which of the following organs/tissues is assigned the highest Tissue Weighting Factor (W_T = 0.12)?
qh: ICRP 103 अनुशंसाओं के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से किस अंग/ऊतक का Tissue Weighting Factor (W_T) सर्वाधिक (0.12) निर्धारित है?
e: ICRP Publication 103 guidelines ke mutabiq organ-specific radiosensitivity ko revise kiya gaya tha taaki stochastic carcinogenesis aur lethal damage ka accurate assessment ho sake. Red Bone Marrow, Colon, Lung, Stomach aur Breast tissues ko maximum high susceptibility bracket mein rank karke unka individual Tissue Weighting Factor ($W_T$) $0.12$ assign kiya gaya hai. Iske opposite Gonads ka $W_T$ purane ICRP 60 ke 0.20 se drop karke 0.08 set kiya gaya, jabki Thyroid ($W_T = 0.04$), Brain ($W_T = 0.01$) aur Skin ($W_T = 0.01$) substantially lower risk category occupy karte hain kyunki hematopoietic tissues radiation-induced leukemia ke liye extremely sensitive hote hain.

qe: According to AERB regulations, what is the cumulative whole-body effective dose limit for an occupational radiation worker?
qh: AERB नियमों के अनुसार एक रेडिएशन कर्मचारी (Occupational Worker) के लिए संपूर्ण शरीर (Whole Body) की संचयी खुराक सीमा क्या है?
oe: 100 mSv in a defined 5-year block (average 20 mSv/year), not exceeding 30 mSv in any single year
20 mSv per calendar year without any multi-year averaging flexibility
50 mSv total cumulative limit over 5 consecutive years
oh: 5 वर्षों के ब्लॉक में कुल 100 mSv (औसत 20 mSv/वर्ष), किसी एक वर्ष में 30 mSv से अधिक नहीं
प्रति वर्ष 20 mSv, बिना किसी लचीलेपन के
e: Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB, India) aur ICRP 103 mandates ke anusar radiation workers (technologists, radiologists) ke liye whole-body annual occupational effective dose ceiling structured block system par based hoti hai. Five consecutive calendar years ke block duration mein worker ki total cumulative dose $100\text{ mSv}$ exceed nahi karni chahiye, jo nominal average $20\text{ mSv per year}$ deliver karti hai. Routine operational workload fluctuations accommodate karne ke liye flexibility rule permit kiya jata hai jiske mutabiq kisi bhi individual single year mein dose maximum $30\text{ mSv}$ tak ja sakti hai, provided 5-year overall total $100\text{ mSv}$ cap cross na ho.

qe: According to revised AERB and ICRP directives, what is the annual equivalent dose limit for the Lens of the Eye for an occupational worker?
qh: AERB/ICRP के संशोधित दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार रेडिएशन वर्कर के लिए आंखों के लेंस (Eye Lens) की वार्षिक औसत खुराक सीमा क्या है?
oe: 20 mSv/year (averaged over 5 years, not exceeding 50 mSv in any single year)
oh: 20 mSv/year (5 वर्ष के औसत पर, किसी 1 वर्ष में 50 mSv से अधिक नहीं)
e: Pehle radiation-induced cataractogenesis ko high threshold dose wala non-stochastic effect mana jata tha aur historical annual limit 150 mSv/year set thi. Lekin recent clinical research aur epidemiological data ne reveal kiya ki ocular lens threshold dose pehle maane gaye levels se significantly lower hoti hai. ICRP 118 statement aur updated AERB regulations ke tehat eye lens limit ko drastically reduce kiya gaya. Ab occupational workers ke liye lens of the eye ki annual equivalent dose limit $20\text{ mSv per year}$ averaged over 5 consecutive years set hai, jisme kisi ek single calendar year mein maximum limit $50\text{ mSv}$ se exceed nahi honi chahiye.

qe: What is the prescribed annual equivalent dose limit for the skin, hands, and feet (extremities) of an occupational radiation worker?
qh: रेडिएशन कर्मचारी के लिए त्वचा, हाथ एवं पैरों (Extremities) की वार्षिक समतुल्य खुराक सीमा कितनी निर्धारित है?
e: Interventional radiology, fluoroscopy beam guidance aur nuclear medicine radiopharmaceutical dispensing ke dauran technologists aur physicians ke hands, feet aur superficial facial skin primary scatter field ke direct proximity mein expose hote hain. In localized body extremities aur skin dermal layer par deterministic tissue damage (jaise erythema, dry desquamation, necrosis ya vascular fibrosis) completely prevent karne ke liye regulatory agencies ne annual equivalent dose limit exactly $500\text{ mSv per year}$ ($50\text{ rem/year}$) establish ki hai. Skin dose ko standardly $1\text{ cm}^2$ ke worst-exposed surface area par average karke calculate kiya jata hai.

qe: What is the annual whole-body effective dose limit prescribed for individual members of the General Public?
qh: आम जनता (General Public) के सदस्यों के लिए संपूर्ण शरीर की वार्षिक प्रभावी खुराक सीमा कितनी है?
e: General public individuals (hospital visitors, waiting relatives, adjacent non-radiation staff) involuntary exposure sustain karte hain bina direct medical benefit ya personalized training ke. Isliye public dose limits occupational standards se substantially strict set ki jaati hain. AERB aur ICRP standards ke mutabiq general public ke members ke liye whole-body annual effective dose limit $1\text{ mSv per year}$ ($0.1\text{ rem/year}$) fix ki gayi hai. Exceptional operational circumstances mein kisi single year mein $5\text{ mSv}$ permit ho sakta hai, basharte consecutive 5 years ka average overall $1\text{ mSv/year}$ ceiling maintain kare. Natural background aur diagnostic medical exposures is limit mein exempt rehte hain.

qe: Once a female radiation worker formally declares a pregnancy, what is the permissible dose limit for the conceptus/fetus during the remainder of the pregnancy?
qh: एक महिला रेडिएशन कर्मचारी द्वारा गर्भावस्था (Pregnancy) घोषित किए जाने के बाद, शेष गर्भावस्था अवधि के दौरान भ्रूण (Fetus) की खुराक सीमा क्या होगी?
e: Developing embryo aur fetus rapidly dividing undifferentiated stem cells se compose hote hain, jo Law of Bergonie-Tribondeau ke anusar radiation-induced teratogenic microcephaly, mental retardation aur childhood leukemia ke prati extremely vulnerable hote hain. AERB aur ICRP protocol ke tehat jab female worker written declaration of pregnancy submit karti hai, tab fetus ko general public member categorize kiya jata hai. Declaration ke baad bachi hui pure gestational pregnancy period ke dauran fetal abdomen par cumulative equivalent dose strictly $1\text{ mSv}$ ($100\text{ mrem}$) se exceed nahi honi chahiye, jise lead apron ke neeche additional monthly TLD badge pehankar actively monitor kiya jata hai.

qe: What is the annual effective dose limit prescribed for students and apprentices (trainees) aged 16 to 18 years pursuing radiography education?
qh: रेडियोग्राफी का प्रशिक्षण ले रहे 16 से 18 वर्ष के छात्रों/प्रशिक्षुओं (Trainees) के लिए वार्षिक प्रभावी खुराक सीमा क्या है?
e: Radiography, nuclear medicine ya radiation therapy technology programs mein enrolled 16 se 18 years age bracket ke student trainees biological development phase mein hote hain, isliye unhe full adult professional workers (20 mSv/year) ki barabar exposure boundary allow nahi ki jaati. AERB safety directives ke anusar in younger trainees ke professional educational training curriculum ke dauran annual effective dose limit exactly $6\text{ mSv per calendar year}$ ($0.6\text{ rem/year}$) capped rehti hai. Sath hi 16 years se kam age ke students ko occupational ionizing radiation fields mein practical entry completely prohibit hoti hai.

qe: What is the prescribed annual radiation dose limit for a patient undergoing diagnostic X-ray examinations in a radiology department?
qh: रेडियोलॉजी विभाग में एक्स-रे कराने आए मरीज़ (Patient) के लिए निर्धारित वार्षिक विकिरण खुराक सीमा क्या है?
oe: No fixed numerical dose limits apply (Justification and Optimization principles apply)
oh: कोई निश्चित खुराक सीमा लागू नहीं होती (औचित्य और अनुकूलन सिद्धांत लागू होते हैं)
e: Medical diagnostic exposure mein patient par koi predefined arbitrary numerical radiation dose limit enforce nahi ki jaati. Agar rigid dose limits apply ki jayein, toh critical life-saving emergencies (jaise polytrauma CT evaluation, complex angiographies ya repeated follow-up scans) restrict ho jayengi aur direct clinical patient harm hoga. Medical radiation purely ICRP ke do core pillars par govern hoti hai: Justification (diagnostic image se milne wala clinical health benefit radiation risk se significantly outweigh hona chahiye) aur Optimization / ALARA (diagnostic quality achieve karne ke liye exposure parameters kVp, mAs aur collimation ko minimum practical level par tune kiya jaye).

qe: What are the prescribed annual equivalent dose limits for the Lens of the Eye and the Skin for members of the general public?
qh: आम जनता के लिए आंखों के लेंस (Lens of the eye) और त्वचा (Skin) की वार्षिक समतुल्य खुराक सीमा क्रमशः क्या है?
e: General public individuals ke liye whole-body effective dose limit ($1\text{ mSv/year}$) ke sath specific localized tissues ke liye individual equivalent dose ceilings specify ki gayi hain taaki deterministic non-stochastic injury zero probability par control rahe. ICRP guidelines aur AERB regulatory manual ke mutabiq general public ke liye Lens of the Eye ki annual equivalent dose limit $15\text{ mSv per year}$ establish ki gayi hai. Dermal Skin layer ke liye ye limit $50\text{ mSv per year}$ ($5\text{ rem/year}$) standard set ki gayi hai, jo worst-exposed $1\text{ cm}^2$ skin patch par average ki jaati hai.

qe: What is the minimum lead (Pb) equivalence and physical height required for a Primary Protective Barrier from the finished floor level?
qh: प्राइमरी प्रोटेक्टिव बैरियर (Primary Protective Barrier) की न्यूनतम लेड (Pb) समकक्षता और फर्श से न्यूनतम ऊंचाई कितनी होनी चाहिए?
oe: 0.5 mm Pb equivalence and 5 feet height
1.5 mm to 2.0 mm Pb equivalence and 2.1 meters (7 feet) height
0.75 mm Pb equivalence and 6 feet height
3.0 mm Pb equivalence and 10 feet height
oh: 1.5 mm से 2.0 mm Pb और 2.1 meter (7 feet)
e: Primary Protective Barrier room construction ka wo structural wall ya floor segment hota hai jis par unattenuated primary X-ray beam directly strike karne ke liye aim ki ja sakti hai (jaise chest wall stand ke piche ki wall ya floor). Unattenuated direct photons ko block karne ke liye AERB guidelines mandate karti hain ki primary barrier minimum $1.5\text{ mm to } 2.0\text{ mm}$ pure lead equivalent material (ya equivalent $15\text{ cm}$ thick high-density solid concrete) se construct hona compulsory hai. Sath hi barrier ki shielding height finished floor level se continuously minimum $2.1\text{ meters}$ (approximately 7 feet) vertical height tak extend honi chahiye.

qe: What is the primary operational objective of a Secondary Protective Barrier in radiographic room design?
qh: सेकेंडरी प्रोटेक्टिव बैरियर (Secondary Barrier) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य किस प्रकार के विकिरण से सुरक्षा प्रदान करना होता है?
oe: Shielding against the unattenuated primary direct X-ray beam
Attenuation of alpha and beta particulate emissions exclusively
Protection against scattered radiation from the patient and leakage radiation from the tube housing
Absorption of ambient extraterrestrial cosmic rays
oh: लीकेज रेडिएशन और स्कैटर (बिखरा हुआ) रेडिएशन
e: Secondary Protective Barrier radiology department ki un structural walls, ceiling ya control booth barriers ko designate kiya jata hai jin par useful primary beam kabhi direct intersect nahi karti. Inka sole engineering purpose patient body se 360-degree angles par deflect hone wale Compton Scatter Radiation aur lead tube housing se permeate hone wale tube Leakage Radiation ko safely absorb karna hota hai. Chunki scattered aur leakage radiation photons primary beam se markedly lower energy display karte hain, isliye secondary barrier ke liye typically $0.75\text{ mm to } 1.0\text{ mm}$ lead equivalence (ya $7.5\text{ cm}$ solid concrete) design parameter standard mana jata hai.

qe: In radiation shielding design equations, in which physical unit is the facility 'Workload' (W) standardly expressed?
qh: एक्स-रे रूम शील्डिंग गणना में 'वर्कलोड' (Workload, W) को सामान्यतः किस इकाई में व्यक्त किया जाता है?
e: Radiation room structural barrier thickness (NCRP Report 147 aur AERB specifications) calculate karte waqt Workload ($W$) ek primary design variable hota hai jo diagnostic X-ray suite ki total weekly radiation output capacity reflect karta hai. Ye machine ke operational tube current (mA) aur total operational beam exposure time (minutes) ka weekly product hota hai, isliye ise milliampere-minutes per week ($mA\text{-min/week}$) unit mein express kiya jata hai. Ek busy institutional clinical radiography room 500 se 1000 mA-min/week generate kar sakta hai, jabki dedicated low-volume extremities clinic mein workload substantially lower level par quantify hota hai.

qe: What does a 'Use Factor' (U) value of 1 signify in radiological structural shielding calculations?
qh: शील्डिंग डिज़ाइन में 'Use Factor' (U) = 1 का क्या अर्थ है?
oe: Staff personnel occupy the space behind the barrier 100% of the operational time
The primary X-ray beam is directed toward that specific wall or floor 100% of the operating time
Only a single X-ray machine operates within the shielding enclosure
The electrical generator operates at 100% physical efficiency
oh: दीवार के पीछे 100% समय कर्मचारी उपस्थित रहते हैं
एक्स-रे बीम का शत-प्रतिशत परिचालन समय सीधे उसी विशेष दीवार या फर्श की ओर निर्देशित रहता है (U = 1)
कमरे में केवल 1 एक्स-रे मशीन है
e: Use Factor ($U$) shielding calculation formula ($B = P \times d^2 / (W \times U \times T)$) ka fractional coefficient hota hai jo X-ray beam operational exposure time ke us percentage fraction ko define karta hai jab useful beam intentional direction mein kisi particular barrier wall ya floor ki taraf oriented rehti hai. Agar kisi barrier ke liye $U = 1$ (Full Use) assign kiya gaya hai, toh iska absolute matlab hai ki machine ke 100% exposure hours ke dauran primary beam direct us particular barrier ki taraf pointed rehti hai. Routine architectural layout mein vertical chest bucky stand ke piche wali wall aur standard table exposures ke liye floor ka Use Factor standardly $U = 1$ liya jata hai.

qe: For areas surrounding an X-ray room, an Occupancy Factor (T) value of '1' (Full Occupancy) is designated for which areas?
qh: रेडियोलॉजी रूम के आस-पास के क्षेत्रों के लिए Occupancy Factor (T) का मान '1' (पूर्ण अधिभोग) किसके लिए निर्धारित किया जाता है?
