oe: Control rooms, administrative offices, darkrooms, and nurse work stations
oh: कंट्रोल रूम, कार्यालय, डार्क रूम और नर्स स्टेशन (T = 1)
e: Occupancy Factor ($T$) shielding mathematics ka correction parameter hai jo barrier wall ke piche adjacent space mein individuals ke presence time fraction ko characterize karta hai. Full Occupancy ($T = 1$) un clinical administrative work zones ke liye apply hota hai jahan staff personnel daily 8-hour shift bhar continuous desk par rehte hain—jaise X-ray control consoles, radiologist reporting offices, darkrooms, nurses stations aur adjacent patient treatment wards. Iske contrast mein transient pedestrian hallways ($T = 1/5$), public waiting areas ($T = 1/5$ to $1/20$), aur unattended elevators ya parking facilities ($T = 1/40$) ke liye $T$ significantly small factor design kiya jata hai.

qe: What is the minimum lead (Pb) equivalence required for the protective lead glass viewing window installed in an X-ray control console?
qh: एक्स-रे कंट्रोल कंसोल में लगी प्रोटेक्टिव लेड ग्लास व्यूइंग विंडो की न्यूनतम लेड समकक्षता कितनी होनी चाहिए?
oh: 1.5 mm से 2.0 mm Pb समकक्ष (1.5 - 2.0 mm Pb)
e: X-ray control booth console room ka designated occupational safe shelter hota hai jahan se technician patient ko visually observe karte hue exposures activate karta hai. Booth ki viewing window transparency maintain karne ke sath dense ionizing radiation attenuation provide karne ke liye lead-oxide infused heavy silicate glass (Lead Glass) ya lead acrylic se construct hoti hai. AERB regulatory safety guidelines ke mutabiq operator viewing window ki structural shielding thickness control panel partition wall ke barabar yaani minimum $1.5\text{ mm to } 2.0\text{ mm}$ pure lead equivalent material mandatory provide karni chahiye taaki scatter radiation leak zero level rahe.

qe: What is the mandatory minimum lead equivalence required for lead aprons used during fluoroscopy, cardiac cath lab, and C-arm procedures (>100 kVp)?
qh: फ्लोरोस्कोपी, कार्डियक कैथ लैब और C-Arm प्रक्रियाओं (>100 kVp) में उपयोग किए जाने वाले लेड एप्रन की न्यूनतम मोटाई क्या होनी चाहिए?
e: General low-workload plain radiography suites mein 0.25 mm Pb equivalent lead aprons sufficient attenuation deliver karte hain. Lekin continuous dynamic fluoroscopy, C-Arm surgical suites aur interventional cardiology cath labs mein tube high operational potentials (100-120 kVp) par continuous fluoroscopic intervals operate karti hai, jisse massive scatter radiation field patient table se emerge hota hai. AERB aur ICRP directives ke mutabiq high scatter fields mein operating physicians aur technologists ke lead aprons ki structural thickness minimum $0.5\text{ mm}$ lead equivalence honi compulsory hai, jo incident scatter beam ko over 95%-99% efficiently attenuate kar deti hai.

qe: Which thermoluminescent phosphor material is standardly used in the TLD badges manufactured for personnel monitoring in India?
qh: भारत में पर्सनल मॉनिटरिंग के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले TLD बैज में कौन सा थर्मोल्यूमिनेसेंट फॉस्फोर पदार्थ उपयोग किया जाता है?
oe: Lithium Fluoride doped with Magnesium and Titanium (LiF:Mg,Ti)
oh: डिस्प्रोसियम युक्त कैल्शियम सल्फेट - CaSO₄:Dy (Calcium Sulphate doped with Dysprosium)
e: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC, Mumbai) dwara establish kiye gaye national personnel dosimetry monitoring framework ke tehat Indian TLD badge cards mein Calcium Sulphate doped with Dysprosium ($CaSO_4:Dy$) active thermoluminescent crystalline phosphor use hota hai. Ye phosphor discs high-temperature resistant Teflon matrix ke sath bind karke aluminum carrier card par mount ki jaati hain. CaSO4:Dy ka core advantage iska exceptional radiation sensitivity level, minimal thermal fading profile aur wide linear dose response range ($10\,\mu\text{Sv}$ se over $10\text{ Sv}$) hota hai, jo diagnostic X-ray, gamma rays aur beta monitoring ke liye highly reliable material hai.

qe: When only a single TLD badge is issued to a diagnostic radiology worker, where must it be worn when wearing a protective lead apron?
qh: नैदानिक एक्स-रे विभाग में जब केवल एक TLD बैज जारी किया गया हो, तो लेड एप्रन पहनते समय इसे कहाँ पहना जाना चाहिए?
oe: Outside the lead apron at the thyroid collar level
Underneath the lead apron at the chest/waist level
Fastened around the wrist like a bracelet
oh: लेड एप्रन के ऊपर कॉलर के स्तर पर
लेड एप्रन के अंदर छाती/कमर के स्तर पर (Underneath the apron at chest level)
e: AERB occupational monitoring guidelines ke standard single-badge protocol ke tehat individual TLD badge ko hamesha protective lead apron ke inside chest ya waist trunk level par wear karna compulsory hota hai. Single badge ka prime purpose worker ke vital trunk organs (heart, lungs, bone marrow, gastrointestinal viscera) dwara sustain ki gayi actual Whole-Body Absorbed Dose ko measure karna hota hai. Agar single badge ko lead apron ke bahar pehan liya jaye, toh dosimeter reading false elevated values record karegi jo actual biological dose ko gross over-estimate kar degi aur institutional investigation alarms unnecessarily trigger karegi.

qe: Under the two-badge monitoring protocol in interventional radiology, where is the second TLD badge positioned?
qh: इंटरवेंशनल रेडियोलॉजी या कैथ लैब में टू-बैज (Two-Badge) प्रोटोकॉल के तहत दूसरा TLD बैज कहाँ पहना जाता है?
oe: Outside the lead apron at the collar/thyroid level
Underneath the apron along the posterior back surface
Firmly concealed underneath the thyroid collar
oh: लेड एप्रन के बाहर कॉलर/गले के स्तर पर (Outside the apron at collar level)
पीठ के पीछे एप्रन के अंदर
e: Interventional fluoroscopy suites aur cath labs mein continuous scatter radiation exposure ki wajah se Two-Badge Dosimetry System deploy kiya jata hai. Pehla TLD badge lead apron ke andar chest level par wear kiya jata hai jo shielded core visceral organs ki Deep Equivalent Dose ($H_p(10)$) measure karta hai. Doosra TLD badge lead apron ke bahar neck collar level par open position mein wear kiya jata hai. Ye unshielded second badge unattenuated scatter fields ko intercept karke worker ke Lens of the Eye aur unshielded head-neck tissues ki equivalent dose exposure ko accurately calculate aur monitor karta hai.

qe: What is the standard personnel monitoring service exchange cycle (monitoring period) for TLD badges in Indian diagnostic radiology departments?
qh: डायग्नोस्टिक रेडियोलॉजी विभाग में नियमित कर्मियों के लिए TLD बैज का सर्विस/बदलाव चक्र (Monitoring Period) सामान्यतः कितना होता है?
e: India mein diagnostic radiology suites (X-ray, CT, dental units) mein routine personnel radiation monitoring ke liye AERB aur BARC accredited processing laboratories dwara standard Quarterly Monitoring Period (3 continuous calendar months) establish kiya gaya hai. Every three months ke end par pura batch of used TLD cards centralized processing laboratory ko courier dispatch hota hai jahan automated hot-gas TLD readers thermoluminescence glow curves evaluate karke cumulative dose records update karte hain. High-workload therapeutic radiation suites ya interventional cath labs mein radiation officer assessment ke basis par monthly cycle bhi implement ho sakti hai.

qe: Why are three distinct filter regions (Metal Cu-Al, Plastic, and Open Window) engineered into the BARC TLD badge cassette?
qh: BARC TLD कैसेट में तीन अलग-अलग फ़िल्टर क्षेत्र (Metal/Cu-Al, Plastic, Open) क्यों दिए जाते हैं?
oe: To waterproof the badge and provide aesthetic structural design
To differentiate radiation types and penetration capabilities, calculating deep dose and surface skin dose separately
Exclusively to cancel environmental natural background radiation
To identify the beam's geometric physical angle of incidence
oh: बैज को जलरोधक और आकर्षक बनाने के लिए
रेडिएशन के प्रकार और भेदन क्षमता में अंतर करके डीप और स्किन डोज़ निकालने के लिए (Deep vs Skin Dose)
सिर्फ बैकग्राउंड रेडिएशन को शून्य करने के लिए
एक्स-रे की दिशा निर्धारित करने के लिए
e: BARC TLD card ke teen CaSO4:Dy discs cassette ke specific physical filter windows ke piche seal hote hain: Filter-1 Copper-Aluminium ($Cu+Al$) metal filters se cover hota hai jo sirf high-energy penetrating photons (gamma aur X-rays) ko pass hone deta hai, jo Deep Tissue Dose ($H_p(10)$) measure karta hai; Filter-2 transparent Perspex plastic sheet se covered hota hai jo beta particulate aur soft X-rays ko modulate karta hai; aur Filter-3 completely Open Window (unfiltered) rehta hai jo non-penetrating surface radiation aur beta particles capture karta hai. In teeno discs ke differential glow responses ko mathematically compare karke skin/surface dose ($H_p(0.07)$) aur deep whole-body dose accurately extract hoti hai.

qe: In skull radiography positioning, what is the approximate angular difference between the Orbitomeatal Line (OML) and the Infraorbitomeatal Line (IOML / Reid's Base Line)?
qh: कपाल (Skull) की पोज़ीशनिंग में Orbitomeatal Line (OML) और Infraorbitomeatal Line (IOML / Reid's Base Line) के बीच लगभग कितने डिग्री का कोणीय अंतर होता है?
e: Skull positioning mein craniometric reference baselines accurate tube angulation aur anatomical projection ke liye primary guideline hoti hain. Orbitomeatal Line (OML) outer canthus of eye se external acoustic meatus (EAM) ke center tak run karti hai, jabki Infraorbitomeatal Line (IOML / Reid's base line) inferior orbital margin se EAM tak extend hoti hai. In dono standardized cranial planes ke beech fixed angular difference exactly 7° to 8° (on average 7°) hota hai. Jab kisi geriatric ya trauma patient mein cervical flexion restricted hone ke kaaran standard OML perpendicular nahi ho pati aur IOML ko cassette plane ke perpendicular rakha jata hai, tab standard central ray angle mein 7° add karke compensation kiya jata hai.

qe: In Towne's View (AP Axial Skull), if the patient's Orbitomeatal Line (OML) is perpendicular to the image receptor, what is the correct angle and direction of the Central Ray (CR)?
qh: Towne's View (AP Axial Skull) में यदि मरीज़ की Orbitomeatal Line (OML) इमेज रिसेप्टर के लंबवत हो, तो सेंट्रल रे (CR) का सही कोण और दिशा क्या होगी?
e: Towne's View occipital bone aur posterior cranial fossa ke internal architectural structures ko visualize karne ke liye dedicated AP axial projection hota hai. Jab patient supine ya erect posture mein chin depress karke Orbitomeatal Line (OML) ko image receptor ke exactly perpendicular maintain karta hai, tab central ray ko midsagittal plane par glabella se 2.5 inches superior enter karate hue 30° Caudad angle diya jata hai. Ye beam trajectory dense facial bones aur frontal profile ko caudal direction mein project karke foramen magnum, dorsum sellae aur petrous ridges ko symmetric profile mein magnify aur open karti hai. Agar patient OML flex na kar sake aur IOML perpendicular ho, toh angle 37° Caudad set hota hai.

qe: In a properly positioned and correctly angled Towne's View radiograph, which anatomical structures should project clearly inside the lumen of the Foramen Magnum?
qh: एक त्रुटिरहित (properly positioned) Towne's View रेडियोग्राफ़ में Foramen Magnum की छाया के ठीक अंदर कौन सी संरचनाएं स्पष्ट रूप से प्रोजेक्ट होनी चाहिए?
oe: Dorsum sellae and Posterior clinoid processes
Upper two-thirds of the Petrous pyramids
oh: डॉर्सम सेली और पोस्टीरियर क्लिनॉइड प्रोसेस (Dorsum sellae & Posterior clinoids)
पेट्रस पिरामिड्स का ऊपरी दो-तिहाई भाग
e: Towne's projection mein diagnostic technical accuracy confirm karne ka prime anatomical criteria foramen magnum ke opening lumen ke andar sphenoid bone ki posterior structures ka visualization hota hai. Agar central ray ka caudal inclination exactly 30° to OML (ya 37° to IOML) achieve ho, toh Foramen Magnum ke radiolucent oval aperture ke theek center mein Dorsum Sellae aur dono Posterior Clinoid Processes ki cortical outline project hoti hai. Agar tube angulation insufficient (under-angulated, e.g., <25°) ho, toh dorsum sellae foramen magnum ke superior border par superimpose ho jata hai, jabki excessive over-angulation (>35°) posterior atlas arch ko foramen lumen ke andar project kar deta hai.

qe: During positioning for the Waters View (Occipito-mental View) of the paranasal sinuses, what angle does the OML form with the plane of the image receptor (IR)?
qh: पैरानासल साइनस के Waters View (Occipito-mental View) में पोज़ीशनिंग के दौरान OML इमेज रिसेप्टर (IR) के समतल के साथ कितने डिग्री का कोण बनाती है?
e: Waters View (Parietoacanthial projection) maxillary sinuses aur mid-facial bones ka gold standard examination hai. Is view mein patient erect stance mein khada hokar neck extend karta hai taaki chin baki plate ke center se firm contact establish kare aur nose plate surface se roughly 0.5 to 1 inch clear rahe. Is precise neck extension geometry par Mentomeatal Line (MML) image receptor plane ke perpendicular align ho jaati hai. MML ke perpendicular hote hi Orbitomeatal Line (OML) cassette plane ke surface ke sath exactly 37° ka mechanical angle form karti hai. Ye 37-degree elevation dense petrous temporal bones ko inferiorly displace kar deta hai.

qe: Which radiographic projection is best suited for evaluating air-fluid levels in the maxillary sinuses and orbital floor blow-out fractures?
qh: मैक्सिलरी साइनस में वायु-तरल स्तर (Air-fluid levels) और ऑर्बिटल फ्लोर के ब्लो-आउट फ्रैक्चर (Blow-out fracture) के मूल्यांकन के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त दृश्य कौन सा है?
e: Maxillary antrum pathologies, acute sinusitis, hemoperitoneum aur facial trauma mein Waters View sabse informative view hai. Neck ke 37° hyperextension ki wajah se skull ke dense petrous pyramids maxillary antra ke inferior floors se theek niche project ho jaate hain. Resultantly, bilateral maxillary sinuses superimposition-free clear air cavities ke roop mein appear hote hain, jahan horizontal X-ray beam ke sath upright position mein subtle air-fluid levels instantly demarcate ho jaate hain. Sath hi ye projection inferior orbital rim aur orbital floor integrity evaluate karta hai, jisse blunt ocular trauma se hone wale blow-out fractures aur maxillary roof teardrop herniations accurately detect hote hain.

qe: In the standard Caldwell View (PA Axial 15°) with a 15° Caudad beam angle, where should the shadow of the petrous pyramids (petrous ridges) project?
qh: Caldwell View (PA Axial 15°) में जब सेंट्रल रे को 15° Caudad निर्देशित किया जाता है, तो पेट्रस पिरामिड (Petrous ridges) की छाया कहाँ दिखाई देनी चाहिए?
oe: Directly in the center of the maxillary sinuses
In the lower one-third (1/3) of the orbits
Completely below and outside the orbital margins
oh: मैक्सिलरी साइनस के ठीक बीच में
ऑर्बिट्स के निचले एक-तिहाई भाग में - Lower 1/3 of the orbits
e: Caldwell projection skull ke frontal bone, frontal sinuses aur anterior ethmoid cells ke evaluation ke liye design kiya gaya PA axial view hai. Patient nose aur forehead dono baki cassette par rest karta hai jisse OML cassette ke strictly perpendicular hoti hai. Central ray ko nasion par 15° Caudad direction mein enter karaya jata hai. Is 15-degree caudal beam inclination ke kaaran dense petrous temporal ridges dono orbits ke lower one-third (inferior 1/3) profile par project hoti hain. Is specific displacement se superior orbital fissures, supraorbital margins aur superior two-thirds orbital cavities bina kisi petrous bone superimposition ke radiolucent visualize hoti hain.

qe: Which axial radiographic projection is performed for symmetric, bilateral evaluation of both Zygomatic Arches and the Sphenoid Sinus?
qh: दोनों Zygomatic Arches और Sphenoid Sinus के सममितीय (symmetric) मूल्यांकन के लिए कौन सा अक्षीय दृश्य (axial view) किया जाता है?
e: Submentovertex (SMV / Schüller method) projection skull base aur facial bones ka true full-axial radiograph deliver karta hai. Isme patient ko supine ya erect seated position mein neck severely hyperextend karayi jaati hai jab tak Infraorbitomeatal Line (IOML) vertical cassette surface ke strictly parallel na ho jaye. Central ray ko midsagittal plane par mandibles ke gonions ke intermediate point se vertex ki taraf IOML ke exactly perpendicular enter karaya jata hai. Is axial profile par cranial base ke foramina (ovale, spinosum), dense sphenoid sinus cavity aur bilateral delicate zygomatic arches temporal bones ke laterally symmetric profile mein completely clear display hoti hain.

qe: Which specialized radiographic method is employed to visualize the Optic Canal and Optic Foramen in an undistorted, circular end-on profile?
qh: ऑप्टिक कैनाल और ऑप्टिक फोरामेन (Optic Foramen) को बिना विरूपण के गोल आकार में देखने के लिए किस विशेष विधि (Method) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Optic Canal sphenoid bone ke lesser wing mein located ek cylindrical osseous channel hota hai jisse optic nerve ($CN\,II$) aur ophthalmic artery cranial vault se orbit mein enter karti hain. Is canal ko end-on circular ring ke roop mein demonstrate karne ke liye Rhese Method (Parieto-orbital oblique) perform kiya jata hai. Patient affected orbit ko film center par rakhte hue nose, cheek aur chin ka three-point touch maintain karta hai, jisse skull Midsagittal Plane film se 53° rotate hota hai aur Acanthomeatal Line (AML) perpendicular hoti hai. Central ray perpendicular di jaati hai, jisse optic foramen orbital quadrant ke lower-outer third segment mein undistorted circular form mein appear hota hai.

qe: Which skull projection is mandatory for the precise diagnostic evaluation of the shape, margins, and bony erosion of the Pituitary Fossa and Sella Turcica?
qh: पिट्यूटरी फोसा (Pituitary fossa) और सेला टर्सिका (Sella turcica) के आकार एवं क्षरण (erosion) के सटीक डायग्नोस्टिक मूल्यांकन हेतु कौन सा दृश्य अनिवार्य है?
oh: ट्रू लेटरल स्कल - True Lateral Skull
e: Sella Turcica sphenoid bone ki superior surface par deep saddle-shaped depression hota hai jo pituitary gland (hypophysis cerebri) ko cradle karta hai. Iska structural outline lateral profile mein hi best demonstrate hota hai. True Lateral Skull projection mein patient ka Midsagittal Plane film ke strictly parallel aur Interpupillary Line (IPL) film surface ke precisely perpendicular rakhi jaati hai. Central ray ko EAM se 3/4 inch anterior aur 3/4 inch superior target kiya jata hai. Is non-rotated projection se anterior clinoid processes, tuberculum sellae, hypophyseal fossa aur dorsum sellae superimposed profiles mein sharp bony margin borders ke sath evaluate hoti hain, jisse adenoma-induced sellar enlargement ya erosion detect hota hai.

qe: If the petrous pyramids completely superimpose and obscure the entire orbital cavities in a Caldwell projection, what positioning error was committed?
qh: यदि Caldwell दृश्य में पेट्रस पिरामिड पूरे ऑर्बिट को पूरी तरह ढक लें (superimpose कर लें), तो पोज़ीशनिंग में क्या त्रुटि हुई है?
oe: The Central Ray had zero angle (0° PA perpendicular beam)
The tube angle was excessive, exceeding 30° Caudad
The patient's neck was excessively hyperextended
The patient's mouth remained widely opened
oh: सेंट्रल रे में कोई कोण नहीं दिया गया - 0° PA Beam
ट्यूब एंगल 30° कॉडैड से अधिक था
गर्दन अत्यधिक एक्सटेंड हो गई थी
मरीज़ का मुंह खुला रह गया था
e: Standard Caldwell projection mein 15° Caudad angulation petrous pyramids ko orbits ke lower 1/3 border par displace karne ke liye mandatory hota hai. Agar radiographer tube gantry par angle dena bhool jaye aur 0° perpendicular Central Ray (standard PA projection) fire kar de, toh dense petrous pyramids direct orbital cavities ke theek center mein cast ho jaati hain. Ye vertical superimposition orbital rims, superior orbital fissures aur ethmoidal air labyrinths ko total radiographic shadow se block kar deti hai. Is error ka corrective step central ray ko nasion par accurately 15° caudal tilt dena ya neck angle calibrate karna hota hai.

qe: What is the primary clinical objective of obtaining an Open-Mouth (Transoral AP) Cervical Spine radiograph?
qh: Open-Mouth (Transoral AP) सर्वाइकल स्पाइन रेडियोग्राफ़ का मुख्य नैदानिक उद्देश्य क्या प्रदर्शित करना है?
oe: To visualize the C7-T1 cervicothoracic junction
To demonstrate C1 (Atlas) and C2 (Axis) Odontoid Process (Dens) and Zygapophyseal Joints
To inspect the narrow thoracic inlet
To evaluate the petrous carotid canal
oh: C1-C2 का ओडोंटोइड प्रोसेस (Dens) और ज़ाइगापोफिसियल जोड़ - Dens & Atlas/Axis
e: Upper cervical spine (C1-Atlas aur C2-Axis) standard AP projection mein dense radiopaque maxilla, upper incisors aur occipital base se heavily obscured rehti hai. Transoral (Open-Mouth AP) projection mein patient mouth ko maximally open karta hai aur head tilt adjust karke upper incisor teeth ke lower edge ko occipital bone base ke line-of-sight mein match kiya jata hai. Central ray open oral cavity ke center se perpendicular traverse karti hai. Ye projection Odontoid process (Dens), C1 lateral masses, C1-C2 atlantoaxial zygapophyseal joints aur lateral interspaces ko superimposition-free visualize karti hai, jo Jefferson burst fractures aur type I-III Dens fractures diagnose karne ke liye critical hai.

qe: To open the C3-C7 intervertebral disk spaces on an AP Axial Cervical Spine projection, at what angle should the Central Ray be directed?
qh: AP Axial Cervical Spine प्रोजेक्शन में C3-C7 इंटरवर्टेब्रल डिस्क स्पेस को खोलने के लिए सेंट्रल रे को किस कोण पर निर्देशित किया जाता है?
e: Human cervical spine lateral profile mein convex anterior lordotic curve (cervical lordosis) exhibit karti hai, jiske kaaran C3 se C7 tak ke intervertebral disc spaces anatomical plane par horizontally flat na hokar upward-anterior sloping angle form karte hain. Agar 0° perpendicular beam use ki jaye, toh adjacent vertebral bodies disc spaces par overlap ho jayengi. In intervertebral spaces ko profile mein kholne ke liye central ray ko lower thyroid cartilage border (C4 level) par 15° to 20° Cephalad angle par direct kiya jata hai. Ye upward beam alignment disk spaces, uncinate processes aur intervertebral foramina margins ko distortion-free project karti hai.

qe: Why is a Lateral Cervical Spine radiograph routinely acquired at a long Source-to-Image Distance (SID) of 72 inches (180 cm)?
qh: Lateral Cervical Spine रेडियोग्राफ़ को सामान्यतः 72 inch (180 cm) की लंबी SID पर क्यों किया जाता है?
oe: To eliminate patient skin radiation dose entirely
To minimize geometric magnification and blur caused by the inevitable large OID of the shoulders
To prevent thermal X-ray tube overloading
oh: मरीज़ की डोज़ शून्य करने के लिए
कंधे के कारण बढ़ी हुई OID के मैग्निफिकेशन और ज्योमेट्रिक अनशार्पनेस को न्यूनतम करने के लिए
ग्रिड कट-ऑफ को रोकने के लिए
एक्स-रे ट्यूब को अधिक गर्म होने से बचाने के लिए
e: Lateral cervical spine positioning mein patient ka lateral shoulder surface vertical wall bucky se firmly touch karta hai. Shoulder width ki wajah se cervical spine column aur cassette plane ke beech unavoidable large Object-to-Image Distance (OID, approx 25-30 cm) create ho jata hai. Standard 40-inch SID par large OID severe geometric beam divergence cause karegi, jisse vertebrae heavily magnify ho jayenge aur penumbra blur cortical edge sharpness ko ruin kar dega. Is geometric distortion ko counteract karne ke liye SID ko 72 inches (180 cm) tak extend kiya jata hai, jisse divergent peripheral rays parallelize ho jaati hain aur recorded spatial resolution crisp maintain rehti hai.

qe: When dense muscular shoulders obscure the C7-T1 cervicothoracic junction on a lateral cervical radiograph, which specialized view is performed?
qh: जब भारी कंधों के ओवरलैप के कारण लेटरल सी-स्पाइन में C7-T1 जंक्शन न दिखे, तो कौन सा विशेष दृश्य किया जाता है?
e: Trauma radiography mein standard lateral cervical spine tab tak clinically negative announce nahi ho sakti jab tak entire C7 body aur C7-T1 intervertebral junction clearly demonstrate na ho. Muscular ya broad-shouldered individuals mein dono shoulders ka superimposition is transition zone ko opaque shadow se hide kar deta hai. Aise cases mein Swimmer's View (Twining Method) kiya jata hai. Patient baki-adjacent arm ko maximally upar elevate karta hai jabki remote arm ko downward pull (depress) karta hai. Ye opposed arm position dono shoulder humeral heads aur clavicles ko vertically separate kar deti hai, jisse C7, T1 aur T2 bodies inter-humeral window mein visualize ho jaati hain.

qe: In an Anterior Oblique projection (RAO / LAO) of the cervical spine, what should be the Central Ray angle with 45° body rotation to visualize the intervertebral foramina?
qh: सर्वाइकल स्पाइन के Anterior Oblique प्रोजेक्शन (RAO / LAO) में इंटरवर्टेब्रल फोरामिना देखने के लिए शरीर के 45° रोटेशन के साथ सेंट्रल रे का कोण क्या होना चाहिए?
oe: 15° to 20° Caudad (demonstrating downside foramina closest to IR)
e: Cervical intervertebral foramina coronal plane se 45° anteriorly aur transverse plane se 15° inferiorly directed hote hain. Cervical spine ke oblique views in foramina ko open demonstrate karte hain. Anterior Oblique projections (RAO aur LAO) mein patient body plane ko 45° rotate karke tube ko 15° to 20° Caudad angle diya jata hai. Ye downward angulation cassette ke adjacent side wale (downside/closest to image receptor) intervertebral foramina ko cleanly open karti hai. Anterior obliques posterior obliques (RPO/LPO with cephalic angle) ki tulna mein radiation biology point of view se preferred hote hain kyunki ye thyroid gland aur eye lenses ko primary beam exit side par rakhkar direct organ dose substantially reduce karte hain.

qe: In the classic 'Scotty Dog' appearance demonstrated on a 45° Oblique Lumbar Spine radiograph, which anatomical structure represents the 'Neck' of the dog?
qh: लम्बर स्पाइन के 45° Oblique रेडियोग्राफ़ पर दिखने वाले प्रसिद्ध 'Scotty Dog' अपीयरेंस में कुत्ते की गर्दन (Neck) किस शारीरिक संरचना का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है?
e: Lumbar spine ke 45° oblique view par vertebral posterior elements align hokar characteristic 'Scotty Dog' silhouette formulate karte hain. Is morphological model mein: Dog ka Ear = Superior Articular Process; Eye = Vertebral Pedicle (end-on view); Nose = Transverse Process; Front Leg = Inferior Articular Process; Body = Vertebral Lamina. Is dog outline ki Neck Pars Interarticularis (superior aur inferior articular processes ke intermediate bony bridge) ko denote karti hai. Clinical significance: Spondylolysis mein pars interarticularis ka stress fracture Scotty dog ki neck par radiolucent 'collar' ya gap ke roop mein appear hota hai, jo aage chalkar spondylolisthesis (vertebral slippage) induce karta hai.

qe: In the radiographic Scotty Dog appearance of the oblique lumbar spine, which vertebral component forms the 'Eye' of the dog?
qh: स्कॉटी डॉग अपीयरेंस में 'कुत्ते की आंख (Eye)' का निर्माण कशेरुका (vertebra) के किस भाग द्वारा होता है?
e: 45° oblique lumbar spine projection mein vertebral pedicle central X-ray beam ke directly parallel align ho jata hai, jisse wo radiographic image par dense, oval cortical ring ke roop mein end-on project hota hai. Ye oval ring Scotty Dog ke facial profile ke center mein settle hokar dog ki 'Eye' formulate karti hai. Proper patient positioning verify karne ke liye pedicle eye ka location vital metric hai: agar pedicle vertebral body ke theek center mein positioned hai toh body rotation exactly 45° accurate hai; agar eye posterior border ki taraf displace ho jaye toh rotation excessive (>45°) ho chuki hoti hai.

qe: In a Spot Lateral projection of the L5-S1 lumbosacral junction, if the patient's spine sags downward due to wide hips, how should the Central Ray be angled?
qh: L5-S1 जंक्शन के स्पॉट लेटरल (Spot Lateral) प्रोजेक्शन में यदि मरीज़ की कमर नीचे की ओर झुकी हो (कम सपोर्ट हो), तो सेंट्रल रे को कितना और किधर कोण दिया जाता है?
e: L5-S1 junction par spine lordotic lumbar curvature se rigid sacral kyphosis mein transition karti hai, jisse is intervertebral space ka anatomical tilt pronounced hota hai. Lateral decubitus position mein broad pelvis aur narrow waist wale patients (especially females) mein spine sag hokar table surface ki taraf laterally bend ho jaati hai. Intervertebral space ko open karne ke liye beam ko interiliac line ke parallel traverse karna chahiye. Agar waist ke niche radiolucent sponge support na diya jaye, toh is spinal sag ko compensate karne ke liye central ray ko ASIS se 1.5 inches inferior aur 2 inches posterior point par 5° Caudad (males) ya 8° Caudad (females) angle par center kiya jata hai.

qe: On a Posterior Oblique (RPO / LPO) projection of the lumbar spine, which side's Zygapophyseal Joints are demonstrated?
qh: लम्बर स्पाइन के Posterior Oblique (RPO / LPO) प्रोजेक्शन में 'Scotty Dog' किस तरफ के Zygapophyseal जोड़ों को प्रदर्शित करता है?
oe: The upside / remote side furthest from the image receptor
The downside / dependent side closest to the image receptor
Bilateral joints simultaneously on the same image
oh: फिल्म के निकटवर्ती तरफ वाले - Downside/Dependent side
e: Lumbar spine Zygapophyseal (facet) joints midsagittal plane se roughly 30° se 50° (average 45°) posteromedial plane par orient hote hain. Posterior Oblique projections (RPO aur LPO) mein patient supine position se 45° elevated hota hai. Geometrical rule ke mutabiq posterior obliques par wahi zygapophyseal joints aur interarticular facets open demonstrate hote hain jo table/image receptor ke closest contact mein hote hain (Downside / Dependent side). Example ke liye, RPO position patient ke right lumbar facet joints ko visualize karti hai, jabki LPO position left joints ko demonstrate karti hai (Anterior obliques RAO/LAO mein exactly inverse upside joints visible hote hain).

qe: Why are both lower limbs and feet rotated 15° to 20° internally for a standard AP Pelvis / Hip radiograph?
qh: स्टैंडर्ड AP Pelvis रेडियोग्राफ़ में दोनों पैरों और पंजों को 15° to 20° अंदर की ओर (Internally) क्यों घुमाया जाता है?
oe: To artificially magnify the lesser trochanter
To overcome femoral anteversion, placing the femoral necks parallel to the IR and displaying the greater trochanters in profile
To completely superimpose the sacroiliac joints
To alleviate patient discomfort during table transfer
oh: लेसर ट्रोकैन्टर को बड़ा दिखाने के लिए
एंटीवर्जन को काउंटर करके फिमोरल नेक को IR के समानांतर लाने और ग्रेटर ट्रोकैन्टर को प्रोफाइल में दिखाने के लिए
सैक्रोइलिएक जॉइंट्स को पूरी तरह ओवरलैप करने के लिए
मरीज़ को दर्द से राहत देने के लिए
e: Femoral neck coronal body plane ke relative anterior direction mein naturally 15° se 20° angled hoti hai (Femoral Anteversion). Agar patient ke pair anatomically relaxed neutral stance mein hon, toh natural external rotation ki wajah se femoral necks foreshorten ho jaati hain aur dense greater trochanters necks par superimpose ho jaate hain. AP Pelvis projection mein dono lower limbs ko feet ke toes aapas mein touch karte hue 15° to 20° medially (internally) rotate kiya jata hai. Ye rotation femoral necks ko image receptor plane ke strictly parallel place kar deti hai, jisse femoral neck apni true anatomical length mein open display hoti hai aur lesser trochanter medial border ke piche completely hide ho jata hai.

qe: In the 'Frog-Leg Lateral' projection (Modified Cleaves Method) for bilateral evaluation of hip dysplasia (DDH), how many degrees are the thighs abducted?
qh: कंजेनिटल हिप डिस्लोकेशन (DDH) के द्विपक्षीय मूल्यांकन हेतु उपयोग की जाने वाली 'Frog-Leg Lateral' (Modified Cleaves Method) में जांघों को कितना एब्डक्ट (abduct) किया जाता है?
e: Modified Cleaves Method (Bilateral Frog-Leg Lateral) pediatric patients mein Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH), slipped capital femoral epiphysis (SCFE) aur bilateral femoral head head-neck junctions evaluate karne ka standard non-trauma projection hai. Supine position mein patient dono knees ko flex karta hai aur feet ke plantar soles ko ek sath firmly touch karta hai. Is posture ke baad dono thighs ko vertical sagittal plane se symmetrically 40° to 45° laterally abduct kiya jata hai (total 80°-90° bilateral spread). Ye 40-45 degree abduction femoral necks aur acetabular relationships ka undistorted lateral profile deliver karti hai bina foreshortening create kiye.

qe: Which tangential projection is indicated to demonstrate vertical fractures of the patella and evaluate the patellofemoral joint space?
qh: पटेला के ऊर्ध्वाधर (vertical) फ्रैक्चर और पेटेलोफिमोरल जॉइंट स्पेस को टेंजेंशियल देखने के लिए कौन सा दृश्य किया जाता है?
oh: स्काईलाइन / सनराइज / सेटेगास्ट - Skyline / Sunrise / Settegast View
e: Patella ka standard AP aur lateral radiograph transverse fractures toh demonstrate kar deta hai, lekin vertical fractures aur subluxations femoral trochlear groove ke superimposition ki wajah se miss ho sakte hain. Is joint space ko axially open karne ke liye Tangential projections (Skyline / Sunrise / Settegast / Merchant methods) use kiye jaate hain. Settegast method mein knee ko 90° flex kiya jata hai aur central ray ko patellofemoral space ke tangentially 15° to 20° cephalad direction mein pass kiya jata hai. Is projection par patella ka axial cross-section, intercondylar sulcus (trochlea), vertical fracture lines aur patellar subluxation tilt crystal-clear display hote hain.

qe: Which radiographic method is recommended to visualize loose bodies ('Joint Mice') and the Intercondylar Fossa (Intercondyloid notch) of the knee without superimposition?
qh: घुटने के जोड़ के भीतर लूज़ बॉडीज़ (Joint Mice) और Intercondylar Fossa (Intercondyloid notch) को विज़ुअलाइज़ करने के लिए कौन सा दृश्य अनुशंसित है?
oh: कैम्प कोवेंट्री / होल्मब्लैड विधि - Camp Coventry / Holmblad Method (Tunnel View)
e: Distal femur ke medial aur lateral condyles ke beech deep posterior depression hota hai jise Intercondylar Fossa (intercondyloid notch) kehte hain. Standard AP view par patella aur tibial plateau is notch ko superimpose kar dete hain. Camp Coventry Method (prone position mein knee 40°-50° flexed, central ray 40°-50° caudad) ya Holmblad Method (kneeling position on all fours, knee 70° flexed, vertical beam) perform ki jaati hai. In 'Tunnel Views' par deep intercondylar notch completely open ho jaati hai, jahan cruciate ligament bony avulsions, intercondylar eminence fractures aur free calcified intra-articular osteochondral fragments ('Joint Mice') unmasked reveal hote hain.

qe: In the Ankle Mortise projection, how many degrees is the entire lower leg and foot internally (medially) rotated?
qh: टखने (Ankle Joint) के 'Mortise View' में पूरे पैर और टखने को कितने डिग्री आंतरिक रूप से (Medially) घुमाया जाता है?
e: Ankle joint talus aur mortise socket (distal tibia plafond, medial malleolus aur lateral fibular malleolus) se construct hota hai. Coronal plane par lateral malleolus medial malleolus se posteriorly positioned hota hai, jisse intermalleolar axis coronal plane se 15° to 20° backward tilted rehti hai. Standard AP view par distal fibula talus ke lateral border par overlap karti hai. Mortise View mein pure limb ko 15° to 20° medially rotate kiya jata hai taaki intermalleolar line image receptor ke exactly parallel aa jaye. Is positioning se lateral talofibular, superior tibiotalar aur medial tibiotalar joint spaces (three-sided mortise) without overlap open dikhte hain.

qe: If a femoral neck fracture is suspected in a severe trauma patient, which radiographic positioning is strictly CONTRAINDICATED?
qh: यदि किसी गंभीर ट्रॉमा मरीज़ में फिमोरल नेक के फ्रैक्चर का संदेह हो, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी पोज़ीशनिंग पूर्णतः वर्जित (Contraindicated) है?
oe: Standard AP Pelvis without limb manipulation
oh: मानक एपी पेल्विस बिना पैरों को घुमाए
e: Acute hip ya pelvic trauma patients mein jahan femoral neck, intertrochanteric fracture ya pelvic ring disruption suspected ho, Frog-Leg Lateral (Cleaves Method) absolute contraindication hoti hai. Frog-leg position ke liye thigh ko forcefully flex aur 45° laterally abduct karna padta hai. Ye aggressive physical manipulation undisplaced fracture fragments ko violently displace kar sakti hai, surrounding femoral artery/vein aur sciatic nerve ko puncture kar sakti hai, aur femoral head ki retinacular blood vessels rupture karke permanent Avascular Necrosis (AVN) induce kar sakti hai. Aise trauma cases mein bilateral pelvis AP bina pair ghumaye aur affected hip ka cross-table axiolateral (Danelius-Miller method) perform kiya jata hai.

qe: To project the Scaphoid bone free of foreshortening and carpal overlap, what specific wrist positioning is applied?
qh: स्कैफाइड अस्थि (Scaphoid bone) के फ्रैक्चर को सुपरइम्पोज़िशन से मुक्त करने के लिए कलाई की पोज़ीशनिंग में क्या किया जाता है?
oe: Extreme radial deviation of the wrist
Maximum ulnar deviation with a 10° to 15° Cephalad (proximal) beam angle
90° acute palmar flexion of the wrist
oh: अधिकतम अल्नर डेविएशन + 10° से 15° सेफैलेड कोण (Ulnar deviation with angle)
e: Scaphoid (navicular) carpal bone anatomically palmar aur lateral direction mein forward-sloping orientation par lie karti hai, jisse standard PA wrist radiograph par ye foreshortened aur curved appear hoti hai, jahan subtle non-displaced hairline waist fractures easily overlook ho jaate hain. Dedicated Scaphoid view mein patient wrist ko maximally Ulnar Deviation (little finger ki taraf eversion) mein stretch karta hai. Ulnar deviation scaphoid bone ke vertical axis ko unbend karke coronal plane par horizontally straighten kar deti hai. Sath hi central ray ko 10° to 15° proximally (along long axis of forearm) angle diya jata hai, jisse scaphoid elongated profile mein waist fracture lines clearly open dikhata hai.

qe: Which specific technical method (Gaynor-Hart Method) is employed to evaluate the Carpal Tunnel and Hook of Hamate?
qh: कार्पल टनल (Carpal Tunnel) और हुक ऑफ हैमेट (Hook of Hamate) के मूल्यांकन के लिए कौन सी विधि (Gaynor-Hart Method) अपनाई जाती है?
oe: Hyperextending the wrist 90° with a 25° to 30° Central Ray angle directed to the palm
Clenching the fist flat against the image receptor
Rotating the wrist into a 45° semi-pronated oblique position
Standard PA projection with 0° vertical beam
oh: कलाई को 90° Hyperextend करके 25° से 30° ट्यूब कोण देना (Gaynor-Hart Method)
हाथ को मुट्ठी बांधकर सीधा रखना
e: Gaynor-Hart Method (Tangential carpal tunnel projection) carpal sulcus aur median nerve canal visualize karne ke liye perform kiya jata hai jo Carpal Tunnel Syndrome aur hook of hamate fracture diagnosis ke liye primary investigation hai. Patient hand ko cassette par palm-down place karke wrist ko strap ya opposite hand ki help se actively 90° dorsiflex (hyperextend) karta hai taaki metacarpals vertical upright orientation achieve karein. Central ray ko carpal canal ke center ki taraf hand ke long axis se 25° to 30° proximal (cephalic) angle par target kiya jata hai. Ye tangential beam anterior carpal canal ko arch ke form mein display karti hai jahan pisiform, hook of hamate aur trapezium borders superimposition-free appear hote hain.

qe: Which trauma projection is most effective for immediate, definitive differentiation between Anterior vs Posterior Glenohumeral Shoulder Dislocation?
qh: कंधे के जोड़ के पूर्वकाल बनाम पश्च विस्थापन (Anterior vs Posterior Shoulder Dislocation) का त्वरित पता लगाने के लिए ट्रॉमा में कौन सा दृश्य सर्वाधिक प्रभावी है?
e: Severe acute shoulder trauma mein patient intense pain aur muscle spasm ke chalte arm rotate ya abduct nahi kar sakta. Scapular 'Y' lateral view (PA Oblique) arm manipulation ke bina perform kiya jata hai. Patient affected shoulder baki ke against place karke body ko 45° to 60° anteriorly rotate karta hai taaki scapular blade beam ke perfectly parallel aa jaye. Scapular body, superior acromion aur anterior coracoid process milkar vertical 'Y' structure formulate karte hain jiske center junction par glenoid cavity situated hoti hai. Normal joint mein humeral head is 'Y' ke center mein overlap hota hai. Anterior dislocation mein head coracoid ke niche (medial/anterior) aur posterior dislocation mein acromion ke niche (posterior) displaced rehta hai.

qe: Which specialized radiographic view (Grashey Method) is utilized to demonstrate the Glenohumeral Joint space fully open in a true AP anatomic profile?
qh: ग्लेनोह्यूमरल जॉइंट स्पेस (Glenohumeral joint space) को खुले रूप में ट्रू एपी प्रोफाइल में देखने के लिए किस विधि का उपयोग किया जाता है?
oe: Grashey Method (Rotating patient 35° to 45° toward the affected side)
oh: ग्राशे विधि - Grashey Method (शरीर को प्रभावित तरफ 35° से 45° घुमाना)
e: Standard AP Shoulder radiograph par scapula thoracic cage ki curvature ke sath contoured rehti hai, jisse glenoid fossa anteromedially 35° to 45° oriented hoti hai. Is obliquity ki wajah se standard AP view par humeral head glenoid cavity ke posterior margin par superimpose ho jata hai aur joint space overlapping shadow se seal dikhta hai. Grashey Method (AP Oblique Glenoid cavity view) mein patient upright position mein body ko affected side ki taraf 35° to 45° posteriorly rotate karta hai taaki scapula ki plane film cassette ke directly parallel aa jaye. Perpendicular beam glenoid surface ko tangential strike karti hai, jisse glenohumeral joint space bina kisi superimposition ke wide-open line ke roop mein demonstrate hota hai.

qe: In an AP Axial Clavicle projection, at what angle should the Central Ray be directed to project the clavicle completely above the thoracic ribcage and lung apices?
qh: AP Axial Clavicle प्रोजेक्शन में हंसली को पसलियों और फेफड़ों के शीर्ष (Apices) के छायांकन से पूरी तरह ऊपर प्रोजेक्ट करने के लिए सेंट्रल रे को कितना कोण दिया जाता है?
e: Standard AP Clavicle projection mein clavicular bone shadow first aur second posterior ribs tatha superior lung apical fields ke direct superimposition ke beech lie karti hai, jisse subtle hairline fractures aur sternoclavicular displacements obscure ho sakte hain. AP Axial Clavicle projection mein central ray ko mid-shaft of clavicle par 15° to 30° Cephalad direction mein angle diya jata hai. Patient habitus ke basis par thin/asthenic patients mein shallow thorax hone ke kaaran higher angle (25°-30°) aur hypersthenic/muscular patients mein flatter angle (15°-20°) employ kiya jata hai. Ye upward angulation puri clavicular shaft ko thoracic cage aur upper ribs se vertically upar radiolucent air space mein project kar deti hai.

qe: In the Inferosuperior Axial projection of the shoulder (Lawrence Method), how is the Central Ray angled horizontally through the axilla?
qh: कंधे के Inferosuperior Axial प्रोजेक्शन (Lawrence Method) में सेंट्रल रे को एक्सिला (Axilla) के माध्यम से किस कोणीय झुकाव पर निर्देशित किया जाता है?
e: Lawrence Method (Inferosuperior Transaxillary projection) non-trauma shoulder evaluations mein glenohumeral joint relationship, Hill-Sachs compression lesions aur Bankart fractures detect karne ke liye perform kiya jata hai. Patient supine position mein lie karta hai aur affected arm ko torso se 90° abduct karke external rotation mein maintain karta hai. Image receptor plate ko superior shoulder margin par neck ke theek upar vertically place kiya jata hai. Horizontal central ray ko axilla ke medial vault se hote hue humerus shaft ke across 15° to 30° Medially angle par direct kiya jata hai. Angle patient ke arm abduction degree ke inversely proportional calibrate hota hai taaki glenohumeral joint tangential view mein open project ho.

qe: The 'Mastoid tip' corresponds to which vertebral level?
qh: 'मैस्टॉइड टिप' किस कशेरुका (वर्टिब्रा) स्तर के अनुरूप होती है?
e: Mastoid process temporal bone ka ek prominent conical osseous projection hota hai jo ear canal ke theek piche palpate kiya ja sakta hai. Radiographic anatomy mein iska distal tip first cervical vertebra yaani C1 (Atlas) ke transverse process aur body ke horizontal plane se perfectly correspond karta hai. Upper cervical spine aur base-of-skull examinations jaise Open-Mouth odontoid view aur AP axial Towne's projection mein mastoid tip ek vital external topographic landmark ki tarah kaam karta hai. Is landmark ki exact spatial knowledge se technologist upper incisors aur occipital base ko align karke dens ko superimposition ke bina accurately project kar pata hai.

qe: Which anatomical landmark corresponds to the level of the 'C3-C4' vertebrae?
qh: कौन सा लैंडमार्क 'C3-C4' कशेरुकाओं के स्तर से मेल खाता है?
oe: Hyoid bone and superior border of Thyroid cartilage
oh: हायॉइड बोन और थायराइड कार्टिलेज का ऊपरी किनारा (Hyoid bone & Thyroid cartilage)
e: Anterior neck surface par Hyoid bone C3 vertebral level par locate hoti hai, jabki laryngeal prominence yaani Thyroid cartilage ka superior notch theek C4 vertebral boundary par positioned hota hai. Clinical radiology mein C3-C4 transition zone vital neurovascular junction represent karta hai kyunki isi level par Common Carotid Artery bifurcate hokar Internal aur External Carotid Arteries mein divide hoti hai. Cervical spine ke AP axial aur lateral projections set karte waqt thyroid cartilage ka superior notch central ray centering ke liye direct non-invasive surface reference banta hai, jisse middle cervical lordotic curvature detector plate ke theek center mein locate hoti hai.

qe: The 'Cricoid cartilage' marks which significant anatomical level?
qh: 'क्रिकॉइड कार्टिलेज' किस महत्वपूर्ण एनाटॉमिकल स्तर को चिह्नित करता है?
e: Cricoid cartilage larynx ki lower cartilaginous ring hoti hai jo anterior neck mein C6 vertebral body ke level par horizontally lie karti hai. Ye level human body ka ek major anatomical crossroad hai: yahan larynx terminate hokar trachea banta hai, aur upar se aane wala pharynx continue hokar direct esophagus mein convert hota hai. Sath hi Middle Cervical Sympathetic Ganglion aur vertebral artery ka C6 transverse foramen ke andar entry point isi boundary par hota hai. Lower cervical spine radiography mein C6 level par central ray direct karke lower lordotic curve aur C7-T1 junction ki baseline positioning evaluate ki jaati hai.

qe: The 'Sternal Angle' (Angle of Louis) lies at the junction of which vertebral bodies?
qh: 'स्टर्नल एंगल' (Angle of Louis) किन कशेरुकाओं के जंक्शन पर स्थित होता है?
e: Sternal Angle ya Angle of Louis sternum ke manubrium aur body ke junction par ek palpable horizontal ridge ke roop mein locate hota hai. Ye surface landmark posteriorly T4-T5 intervertebral disc plane se precisely correspond karta hai, jise Transverse Thoracic Plane kehte hain. Ye boundary superior mediastinum ko inferior mediastinum se divide karti hai. Isi level par ascending aorta khatam hokar arch of aorta banta hai, pulmonary trunk bifurcate hota hai aur azygos vein superior vena cava mein drain karti hai. Chest aur thoracic spine radiography mein T4-T5 level internal thoracic structures aur mediastinal borders identify karne ka primary anatomical datum hota hai.

qe: At what vertebral level does the 'Trachea bifurcate' (Carina) into the primary bronchi?
qh: किस वर्टिब्रल स्तर पर श्वासनली (Trachea) दो मुख्य ब्रांकाई (Carina) में विभाजित होती है?
e: Trachea ka distal end internal cartilaginous ridge Carina par terminate hota hai, jahan se ye right aur left primary bronchi mein bifurcate hota hai. Recumbent supine position mein ye bifurcation T4-T5 intervertebral space ke theek barabar lie karta hai, jo sternal angle ka direct posterior counterpart hai. Standing ya deep inspiration par carina niche descend hokar T6 level tak shift ho sakti hai. Chest radiography mein carina ki exact T4-T5 localization endotracheal (ET) tube placement verify karne ke liye critical hoti hai, taaki ET tube tip carina se 3 se 5 cm superior place rahe aur accidental unilateral bronchial intubation prevent ho sake.

qe: The 'Xiphoid process' (distal tip of the sternum) corresponds to which vertebral level?
qh: 'जिफॉइड प्रोसेस' (उरोस्थि का निचला सिरा) किस वर्टिब्रल स्तर के अनुरूप है?
e: Xiphoid process sternum ka sabse chhota aur distal cartilaginous/bony element hota hai jo anterior midline par palpate hota hai. Xiphisternal joint aur xiphoid process posteriorly T9-T10 vertebral bodies ke plane par lie karte hain. Ye anatomical landmark thoracic cage ki inferior boundary define karta hai, diaphragm ke anterior central tendon ka attachment point banta hai, aur underlying liver ke superior margin ko mark karta hai. Abdominal plain film (KUB) aur thoracic spine AP projections mein xiphoid tip diaphragm ke dome aur T12 junction ko include karne ke liye superior collimation margin set karne mein use hoti hai.

qe: In an average recumbent patient, the 'Umbilicus' corresponds to which vertebral level?
qh: सामान्य लेटे हुए मरीज़ में 'नाभि' (Umbilicus) किस वर्टिब्रल स्तर से मेल खाती है?
e: Normal sthenic habitus wale supine recumbent patient mein Umbilicus L3-L4 intervertebral disc space ke transverse horizontal plane se correspond karti hai. Ye landmark abdominal wall ke four quadrants (RUQ, LUQ, RLQ, LLQ) ka intersection point hota hai aur abdominal aorta ke terminal bifurcation (L4 level) ke slightly superior lie karta hai. Body habitus, obesity aur standing posture mein gravity ki wajah se umbilicus L5 ya sacral plane tak ptotic descent kar sakti hai. Is variable shift ke chalte skeletal positioning mein bony landmarks (jaise iliac crest) ko soft tissue umbilicus ke mukable primary reliability di jaati hai.

qe: The highest point of the 'Iliac Crest' is the standard centering landmark for which vertebra?
qh: 'इलियाक क्रेस्ट' का उच्चतम बिंदु किस कशेरुका के लिए मानक सेंटरिंग लैंडमार्क है?
e: Pelvic ilium ka superior curved border Iliac Crest kehlata hai. Bilateral iliac crests ke uppermost points ko connect karne wali horizontal reference line ko Tuffier's line (Intercrestal line) kehte hain, jo vertebral column ke L4 spinous process aur L4-L5 intervertebral disc space se horizontally intersect karti hai. Lumbar spine AP/lateral, KUB plain abdomen aur pelvis examinations mein iliac crest gold standard palpable landmark hai. Yahan central ray target karne se L1 se lekar L5-S1 junction tak ki complete lumbar lordotic series aur pelvic margins cassette par symmetrically capture ho jaati hain.

qe: For an AP view of the 'Lumbar Spine', the central ray is directed perpendicular to the level of:
qh: 'लम्बर स्पाइन' के एपी व्यू के लिए, सेंट्रल रे को किसके स्तर पर लंबवत निर्देशित किया जाता है?
oh: इलियाक क्रेस्ट - L4 स्तर (Iliac crest / L4 level)
e: Standard 35 x 43 cm detector par complete Lumbar Spine AP projection acquire karte waqt central ray ko midsagittal plane par exactly iliac crest (L4-L5 vertebral level) ke horizontal plane par perpendicular enter karaya jata hai. Is standardized centering se L1 se L5 tak ki sabhi lumbar bodies, sacroiliac joints aur lower thoracic vertebrae (T11-T12) field-of-view mein balance ho jaate hain. Agar specifically lumbosacral junction (L5-S1) ka spot view lena ho, toh centering iliac crest se 1.5 inches inferior ya ASIS level par shift ki jaati hai taaki beam divergence lumbosacral disc space ko directly open kar sake.

qe: The 'Jugular (Sternal) Notch' corresponds posteriorly to which vertebral level?
qh: 'जुगुलर (स्टर्नल) नॉच' पीछे किस वर्टिब्रल स्तर से मेल खाता है?
e: Manubrium sterni ke superior border par deep central concavity hoti hai jise Jugular Notch, Suprasternal Notch ya Sternal Notch kehte hain. Horizontal axial plane par ye notch posteriorly T2-T3 intervertebral space se correspond karti hai. Chest radiography mein jugular notch PA projection ke waqt centering verify karne ka prominent anterior landmark hai. Apex of the lungs aur upper thoracic inlet clavicles ke superior border se 1.5 to 2 inches upar project hote hain. Is notch se roughly 3 to 4 inches inferiorly measure karke erect PA chest exam ke liye T7 mid-thorax centering verify ki jaati hai.

qe: The 'Vertebra Prominens' is the anatomical landmark for which spinous process?
qh: 'वर्टिब्रा प्रोमिनेंस' किस स्पाइनस प्रोसेस का एनाटॉमिकल लैंडमार्क है?
e: Seventh cervical vertebra (C7) ko structurally Vertebra Prominens kaha jata hai kyunki iska posterior spinous process exceptionally long, thick, horizontal aur non-bifid hota hai. Neck ko slightly flex karne par ye process skin ke niche base of the neck par easily visualize aur palpate ho jata hai. Thoracic spine aur PA chest radiography mein vertebra prominens primary posterior surface landmark hai. Adult PA chest exam mein vertebra prominens se 7 inches (females) ya 8 inches (males) inferiorly measure karke central ray ko T7 mid-thoracic body par align kiya jata hai.

qe: The 'Anterior Superior Iliac Spine' (ASIS) corresponds to which vertebral/sacral level?
qh: 'एंटीरियर सुपीरियर इलियाक स्पाइन' (ASIS) किस कशेरुकी/सेक्रल स्तर के अनुरूप है?
e: Iliac crest ke anterior terminal par ek sharp bony prominence hoti hai jise Anterior Superior Iliac Spine (ASIS) kehte hain, jo inguinal ligament ka origin point banta hai. ASIS posteriorly S1-S2 sacral segments ke horizontal level se match karti hai. Pelvic girdle, hip joint aur sacrococcygeal radiography mein ASIS primary positioning coordinate hai. Femoral neck aur hip joint center locate karne ke liye ASIS se pubic symphysis tak line draw ki jaati hai aur uske midpoint se 2.5 inches distally perpendicular measure kiya jata hai, jo femoral head ka exact location mark karta hai.

qe: At which vertebral level does the 'Inferior Angle of the Scapula' typically lie in an erect patient?
qh: सीधे खड़े मरीज़ में 'स्कैपुला का निचला कोण' आमतौर पर किस वर्टिब्रल स्तर पर स्थित होता है?
e: Scapula ka lowest point Inferior Angle kehlata hai jahan medial aur lateral borders aapas mein meet karte hain. Normal upright erect posture mein dono scapulae ke inferior angles T7 spinous process aur T7 vertebral body ke horizontal plane par lie karte hain. Ye level mid-thoracic cavity aur heart ke central mass ko represent karta hai. Standard PA chest X-ray positioning mein central ray ko inferior angle of scapula ke level par midsagittal plane par center kiya jata hai, jisse lung apices se lekar costophrenic angles tak ka entire lung parenchyma cassette par symmetrically cover hota hai.

qe: The 'Transpyloric plane' passes through which vertebral level?
qh: 'ट्रांसपायलोरिक प्लेन' किस कशेरुका स्तर से होकर गुजरता है?
e: Transpyloric plane (Addison's plane) jugular notch aur pubic symphysis ke exact midpoint se pass hone wala horizontal imaginary transverse plane hai. Ye posteriorly L1 vertebral body ke lower margin se intersect karta hai. Upper abdominal cross-sectional anatomy aur fluoroscopic barium procedures mein ye plane key anatomical landmarks cross karta hai: stomach ka pylorus, duodenum ka C-loop junction, pancreas ki neck, mesenteric vessels ka origin, gallbladder ka fundus aur dono kidneys ke hila. Barium meal series mein stomach emptying aur duodenal bulb imaging ke liye L1 plane primary diagnostic reference banta hai.

qe: The 'Greater Trochanter' of the femur lies at the same transverse plane as the:
qh: फीमर का 'ग्रेटर ट्रोकेन्टर' किस संरचना के समान अनुप्रस्थ तल पर स्थित होता है?
e: Femur ka Greater Trochanter lateral proximal thigh par easily palpable bony landmark hota hai. Iska superior margin horizontal transverse plane par midline Pubic Symphysis aur Coccyx ke level se perfectly match karta hai. Clinical pelvic radiography mein pubic symphysis ko directly palpate karna patient modesty ke chalte uncomfortable ho sakta hai. Greater trochanter ko laterally feel karke technologist non-invasively pubic symphysis ka exact inferior level identify kar leta hai, jo AP Pelvis, hip joint aur lower bladder margin include karne ke liye inferior collimation line define karta hai.
